definition_zh: 这种难度很有趣，能考验你的能力
example_zh: 具有挑战性的工作/问题/难题

definition: a hall in a public building that is used for formal meetings
example: The members left the council chamber.
definition_zh: 公共建筑中用于举行正式会议的大厅
example_zh: 议员们离开了议会大厅。

definition: a person, team, etc. that has won a competition, especially in a sport
example: the world/European/national/Olympic champion
definition_zh: 在比赛中获胜的人、团队等，尤其是体育比赛中的获胜者
example_zh: 世界冠军/欧洲冠军/全国冠军/奥运冠军

definition: a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport
example: the National Basketball Association Championship
definition_zh: 一项旨在评选某项运动中最佳选手或最佳队伍的比赛
example_zh: 美国职业篮球联赛总冠军

definition: a possibility of something happening, especially something that you want
example: chance of doing something, She only has a slim chance of passing the exam.
definition_zh: 某事发生的可能性，尤其是你希望发生的那种事
example_zh: 做某事的可能性，她通过考试的可能性微乎其微。

definition: the act or result of something becoming different
example: change in something, We're hoping for a change in the weather.
definition_zh: 某事物发生变化的过程或结果
example_zh: 某事发生变化，我们希望天气能有所变化。

definition: to become different
example: Rick hasn't changed. He looks exactly the same as he did at school.
definition_zh: 变得与众不同
example_zh: 里克一点也没变。他看起来和上学时一模一样。

definition: a television station
example: a television/TV channel
definition_zh: 一家电视台
example_zh: 一个电视频道

definition: a complete lack of order
example: economic/political/domestic chaos
definition_zh: 完全缺乏秩序
example_zh: 经济/政治/国内动荡

definition: a separate section of a book, usually with a number or title
example: to read/write a chapter
definition_zh: 书籍中的一个独立章节，通常带有编号或标题
example_zh: 阅读/撰写一章

definition: a person or an animal in a book, play or film
example: the main character in the film
definition_zh: 书籍、戏剧或电影中的人物或动物
example_zh: 电影中的主角

definition: very typical of something or of somebody’s character
example: characteristic of something/somebody, Community support of families is characteristic of many societies.
definition_zh: 非常具有某种事物的典型特征，或非常符合某人的性格
example_zh: 某事/某人的特征，社区对家庭的支持是许多社会的特征。

definition: a typical feature or quality that something/somebody has
example: There were few similarities in the brothers' physical characteristics.
definition_zh: 某物或某人所具有的典型特征或品质
example_zh: 这两兄弟的外貌特征几乎没什么相似之处。

definition: to be typical of a person, place or thing
example: the rolling hills that characterize this part of England
definition_zh: 是某人、某地或某物的典型特征
example_zh: 这片英格兰地区特有的连绵起伏的丘陵

definition: the amount of money that somebody asks for goods and services
example: admission charges
definition_zh: 某人对商品和服务所要求的金额
example_zh: 门票费用

definition: to ask an amount of money for goods or a service
example: The fees charged by some companies are excessive.
definition_zh: 对商品或服务收取一定金额的费用
example_zh: 某些公司收取的费用过高。

definition: an organization for helping people in need
example: a registered charity
definition_zh: 一个帮助有困难的人的组织
example_zh: 一家注册慈善机构

definition: the power of pleasing or attracting people
example: He was a man of great charm.
definition_zh: 取悦或吸引他人的能力
example_zh: 他是个极具魅力的人。

definition: very pleasant or attractive
example: The cottage is tiny, but it's charming.
definition_zh: 非常令人愉悦或有吸引力
example_zh: 这间小屋虽然很小，但很有魅力。

definition: a diagram, lists of figures, etc. that shows information
example: Some shares have lost two-thirds of their value since being issued (see chart).
definition_zh: 图表、图例列表等，用于展示信息
example_zh: 有些股票自发行以来，市值已下跌了三分之二（见图表）。

definition: to record or follow the progress or development of somebody/something
example: The exhibition charts the history of the palace.
definition_zh: 记录或关注某人/某事的进展或发展情况
example_zh: 该展览追溯了这座宫殿的历史。

definition: a written statement describing the rights that a particular group of people should have
example: the European Social Charter of workers’ rights
definition_zh: 一份书面声明，阐述某特定群体应享有的权利
example_zh: 《欧洲社会宪章》中的工人权利

definition: an act of running or driving after somebody/something in order to catch them or it
example: The thieves were caught by police after a short chase.
definition_zh: 为了追上某人或某物而奔跑或驾驶的行为
example_zh: 经过短暂追捕，小偷们被警方抓获。

definition: to run, drive, etc. after somebody/something in order to catch them or it
example: chase somebody/something, My dog likes chasing rabbits.
definition_zh: 为了追上某人或某物而奔跑、开车等
example_zh: 追赶某人/某物，我的狗喜欢追兔子。

definition: a friendly informal conversation
example: I just called in for a chat.
definition_zh: 一次友好的非正式交谈
example_zh: 我只是打个电话过来聊聊。

definition: to talk in a friendly, informal way to somebody
example: I'm sorry I can't stop to chat.
definition_zh: 以友好、随和的方式与某人交谈
example_zh: 很抱歉，我没时间停下来闲聊。

definition: costing little money or less money than you expected
example: cheap imports/flights
definition_zh: 花不了多少钱，或者比你预期的要少
example_zh: 廉价进口商品/机票

definition: for a low price
example: I got this dress cheap in a sale.
definition_zh: 价格低廉
example_zh: 我在打折时以低价买到了这条连衣裙。

definition: a person who cheats, especially in a game
example: You little cheat!
definition_zh: 作弊的人，尤其是在游戏中作弊的人
example_zh: 你这个小骗子！

definition: to trick somebody or make them believe something that is not true
example: cheat somebody/something, She is accused of attempting to cheat the taxman.
definition_zh: 欺骗某人，或让某人相信某件不真实的事情
example_zh: 欺骗某人/某物，她被指控企图欺骗税务机关。

definition: an act of making sure that something is safe, correct or in good condition by examining it
example: Could you give the tyres a check?
definition_zh: 通过检查某物，以确保其安全、正确或状况良好
example_zh: 你能帮我检查一下轮胎吗？

definition: to examine something to see if it is correct, safe or acceptable
example: check something, She gave me the minutes of the meeting to read and check.
definition_zh: 检查某事，以确定其是否正确、安全或可接受
example_zh: 核对一下，她把会议纪要交给我，让我阅读并核对。

definition: either side of the face below the eyes
example: chubby/rosy/pink cheeks
definition_zh: 眼睛下方脸部的两侧
example_zh: 圆润/红润/粉嫩的脸颊

definition: a shout of joy, support or praise
example: A great cheer went up from the crowd.
definition_zh: 一声欢呼、声援或赞美
example_zh: 人群中爆发出阵阵欢呼声。

definition: to shout loudly, in order to show support or praise for somebody, or to encourage them
example: We all cheered as the team came on to the field.
definition_zh: 大声喊叫，以表达对某人的支持或赞扬，或鼓励对方
example_zh: 当球队走上球场时，我们全都欢呼起来。

definition: happy, and showing it by the way that you behave
example: You're not your usual cheerful self today.
definition_zh: 感到快乐，并通过你的行为表现出来
example_zh: 你今天不像往常那样开朗了。

definition: a type of food made from milk that can be either soft or hard and is usually white or yellow in colour; a particular type of this food
example: Cheddar cheese
definition_zh: 一种用牛奶制成的食品，质地可软可硬，通常呈白色或黄色；该食品的特定种类
example_zh: 切达干酪

definition: a person whose job is to cook, especially the most senior person in a restaurant, hotel, etc.
example: a new book by celebrity chef Jamie Oliver
definition_zh: 以烹饪为职业的人，尤其是餐厅、酒店等场所中职位最高的人。
example_zh: 名厨杰米·奥利弗的新书

definition: connected with chemistry
example: changes in the chemical composition of the atmosphere
definition_zh: 与化学有关
example_zh: 大气化学成分的变化

definition: a substance obtained by or used in a chemical process
example: toxic chemicals
definition_zh: 通过化学过程获得或用于化学过程的物质
example_zh: 有毒化学品

definition: the scientific study of the structure of substances, how they react when combined or in contact with one another, and how they behave under different conditions
example: a degree in chemistry
definition_zh: 对物质结构、物质相互结合或接触时如何发生反应，以及在不同条件下其表现如何的科学研究
example_zh: 化学学位

definition: the top part of the front of the body, between the neck and the stomach
example: chest pains
definition_zh: 身体前部上端，位于脖子和肚子之间
example_zh: 胸痛

definition: a large bird that is often kept for its eggs or meat
example: They keep chickens in the back yard.
definition_zh: 一种常因产蛋或肉用而被饲养的大型鸟类
example_zh: 他们在后院养鸡。

definition: most important
example: the chief cause/problem/reason
definition_zh: 最重要的
example_zh: 主要原因/问题/理由

definition: a person with a high rank or the highest rank in a company or an organization
example: army/police chiefs
definition_zh: 在公司或组织中职位较高或职位最高的人
example_zh: 军队/警察首长

definition: a young human who is not yet an adult
example: a child of 3/a 3-year-old child
definition_zh: 尚未成年的人类青少年
example_zh: 3岁的孩子/一个3岁的孩子

definition: the period of somebody’s life when they are a child
example: childhood, adolescence, and adulthood
definition_zh: 一个人生命中作为儿童的时期
example_zh: 童年、青春期和成年期

definition: a long thin piece of potato fried in oil or fat
example: He was eating a burger and chips.
definition_zh: 用油或油脂炸制的一条细长的土豆条
example_zh: 他正在吃汉堡和薯条。

definition: a hard brown sweet food made from cocoa beans, used in cooking to add taste to cakes, etc. or eaten as a sweet
example: a chocolate bar
definition_zh: 一种由可可豆制成的坚硬棕色甜食，可用于烹饪以增添蛋糕等的风味，也可作为甜点直接食用。
example_zh: 一块巧克力棒

definition: an act of choosing between two or more possibilities; something that you can choose
example: We are faced with a difficult choice.
definition_zh: 在两个或多个选项之间做出选择的行为；可以供选择的事物
example_zh: 我们面临一个艰难的选择。

definition: a group of people who sing together, for example in church services or public performances
example: She sings in the school choir.
definition_zh: 一群一起唱歌的人，例如在教堂礼拜或公开演出中
example_zh: 她在学校合唱团里唱歌。

definition: to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available
example: You choose—I can't decide.
definition_zh: 从现有选项中决定你想要哪样东西或哪个人
example_zh: 你来选吧——我拿不定主意。

definition: to cut something into pieces with a sharp tool such as a knife
example: chop something, He was chopping logs for firewood.
definition_zh: 用刀具等锋利的工具将某物切成小块
example_zh: 砍……，他正在砍木头当柴火。

definition: lasting for a long time; difficult to cure
example: chronic bronchitis/arthritis/asthma
definition_zh: 持续时间很长；难以治愈
example_zh: 慢性支气管炎/关节炎/哮喘

definition: a thick, solid piece that has been cut or broken off something
example: a chunk of cheese/masonry
definition_zh: 从某物上切下或掰下的一块厚实、坚实的块状物
example_zh: 一块奶酪/一块砖块

definition: a building where Christians go to attend services, pray, etc.
example: The procession moved into the church.
definition_zh: 基督徒前往参加礼拜、祈祷等活动的场所。
example_zh: 游行队伍走进了教堂。

definition: a thin tube of paper filled with tobacco, for smoking
example: to smoke/have a cigarette
definition_zh: 一种装满烟草的细纸管，用于吸烟
example_zh: 抽烟/抽根烟

definition: a building in which films are shown
example: the local cinema
definition_zh: 一座放映电影的建筑
example_zh: 当地的电影院

definition: a completely round flat shape
example: the centre/circumference/radius/diameter of a circle
definition_zh: 一种完全圆形的扁平形状
example_zh: 圆的中心/周长/半径/直径

definition: to draw a circle around something
example: circle something, Luke circled a date on the kitchen calendar.
definition_zh: 在某物周围画一个圆
example_zh: 圈出某物，卢克在厨房日历上圈出了一个日期。

definition: a line, route or journey around a place
example: The race ended with eight laps of a city centre circuit.
definition_zh: 环绕某地的线路、路线或行程
example_zh: 比赛以市中心赛道上的八圈赛程收官。

definition: when a liquid, gas or air circulates or is circulated, it moves continuously around a place or system
example: The condition prevents the blood from circulating freely.
definition_zh: 当液体、气体或空气循环或被循环时，它们会持续地在某个场所或系统中流动
example_zh: 这种病症会阻碍血液的正常循环。

definition: the movement of blood around the body
example: Regular exercise will improve blood circulation.
definition_zh: 血液在体内的循环
example_zh: 定期锻炼有助于改善血液循环。

definition: the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event or an action
example: Police said there were no suspicious circumstances surrounding the boy's death.
definition_zh: 与某种状况、事件或行动相关并对其产生影响的条件和事实
example_zh: 警方表示，这名男孩的死亡没有可疑之处。

definition: to mention something as a reason or an example, or in order to support what you are saying
example: cite something, She cited examples of companies the city has helped relocate or expand.
definition_zh: 将某事作为理由或例子提及，或为了支持自己的观点
example_zh: 举例说明，她列举了该市曾协助搬迁或扩建的一些企业的例子。

definition: a person who has the legal right to belong to a particular country
example: The defeat of the president did not change the lives of ordinary citizens for the better.
definition_zh: 依法有权成为某国公民的人
example_zh: 总统的败选并未使普通民众的生活变得更好。

definition: the legal right to belong to a particular country
example: They were granted full French citizenship.
definition_zh: 属于某个国家的法律权利
example_zh: 他们获得了完整的法国国籍。

definition: a large and important town
example: Parking is difficult in the city centre.
definition_zh: 一座规模庞大且重要的城镇
example_zh: 市中心的停车很困难。

definition: officially connected with a town or city
example: civic buildings/leaders
definition_zh: 与某镇或某市有正式隶属关系
example_zh: 公共建筑/领导人

definition: connected with the people who live in a country
example: civil unrest (= that is caused by groups of people within a country)
definition_zh: 与该国人民息息相关
example_zh: 国内动乱（即由一国内部群体引发的动乱）

definition: connected with people who are not members of the armed forces or the police
example: He left the army and returned to civilian life.
definition_zh: 与非武装部队或警察人员有联系
example_zh: 他退伍后重返平民生活。

definition: a person who is not a member of the armed forces or the police
example: Two soldiers and one civilian were killed in the explosion.
definition_zh: 非武装部队或警察人员
example_zh: 爆炸造成两名士兵和一名平民死亡。

definition: a state of human society that is very developed and organized
example: the technology of modern civilization
definition_zh: 一种高度发达且组织有序的人类社会状态
example_zh: 现代文明的技术

definition: a statement that something is true although it has not been proved and other people may not agree with or believe it
example: claim about somebody/something, The company had made false claims about its products.
definition_zh: 指某事虽未经证实，且他人可能不认同或不相信，但仍断言其为真的说法
example_zh: 关于某人/某事的声明，该公司曾对其产品作出虚假声明。

definition: to say that something is true although it has not been proved and other people may not believe it
example: claim (that)…, He claims (that) he was not given a fair hearing.
definition_zh: 指某件事虽然尚未得到证实，且其他人可能并不相信，但仍断言其为真
example_zh: 声称（……），他声称自己没有得到公正的听证。

definition: to make something clearer or easier to understand
example: clarify something, to clarify a situation/problem/issue
definition_zh: 使某事更清晰或更易于理解
example_zh: 澄清某事，澄清某种情况/问题/争议

definition: the quality of being expressed clearly
example: a lack of clarity in the law
definition_zh: 表达清晰的特点
example_zh: 法律条文不够明确

definition: a short fight between two groups of people
example: Clashes broke out between police and demonstrators.
definition_zh: 两群人之间的一场短暂冲突
example_zh: 警方与示威者之间爆发了冲突。

definition: a group of students who are taught together
example: in the/your class, We were in the same class at school.
definition_zh: 一群一起上课的学生
example_zh: 在……的/你的班上，我们以前在学校是同班同学。

definition: accepted or deserving to be accepted as one of the best or most important of its kind
example: a classic film/story/car/game
definition_zh: 被公认为或理应被公认为同类中最佳或最重要的之一
example_zh: 一部经典电影/故事/汽车/游戏

definition: a book, film or song which is well known and considered to be of very high quality, setting standards for other books, etc.
example: The film is now a cult classic.
definition_zh: 一本广为人知且被认为质量极高的书、电影或歌曲，为其他书籍等树立了标杆。
example_zh: 这部电影如今已成为一部 cult 经典。

definition: relating to classical music
example: a classical composer/musician/pianist
definition_zh: 与古典音乐有关的
example_zh: 一位古典作曲家/音乐家/钢琴家

definition: the act or process of putting people or things into a group or class (= of classifying them)
example: a style of music that defies classification (= is like no other)
definition_zh: 将人或事物归入某个群体或类别（即对其进行分类）的行为或过程
example_zh: 一种难以归类的音乐风格（= 独一无二）

definition: to arrange something in groups according to features that they have in common
example: The books in the library are classified according to subject.
definition_zh: 根据共同特征将事物分组排列
example_zh: 图书馆里的书籍是按主题分类的。

definition: a room where a class of children or students is taught
example: classroom activities
definition_zh: 一间用于给孩子们或学生上课的教室
example_zh: 课堂活动

definition: a group of words that includes a subject and a verb, and forms a sentence or part of a sentence
example: in a clause, There are languages that require the subject to come before the object in a clause.
definition_zh: 由主语和谓语组成的词组，构成一个句子或句子的组成部分
example_zh: 在从句中，有些语言要求主语必须位于宾语之前。

definition: not dirty
example: Are your hands clean?
definition_zh: 不脏
example_zh: 你的手洗干净了吗？

definition: to remove the dirt or dust from something
example: I spent all day cooking and cleaning.
definition_zh: 清除某物上的污垢或灰尘
example_zh: 我一整天都在做饭和打扫卫生。

definition: easy to understand and not confusing
example: She gave me clear and precise directions.
definition_zh: 通俗易懂，不会让人感到困惑
example_zh: 她给我指了条清晰明确的路。

definition: to remove things that are not wanted or needed from something
example: clear something, The settlers cleared the land and planted crops.
definition_zh: 从某物中去除不需要或不想要的东西
example_zh: 开垦某地，定居者们开垦了这片土地并播种了农作物。

definition: in a way that is easy to see or hear
example: Please speak clearly after the tone.
definition_zh: 以一种容易看到或听到的方式
example_zh: 请在提示音后清晰地说出您的内容。

definition: a person whose job is to serve customers in a shop
example: The clerk at the counter gave me too little change.
definition_zh: 在商店里负责为顾客提供服务的人
example_zh: 柜台的店员找的零钱少了。

definition: quick at learning and understanding things
example: a clever child
definition_zh: 学习理解能力强
example_zh: 一个聪明的孩子

definition: the act of pressing the button on a computer mouse or touchpad
example: a mouse click
definition_zh: 按下电脑鼠标或触控板上的按钮这一动作
example_zh: 一次鼠标点击

definition: to choose a particular function or item on a computer screen, etc., by pressing one of the buttons on a mouse or touchpad
example: Click here to add your opinion to the survey.
definition_zh: 通过点击鼠标或触控板上的某个按钮，在计算机屏幕上选择特定的功能或项目等
example_zh: 点击此处在调查中发表您的意见。

definition: a person who uses the services or advice of a professional person or organization
example: She's a well-known lawyer with many famous clients.
definition_zh: 指使用专业人士或组织提供的服务或建议的人
example_zh: 她是一位知名律师，拥有许多名流客户。

definition: a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or ocean
example: the cliff edge/top
definition_zh: 一块岩石嶙峋的高地，一侧极其陡峭，通常位于海边或海滨
example_zh: 悬崖边缘/顶部

definition: the regular pattern of weather conditions of a particular place
example: a tropical/warm/mild/temperate/cold climate
definition_zh: 某地天气状况的常规模式
example_zh: 热带/温暖/温和/温带/寒冷气候

definition: an act of climbing up a mountain, rock or large number of steps; a period of time spent climbing
example: an exhausting climb
definition_zh: 攀登山峰、岩石或大量台阶的行为；攀登所花费的时间
example_zh: 一段令人筋疲力尽的攀登

definition: to go up something towards the top
example: climb (up) something, to climb a mountain/tree
definition_zh: 沿着某物向上爬到顶部
example_zh: 攀爬（某物），指攀登山峰/树木

definition: to hold on tightly to somebody/something
example: cling to somebody/something, survivors clinging to a raft
definition_zh: 紧紧抓住某人/某物
example_zh: 紧抓某人/某物，幸存者紧抓木筏

definition: a building or part of a hospital where people can go for special medical treatment or advice
example: Your local family planning clinic can give you advice about birth control.
definition_zh: 医院内的一栋建筑或部分区域，人们可以前往那里接受特殊的医疗治疗或咨询
example_zh: 您当地的计划生育诊所可以为您提供有关避孕的建议。

definition: relating to the examination and treatment of patients and their illnesses
example: clinical research (= done on patients, not just considering theory)
definition_zh: 与患者及其疾病的检查和治疗有关的
example_zh: 临床研究（即在患者身上进行的，而不仅仅是理论探讨）

definition: a short part of a film that is shown separately
example: Here is a clip from her latest movie.
definition_zh: 电影中单独放映的一小段内容
example_zh: 这是她最新电影中的一段片段。

definition: an instrument for measuring and showing time, in a room, on the wall of a building or on a computer screen (not worn or carried like a watch)
example: The clock struck twelve/midnight.
definition_zh: 一种用于测量和显示时间的仪器，通常放置在房间内、建筑物的墙上或电脑屏幕上（不像手表那样佩戴或随身携带）
example_zh: 时钟敲响了十二点/午夜。

definition: near in space or time
example: I had no idea the beach was so close.
definition_zh: 在空间或时间上相近
example_zh: 我完全没想到海滩竟然这么近。

definition: near; not far away
example: + adv./prep., They sat close together.
definition_zh: 附近；不远
example_zh: + 副词/介词，他们坐得很近。

definition: the end of a period of time or an activity
example: at the close of the seventeenth century
definition_zh: 一段时间或某项活动的结束
example_zh: 十七世纪末

definition: to put something into a position so that it covers an opening; to get into this position
example: He closed the door firmly.
definition_zh: 将某物放置在某个位置，使其遮住开口；采取这种姿势
example_zh: 他“啪”地一声把门关上了。

definition: shut
example: Keep the door closed.
definition_zh: 关闭
example_zh: 请把门关好。

definition: near in space or time
example: He walked into the room, closely followed by the rest of the family.
definition_zh: 在空间或时间上相近
example_zh: 他走进房间，其余家人紧随其后。

definition: the situation when a factory, school, hospital, etc. shuts permanently
example: factory closures
definition_zh: 工厂、学校、医院等机构永久关闭的情况
example_zh: 工厂关闭

definition: material made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, etc.
example: woollen/cotton/linen cloth
definition_zh: 通过编织或针织棉、羊毛、丝绸等制成的织物。
example_zh: 羊毛/棉/亚麻布

definition: the things that you wear, such as trousers, dresses and jackets
example: I bought some new clothes for the trip.
definition_zh: 你穿的衣服，比如裤子、连衣裙和夹克
example_zh: 我为这次旅行买了一些新衣服。

definition: clothes, especially a particular type of clothes
example: Workers at the factory wear protective clothing.
definition_zh: 衣服，尤其是某一种衣服
example_zh: 工厂里的工人穿着防护服。

definition: a grey or white mass that floats in the sky, made of very small drops of water
example: Dark clouds were gathering in the west.
definition_zh: 漂浮在天空中的灰色或白色团块，由极其微小的水滴组成
example_zh: 西边乌云密布。

definition: an organization for people who share an interest or do a sport or activity together
example: a golf/tennis/chess/film club
definition_zh: 由兴趣相投或共同从事某项运动或活动的人组成的组织
example_zh: 高尔夫/网球/国际象棋/电影俱乐部

definition: an object, a piece of evidence or some information that helps the police solve a crime
example: The burglar left no clues.
definition_zh: 有助于警方破案的物品、证据或信息
example_zh: 窃贼没有留下任何线索。

definition: a group of things of the same type that grow or appear close together
example: The telescope is focused on a dense cluster of stars at the edge of the galaxy.
definition_zh: 一组生长或出现得很近的同类事物
example_zh: 这台望远镜正对准银河系边缘的一个密集星团。

definition: a person who trains a person or team in sport
example: the head/assistant coach
definition_zh: 负责对个人或团队进行体育训练的人
example_zh: 主教练/助理教练

definition: to train somebody to play a sport, to do a job better, or to improve a skill
example: coach somebody, He has coached the team for five years.
definition_zh: 培训某人从事某项运动、更好地胜任某项工作，或提高某项技能
example_zh: 指导某人，他已经执教这支球队五年了。

definition: a hard black mineral that is found below the ground and burnt to produce heat
example: I put more coal on the fire.
definition_zh: 一种坚硬的黑色矿物，存在于地下，经燃烧可产生热量
example_zh: 我往火里添了些煤。

definition: a government formed by two or more political parties working together
example: The two parties have formed a coalition.
definition_zh: 由两个或多个政党共同组建的政府
example_zh: 两党已组成联盟。

definition: the land next to or near to the sea or ocean
example: a trip to the coast
definition_zh: 紧邻或靠近大海或海洋的土地
example_zh: 一次海边之旅

definition: of or near a coast
example: coastal waters/resorts/scenery
definition_zh: 位于海岸或靠近海岸的
example_zh: 沿海水域/度假胜地/风景

definition: a piece of outdoor clothing that is worn over other clothes to keep warm or dry. Coats have sleeves (= parts covering the arms) and may be long or short.
example: to wear a coat
definition_zh: 一种穿在其他衣服外面的户外服装，用于保暖或防潮。大衣有袖子（即覆盖手臂的部分），可长可短。
example_zh: 穿外套

definition: a drink usually made from a mixture of one or more spirits (= strong alcoholic drinks) and fruit juice. It can also be made without alcohol.
example: a cocktail bar/cabinet/lounge/shaker
definition_zh: 一种通常由一种或多种烈酒（即高浓度酒精饮料）与果汁混合制成的饮品。也可以不加酒精来制作。
example_zh: 鸡尾酒酒吧/酒柜/休息室/摇酒器

definition: a system of words, letters, numbers or symbols that represent a message or record information secretly or in a shorter form
example: to break/crack a code (= to understand and read the message)
definition_zh: 一种由词语、字母、数字或符号组成的系统，用于以隐秘的方式或以更简洁的形式表达信息或记录信息
example_zh: 破译密码（即理解并读懂信息）

definition: the roasted seeds (called coffee beans) of a tropical bush; a powder made from them
example: ground/real/instant coffee
definition_zh: 一种热带灌木的烘焙种子（称为咖啡豆）；用其制成的粉末
example_zh: 研磨咖啡/速溶咖啡/即溶咖啡

definition: connected with mental processes of understanding
example: a child’s cognitive development
definition_zh: 与理解的心理过程相关
example_zh: 儿童的认知发展

definition: a small flat piece of metal used as money
example: gold coins
definition_zh: 一种用作货币的小块扁平金属片
example_zh: 金币

definition: to take place at the same time
example: It's a pity our trips to New York don't coincide.
definition_zh: 同时举行
example_zh: 真遗憾，我们去纽约的时间没能凑在一起。

definition: the fact of two things happening at the same time by chance, in a surprising way
example: a strange/an extraordinary/a remarkable coincidence
definition_zh: 两件事偶然同时发生，且方式出人意料这一事实
example_zh: 一个奇怪的/一个非凡的/一个惊人的巧合

definition: having a lower than usual temperature; having a temperature lower than the human body
example: I'm cold. Turn the heating up.
definition_zh: 温度低于正常水平；温度低于人体温度
example_zh: 我冷。把暖气调大点。

definition: a common illness that affects the nose and/or throat, making you cough, sneeze, etc.
example: I've got a cold.
definition_zh: 一种常见的疾病，会影响鼻子和/或喉咙，导致咳嗽、打喷嚏等症状。
example_zh: 我感冒了。

definition: to work together with somebody in order to produce or achieve something
example: Researchers around the world are collaborating to develop a new vaccine.
definition_zh: 与某人通力合作，以创造或实现某事
example_zh: 世界各地的研究人员正在通力合作，共同研发一种新疫苗。

definition: the act of working with another person or group of people to create or produce something
example: It was a collaboration that produced extremely useful results.
definition_zh: 与另一个人或一群人合作以创造或制作某物的行为
example_zh: 这是一次取得了极具价值成果的合作。

definition: a sudden failure of something, such as an institution, a business or a course of action
example: the collapse of the Soviet Union
definition_zh: 某事物（如机构、企业或行动方案）的突然失败
example_zh: 苏联的解体

definition: to fall down or fall in suddenly, often after breaking apart
example: The roof collapsed under the weight of snow.
definition_zh: 突然倒下或坠入，通常是在崩裂之后
example_zh: 屋顶因积雪的重量而坍塌了。

definition: a person that you work with, especially in a profession or a business
example: work/senior/male colleagues
definition_zh: 与你共事的人，尤其是在同一行业或同一企业中
example_zh: 工作/资深/男性同事

definition: to bring things together from different people or places
example: collect something, to collect data/evidence/information
definition_zh: 将来自不同的人或地方的事物整合在一起
example_zh: 收集某物，收集数据/证据/信息

definition: a group of objects, often of the same sort, that have been collected
example: He wanted to share his vast art collection with the world.
definition_zh: 一组被收集起来的物品，通常是同类物品
example_zh: 他希望将自己庞大的艺术收藏与全世界分享。

definition: done or shared by all members of a group of people; involving a whole group or society
example: collective leadership/decision-making/responsibility
definition_zh: 由一群人的所有成员完成或分享的；涉及整个群体或社会的
example_zh: 集体领导/决策/责任

definition: a person who collects things, either as a hobby or as a job
example: a stamp collector
definition_zh: 指以收藏为爱好或职业的人
example_zh: 一位集邮者

definition: (in the UK) a place where students go to study or to receive training after they have left school
example: a secretarial college
definition_zh: （在英国）学生从学校毕业后去学习或接受培训的地方
example_zh: 一所秘书学院

definition: an accident in which two vehicles or people crash into each other
example: collision between A and B, a collision between two trains
definition_zh: 指两辆车或两人发生碰撞的事故
example_zh: A与B之间的碰撞，两列火车之间的碰撞

definition: connected with or belonging to a country that controls another country
example: a colonial power
definition_zh: 与控制另一个国家的国家有关联或隶属于该国
example_zh: 一个殖民大国

definition: a country or an area that is governed by people from another, more powerful, country
example: former British colonies
definition_zh: 一个由另一个更强大的国家的人所统治的国家或地区
example_zh: 英国的前殖民地

definition: the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light. Red, orange and green are colours.
example: What's your favourite colour?
definition_zh: 物体因反射光线的方式而呈现出的外观。红色、橙色和绿色都是颜色。
example_zh: 你最喜欢的颜色是什么？

definition: having a particular colour or different colours
example: brightly coloured balloons
definition_zh: 具有某种特定颜色或多种颜色
example_zh: 色彩鲜艳的气球

definition: full of bright colours or having a lot of different colours
example: colourful shop windows
definition_zh: 充满鲜艳的色彩，或包含许多不同的颜色
example_zh: 色彩斑斓的橱窗

definition: one of the straight sections from top to bottom into which text on a page or screen is divided
example: a dictionary with two columns per page
definition_zh: 页面或屏幕上的文本被划分为的、从上到下的直线段之一
example_zh: 每页两栏的词典

definition: a journalist who writes regular articles for a newspaper or magazine
example: a newspaper columnist
definition_zh: 一位定期为报纸或杂志撰稿的记者
example_zh: 一位报纸专栏作家

definition: fighting or a fight, especially during a time of war
example: in combat, He was killed in combat.
definition_zh: 战斗或一场战斗，尤其是在战争时期
example_zh: 在战斗中，他在战斗中阵亡。

definition: to stop something unpleasant or harmful from happening or from getting worse
example: measures to combat crime/inflation/unemployment/disease
definition_zh: 阻止某件令人不快或有害的事情发生，或防止其恶化
example_zh: 打击犯罪、通货膨胀、失业和疾病的措施

definition: two or more things joined or mixed together to form a single unit
example: combination of something, The tragedy was due to a combination of factors.
definition_zh: 两个或多个事物结合或混合在一起，形成一个整体
example_zh: 某种因素的综合作用，这场悲剧是多种因素综合作用的结果。

definition: to come together to form a single thing or group; to join two or more things or groups together to form a single one
example: combine to do something, Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water.
definition_zh: 聚合为一个整体或群体；将两个或多个事物或群体结合在一起，形成一个整体
example_zh: 结合起来做某事，氢和氧结合形成水。

definition: to move to or towards a person or place
example: + adv./prep., He left and said he was never coming back.
definition_zh: 向某人或某地移动
example_zh: + 副词/介词，他走了，并说他再也不会回来了。

definition: a play, film or TV show that is intended to be funny, usually with a happy ending; plays, films and TV shows of this type
example: a romantic comedy
definition_zh: 旨在逗乐的戏剧、电影或电视剧，通常以圆满结局收场；此类戏剧、电影和电视剧
example_zh: 一部浪漫喜剧

definition: the state of being physically relaxed and free from pain; the state of having a pleasant life, with everything that you need
example: The hotel offers a high standard of comfort and service.
definition_zh: 身体放松且无痛的状态；生活愉快、所需尽备的状态
example_zh: 这家酒店提供高水准的舒适体验和服务。

definition: to make somebody who is worried or unhappy feel better by being kind and showing sympathy to them
example: comfort somebody, The victim's widow was today being comforted by family and friends.
definition_zh: 通过对某人表现出善意和同情，让感到担忧或不开心的人心情好转
example_zh: 安慰某人，今天，受害者的遗孀正受到亲友的安慰。

definition: making you feel physically relaxed; pleasant to wear, sit on, etc.
example: It's such a comfortable bed.
definition_zh: 让你感到身体放松；穿着、坐着等时都很舒适。
example_zh: 这张床真舒服。

definition: humorous and making you laugh
example: a comic monologue/story
definition_zh: 风趣幽默，让人发笑
example_zh: 一则幽默独白/故事

definition: a magazine, usually for children, that tells stories through pictures
example: a comic book superhero
definition_zh: 一种通常面向儿童、通过图片讲述故事的杂志
example_zh: 漫画书中的超级英雄

definition: an order given to a person or an animal
example: Begin when I give the command.
definition_zh: 对人或动物下达的命令
example_zh: 等我下达指令后开始。

definition: to tell somebody to do something
example: command somebody to do something, He commanded his men to retreat.
definition_zh: 让某人做某事
example_zh: 命令某人做某事，他命令手下撤退。

definition: a person who is in charge of something, especially an officer in charge of a particular group of soldiers or a military operation
example: military/allied/field/flight commanders
definition_zh: 负责某项事务的人，尤其是负责特定部队或某项军事行动的军官
example_zh: 军事/盟军/前线/飞行指挥官

definition: to begin to happen; to begin something
example: The meeting is scheduled to commence at noon.
definition_zh: 开始发生；开始做某事
example_zh: 会议定于中午开始。

definition: something that you say or write that gives an opinion on or explains somebody/something
example: comment on something, She made helpful comments on my work.
definition_zh: 你所说或所写的内容，其中表达了对某人或某事的看法，或对其进行了解释
example_zh: 对某事发表评论，她对我的作品提出了有建设性的意见。

definition: to express an opinion about something
example: He refused to comment until after the trial.
definition_zh: 对某事发表意见
example_zh: 他拒绝在审判结束前发表评论。

definition: a spoken description of an event that is given while it is happening, especially on the radio or television
example: a sports commentary
definition_zh: 对正在发生的事件进行的口头描述，尤其是在广播或电视上进行的描述
example_zh: 一篇体育评论

definition: a person who describes an event while it is happening, especially on television or radio
example: a television/sports commentator
definition_zh: 在事件发生时对其进行解说的人，尤其是在电视或广播中
example_zh: 一名电视/体育评论员

definition: trade, especially between countries; the buying and selling of goods and services
example: Leaders of industry and commerce met at the summit in Paris.
definition_zh: 贸易，尤其是国家之间的贸易；商品和服务的买卖
example_zh: 工商界领袖齐聚巴黎峰会。

definition: connected with the buying and selling of goods and services
example: residential and commercial properties
definition_zh: 与商品和服务的买卖有关
example_zh: 住宅和商业房产

definition: an advertisement on television, on the radio or on a website
example: a TV/television commercial
definition_zh: 电视、广播或网站上的广告
example_zh: 电视广告

definition: an official group of people who have been given responsibility to control something, or to find out about something, usually for the government
example: The commission is expected to report its findings next month.
definition_zh: 一个由官方任命的团体，其职责是管理某项事务或调查某件事，通常受政府委托
example_zh: 该委员会预计将于下个月公布调查结果。

definition: to officially ask somebody to write, make or create something or to do a task for you
example: commission somebody to do something, She has been commissioned to write a new national anthem.
definition_zh: 正式请某人代为撰写、制作或创作某物，或代为完成某项任务
example_zh: 委托某人做某事，她受委托创作一首新的国歌。

definition: a member of a commission (= an official group of people who are responsible for controlling something or finding out about something)
example: the Church Commissioners (= the group of people responsible for controlling the financial affairs of the Church of England)
definition_zh: 委员会的一名成员（= 负责管理某事或调查某事的官方团体）
example_zh: 教会委员会（即负责管理英国国教财务事务的机构）

definition: to do something wrong or illegal
example: to commit a crime/an offence
definition_zh: 做错事或违法
example_zh: 犯下罪行/违法行为

definition: a promise to do something or to behave in a particular way; a promise to support somebody/something; the fact of committing yourself
example: I'm not ready to make a long-term commitment.
definition_zh: 承诺做某事或以某种特定方式行事；承诺支持某人或某事；做出承诺这一事实
example_zh: 我还没准备好做出长期承诺。

definition: a group of people who are chosen, usually by a larger group, to make decisions or to deal with a particular subject
example: an executive/advisory/organizing committee
definition_zh: 由一个较大群体选出的、负责做出决策或处理特定事务的一群人
example_zh: 执行/顾问/组织委员会

definition: a product or a raw material that can be bought and sold
example: rice, flour and other basic commodities
definition_zh: 一种可以买卖的产品或原材料
example_zh: 大米、面粉和其他生活必需品

definition: happening often; existing in large numbers or in many places
example: a common problem/occurrence/practice
definition_zh: 经常发生；数量众多或分布广泛
example_zh: 一个常见的问题/现象/做法

definition: usually; very often; by most people
example: Christopher is commonly known as Kit.
definition_zh: 通常；非常经常；大多数人
example_zh: 克里斯托弗通常被称为基特。

definition: to share or exchange information, news, ideas, feelings, etc.
example: We only communicate by email.
definition_zh: 分享或交流信息、新闻、想法、感受等。
example_zh: 我们仅通过电子邮件进行沟通。

definition: the activity or process of expressing ideas and feelings or of giving people information
example: communication between A and B, Good communication between team leaders and members is essential.
definition_zh: 表达思想和情感，或向他人传递信息的活动或过程
example_zh: A与B之间的沟通，团队领导与成员之间良好的沟通至关重要。

definition: connected with communism
example: communist ideology
definition_zh: 与共产主义有关
example_zh: 共产主义意识形态

definition: all the people who live in a particular area, country, etc. when talked about as a group
example: The local community supported us from the start.
definition_zh: 指作为整体来讨论的、居住在特定地区、国家等地的所有居民
example_zh: 当地社区从一开始就支持我们。

definition: a person or an animal that travels with you or spends a lot of time with you
example: travelling companions
definition_zh: 与你一同旅行或经常与你在一起的人或动物
example_zh: 旅伴

definition: a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services
example: insurance/oil/tech/technology/pharmaceutical companies
definition_zh: 一种通过生产或销售商品或服务来盈利的商业组织
example_zh: 保险/石油/科技/技术/制药公司

definition: similar to somebody/something else and able to be compared
example: A comparable house in the south of the city would cost twice as much.
definition_zh: 与其他某人/某物相似，且可以进行比较
example_zh: 在该市南部，一套类似的房子价格要高出一倍。

definition: measured or judged by how similar or different it is to something else
example: Then he was living in comparative comfort (= compared with others or with his own life at a previous time).
definition_zh: 根据它与其他事物的相似或不同程度来衡量或评判
example_zh: 那时他的生活相对舒适（即与他人相比，或与他过去的生活相比）。

definition: to examine people or things to see how they are similar and how they are different
example: compare A and B, It is interesting to compare their situation and ours.
definition_zh: 对人和事物进行考察，以了解它们的相似之处和不同之处
example_zh: 比较A和B，将它们的情况与我们的情况进行对比，这很有意思。

definition: the process of comparing two or more people or things
example: For Durkheim, comparison was the most important method of analysis in sociology.
definition_zh: 将两个人或两件事物进行比较的过程
example_zh: 对涂尔干而言，比较是社会学中最重要的分析方法。

definition: a strong feeling of sympathy for people or animals who are suffering and a desire to help them
example: to feel/show compassion
definition_zh: 对正在受苦的人或动物怀有强烈的同情心，并希望帮助他们
example_zh: 感到/表现出同情心

definition: to force somebody to do something; to make something necessary
example: compel somebody to do something, The law can compel fathers to make regular payments for their children.
definition_zh: 迫使某人做某事；使某事成为必要
example_zh: 强迫某人做某事。法律可以强制父亲定期为子女支付抚养费。

definition: that makes you pay attention to it because it is so interesting and exciting
example: Her latest book makes compelling reading.
definition_zh: 这会让你不由得关注它，因为它太有趣、太刺激了
example_zh: 她的最新著作引人入胜。

definition: to provide something good to balance or reduce the bad effects of damage, loss, etc.
example: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a loved one.
definition_zh: 提供一些有益之物，以抵消或减轻损害、损失等带来的负面影响。
example_zh: 失去至亲的痛苦是任何东西都无法弥补的。

definition: something, especially money, that somebody gives you because they have hurt you, or damaged something that you own; the act of giving this to somebody
example: to claim/award/receive compensation
definition_zh: 某人因伤害了你，或损坏了你拥有的物品而给予你的东西（尤其是金钱）；将此物给予他人的行为
example_zh: 申请/获得/领取赔偿

definition: to take part in a contest or game
example: The games were an outstanding success, with almost 2 400 athletes competing.
definition_zh: 参加比赛或游戏
example_zh: 本届运动会取得了巨大成功，共有近2400名运动员参赛。

definition: the ability to do something well
example: to gain a high level of competence in English
definition_zh: 把某件事做得很好的能力
example_zh: 掌握高水平的英语能力

definition: having enough skill or knowledge to do something well or to the necessary standard
example: He's very competent in his work.
definition_zh: 具备足够的技能或知识，能够将某件事做好或达到必要的标准
example_zh: 他在工作上非常称职。

definition: an event in which people compete with each other to find out who is the best at something
example: a design/an art/a talent competition
definition_zh: 一种人们相互竞争以确定谁在某方面最出色的事
example_zh: 一项设计/艺术/才艺比赛

definition: used to describe a situation in which people or organizations compete against each other
example: competitive games/sports
definition_zh: 用于描述人们或组织之间相互竞争的情况
example_zh: 竞技类游戏/体育项目

definition: a person who takes part in a competition
example: Over 200 competitors entered the race.
definition_zh: 参加比赛的人
example_zh: 共有200多名选手参加了比赛。

definition: to produce a book, list, report, etc. by bringing together different items, articles, songs, etc.; to collect information in order to produce a book, list, etc.
example: We are trying to compile a list of suitable people for the job.
definition_zh: 通过汇集不同的项目、文章、歌曲等，编纂成书、列表、报告等；收集信息以编纂成书、列表等。
example_zh: 我们正在尝试整理一份适合该职位的人选名单。

definition: to say that you are annoyed, unhappy or not satisfied about somebody/something
example: She never complains, but she's obviously exhausted.
definition_zh: 表示你对某人或某事感到恼火、不高兴或不满意
example_zh: 她从不抱怨，但显然已经筋疲力尽了。

definition: a reason for not being satisfied; a statement that somebody makes saying that they are not satisfied
example: a formal complaint
definition_zh: 不满意的原因；某人表示自己不满意时所说的话
example_zh: 一份正式投诉

definition: to add to something in a way that improves it or makes it more attractive
example: The excellent menu is complemented by a good wine list.
definition_zh: 以某种方式对某物进行补充，使其得到改进或更具吸引力
example_zh: 除了精彩的菜单外，这里还有一份不错的酒单。

definition: including all the parts, etc. that are necessary; whole
example: a complete list/sequence/picture/profile
definition_zh: 包括所有必要的部件等；整体
example_zh: 完整的列表/顺序/图片/简介

definition: to finish making or doing something
example: to complete a course/project
definition_zh: 完成某件事
example_zh: 完成一门课程/一个项目

definition: in every way possible; in every part
example: It was completely different from how I had imagined it.
definition_zh: 在各个方面；在每个部分
example_zh: 这和我想象中的完全不一样。

definition: the act or process of finishing something; the state of being finished and complete
example: the completion of the new hospital building
definition_zh: 完成某事的动作或过程；已完成且完备的状态
example_zh: 新医院大楼的竣工

definition: made of many different things or parts that are connected; difficult to understand
example: a complex problem/issue/process/system
definition_zh: 由许多不同的东西或部件连接而成；难以理解
example_zh: 一个复杂的问题/议题/流程/系统

definition: a group of buildings of a similar type together in one place
example: a sports/leisure/shopping complex
definition_zh: 一组类型相似的建筑物聚集在同一地点
example_zh: 一个体育、休闲和购物综合体

definition: the state of being formed of many parts; the state of being difficult to understand
example: the increasing complexity of modern telecommunication systems
definition_zh: 由许多部分组成；难以理解的状态
example_zh: 现代电信系统的日益复杂化

definition: the practice of obeying rules or requests made by people in authority
example: compliance (with something), procedures that must be followed to ensure full compliance with the law
definition_zh: 遵守权威人士制定的规则或提出的请求的做法
example_zh: 合规（符合某项要求），为确保完全遵守法律而必须遵循的程序

definition: made of many different things or parts that are connected; difficult to understand
example: a complicated issue/process/system
definition_zh: 由许多不同的东西或部件连接而成；难以理解
example_zh: 一个复杂的问题/流程/系统

definition: a thing that makes a situation more complicated or difficult
example: The bad weather added a further complication to our journey.
definition_zh: 使某种情况变得更加复杂或困难的因素
example_zh: 恶劣的天气给我们的旅程增添了新的困难。

definition: to obey a rule, an order, etc.; to meet particular standards
example: They refused to comply with the UN resolution.
definition_zh: 遵守规则、命令等；符合特定标准
example_zh: 他们拒绝遵守联合国决议。

definition: one of several parts of which something is made
example: the different organizations involved in the design of the various components
definition_zh: 某物由若干部分组成，其中之一
example_zh: 参与各组件设计的不同组织

definition: to write music
example: Mozart composed his last opera shortly before he died.
definition_zh: 创作音乐
example_zh: 莫扎特在他去世前不久创作了他的最后一部歌剧。

definition: a person who writes music, especially classical music
example: Verdi was a prolific composer of operas.
definition_zh: 创作音乐的人，尤其是古典音乐
example_zh: 威尔第是一位多产的歌剧作曲家。

definition: the different parts that something is made of; the way in which the different parts are organized
example: the chemical composition of the soil
definition_zh: 某物由哪些部分组成；这些部分是如何组织起来的
example_zh: 土壤的化学成分

definition: a thing consisting of two or more separate things combined together
example: compounds derived from rainforest plants
definition_zh: 由两个或两个以上独立事物组合而成的东西
example_zh: 源自雨林植物的化合物

definition: including all, or almost all, the items, details, facts, information, etc., that may be involved
example: a comprehensive list of addresses
definition_zh: 包括可能涉及的所有或几乎所有项目、细节、事实、信息等
example_zh: 一份完整的地址清单

definition: to have somebody/something as parts or members
example: comprise something, The collection comprises 327 paintings.
definition_zh: 由某人或某物作为组成部分或成员
example_zh: 由……组成，该收藏共包含327幅画作。

definition: an agreement made between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end
example: After lengthy talks the two sides finally reached a compromise.
definition_zh: 两人或两组人之间达成的协议，双方各自放弃部分诉求，最终使双方都感到满意
example_zh: 经过长时间的谈判，双方终于达成了妥协。

definition: to give up some of your demands in order to reach an agreement after disagreeing with somebody
example: Neither side is prepared to compromise.
definition_zh: 在与某人意见不一致后，为了达成协议而放弃部分要求
example_zh: 双方都不愿做出让步。

definition: that must be done because of a law or a rule
example: English is a compulsory subject at this level.
definition_zh: 因法律或规定而必须做的事
example_zh: 英语是该年级段的必修科目。

definition: to calculate something
example: The losses were computed at £5 million.
definition_zh: 计算某项内容
example_zh: 损失金额计算为500万英镑。

definition: an electronic machine that can store, organize and find information, do processes with numbers and other data, and control other machines
example: a home computer
definition_zh: 一种能够存储、整理和检索信息，对数字和其他数据进行处理，并控制其他机器的电子设备
example_zh: 一台家用电脑

definition: to hide somebody/something
example: conceal somebody/something, The paintings were concealed beneath a thick layer of plaster.
definition_zh: 藏起某人/某物
example_zh: 隐藏某人/某物，这些画作被藏在一层厚厚的石膏之下。

definition: to admit that something is true, logical, etc. after first denying it or resisting it
example: + speech, ‘Not bad,’ she conceded grudgingly.
definition_zh: 在先是否认或抗拒某事之后，承认该事属实、合乎逻辑等
example_zh: + 她不情愿地承认道：“还不错。”

definition: to form an idea, a plan, etc. in your mind
example: He conceived the idea of transforming the old power station into an arts centre.
definition_zh: 在脑海中形成一个想法、一个计划等
example_zh: 他构思了将这座旧发电站改造成艺术中心的想法。

definition: to give all your attention to something and not think about anything else
example: I can't concentrate with all that noise going on.
definition_zh: 全神贯注于某事，不考虑其他任何事情
example_zh: 周围这么吵，我根本无法集中注意力。

definition: the ability to direct all your effort and attention on one thing, without thinking of other things
example: This book requires a great deal of concentration.
definition_zh: 能够将全部精力和注意力都集中在某件事上，而不去想其他事情
example_zh: 读这本书需要高度的专注力。

definition: an idea or a principle that is connected with something abstract
example: concept of something, the concept of social class
definition_zh: 与某种抽象事物相关的概念或原则
example_zh: 某事物的概念，社会阶级的概念

definition: an understanding or a belief of what something/somebody is or what something/somebody should be
example: conception of something, Marx’s conception of social justice
definition_zh: 对某事或某人是什么，或者某事或某人应该是什么的理解或信念
example_zh: 对某事的理解，马克思对社会正义的理解

definition: a feeling of worry, especially one that is shared by many people
example: concern about something/somebody, Villagers expressed concern about the level of traffic.
definition_zh: 一种担忧的情绪，尤其是许多人共同怀有的那种情绪
example_zh: 对某事/某人的担忧，村民们对交通流量表示了担忧。

definition: to affect somebody/something; to involve somebody/something
example: Don't interfere in what doesn't concern you.
definition_zh: 影响某人/某事；涉及某人/某事
example_zh: 别管不关你的事。

definition: worried and feeling concern about something/somebody
example: Concerned citizens can have a huge impact.
definition_zh: 为某事或某人感到担忧和挂心
example_zh: 有责任心的公民可以产生巨大的影响。

definition: a public performance of music
example: to attend/go to a concert
definition_zh: 音乐公开演出
example_zh: 参加/去听一场音乐会

definition: something that you allow or do, or allow somebody to have, in order to end an argument or to make a situation less difficult
example: The firm will be forced to make concessions if it wants to avoid a strike.
definition_zh: 为了结束争论或缓解局势而允许或做某事，或者允许某人拥有某物
example_zh: 如果该公司想避免罢工，就不得不做出让步。

definition: to decide or believe something as a result of what you have heard or seen
example: conclude something, It is too early for us to conclude anything.
definition_zh: 根据所听或所见的内容，对某事做出决定或形成看法
example_zh: 得出某种结论，现在下结论还为时过早。

definition: something that you decide when you have thought about all the information connected with the situation
example: We can safely draw some conclusions from our discussion.
definition_zh: 这是你在仔细考虑了与该情况相关的所有信息后所做出的决定
example_zh: 我们可以从我们的讨论中得出一些可靠的结论。

definition: made of concrete
example: a concrete floor
definition_zh: 由混凝土制成
example_zh: 混凝土地板

definition: building material that is made by mixing together cement, sand, small stones and water
example: a slab of concrete
definition_zh: 一种由水泥、沙子、小石子和水混合制成的建筑材料
example_zh: 一块混凝土板

definition: to say very strongly that you think something is bad, usually for moral reasons
example: condemn somebody/something, The government issued a statement condemning the killings.
definition_zh: 非常强烈地表达你认为某件事很糟糕，通常是出于道德上的原因
example_zh: 谴责某人/某事，政府发表声明谴责了这些杀戮行为。

definition: the state that something is in
example: in… condition, to be in pristine/excellent/perfect condition
definition_zh: 某物所处的状态
example_zh: 处于……状态，处于崭新/极佳/完美状态

definition: a person’s behaviour in a particular place or in a particular situation
example: The sport has a strict code of conduct.
definition_zh: 一个人在特定场所或特定情境下的行为
example_zh: 这项运动有一套严格的行为准则。

definition: to organize and/or do a particular activity
example: to conduct an experiment/inquiry/investigation/interview
definition_zh: 组织和/或开展某项活动
example_zh: 进行一项实验/探究/调查/访谈

definition: to discuss something with somebody, in order to exchange opinions or get advice
example: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.
definition_zh: 与某人讨论某事，以便交换意见或征求建议
example_zh: 他想在做出决定之前先和同事们商量一下。

definition: a large official meeting, usually lasting for a few days, at which people with the same work or interests come together to discuss their views
example: The hotel is used for exhibitions, conferences and social events.
definition_zh: 一场大型官方会议，通常持续几天，与会者因从事相同工作或拥有共同兴趣而齐聚一堂，交流各自的观点
example_zh: 该酒店用于举办展览、会议和社交活动。

definition: to admit, especially formally or to the police, that you have done something wrong or illegal
example: After hours of questioning, the suspect confessed.
definition_zh: 承认，尤其是正式地或向警方承认，自己做错了事或做了违法的事
example_zh: 经过数小时的审讯，嫌疑人供认不讳。

definition: a statement that a person makes, admitting that they are guilty of a crime; the act of making such a statement
example: After hours of questioning by police, she made a full confession.
definition_zh: 一个人承认自己犯有某项罪行的陈述；作出此类陈述的行为
example_zh: 经过警方数小时的讯问，她供认不讳。

definition: the feeling that you can trust, believe in and be sure about the abilities or good qualities of somebody/something
example: The president's actions hardly inspire confidence.
definition_zh: 一种能够信任、相信并确信某人或某事的能力或优点的感觉
example_zh: 总统的所作所为很难让人产生信心。

definition: feeling sure about your own ability to do things and be successful
example: She was in a relaxed, confident mood.
definition_zh: 对自己做事和取得成功的能力充满信心
example_zh: 她当时心情轻松，充满自信。

definition: an arrangement of the parts of something or a group of things; the form or shape that this arrangement produces
example: configuration of something, The design is based on four configurations of squares.
definition_zh: 某物或一组事物各部分的排列方式；这种排列所形成的形态或形状
example_zh: 某物的配置，该设计基于四种正方形配置。

definition: to keep somebody/something inside the limits of a particular activity, subject, area, etc.
example: be confined to (doing) something, The work will not be confined to the Glasgow area.
definition_zh: 使某人或某物局限于某项特定活动、主题、领域等范围内。
example_zh: 仅限于（做）某事，这项工作不会仅限于格拉斯哥地区。

definition: to state or show that something is definitely true or correct, especially by providing evidence
example: confirm something, His guilty expression confirmed my suspicions.
definition_zh: 指明或表明某事肯定是真实的或正确的，尤其是通过提供证据来证明
example_zh: 证实某事，他那副心虚的神情证实了我的怀疑。

definition: a statement, letter, etc. that shows that something is true, correct or definite
example: I'm still waiting for confirmation of the test results.
definition_zh: 一种声明、信函等，用以证明某事属实、正确或确定无疑
example_zh: 我还在等待检测结果的确认。

definition: a situation in which people, groups or countries disagree strongly or are involved in a serious argument
example: The violence was the result of political conflicts.
definition_zh: 一种情况，即个人、群体或国家之间存在严重分歧或卷入激烈争论
example_zh: 这场暴力事件是政治冲突造成的。

definition: if two ideas, beliefs, stories, etc. conflict, it is not possible for them to exist together or for them both to be true
example: Reports conflicted on how much of the aid was reaching the famine victims.
definition_zh: 如果两个想法、信念、故事等相互冲突，它们就不可能同时存在，也不可能同时为真。
example_zh: 关于有多少援助物资真正送达饥荒受害者手中，各方报道说法不一。

definition: to appear and need to be dealt with by somebody
example: What is to be done about the economic problems confronting the country?
definition_zh: 出现并需要由某人处理
example_zh: 面对国家当前面临的经济问题，该如何应对？

definition: a situation in which there is anger between people or groups who disagree because they have different opinions
example: confrontation (with somebody), She wanted to avoid another confrontation with her father.
definition_zh: 指因意见不同而产生分歧的人或群体之间存在愤怒的情形
example_zh: 冲突（与某人），她想避免再次与父亲发生冲突。

definition: to make somebody unable to think clearly or understand something
example: confuse somebody, These two sets of statistics are guaranteed to confuse the public.
definition_zh: 使某人无法清晰思考或理解某事
example_zh: 让某人感到困惑，这两组统计数据肯定会让公众感到困惑。

definition: unable to think clearly or to understand what is happening or what somebody is saying
example: I'm confused—say all that again.
definition_zh: 无法清晰思考，也无法理解正在发生的事情或他人所说的话
example_zh: 我有点搞不懂——请把刚才那番话再说一遍。

definition: difficult to understand; not clear
example: The instructions on the box are very confusing.
definition_zh: 难以理解；不明确
example_zh: 包装盒上的说明非常令人困惑。

definition: a state of not being certain about what is happening, what you should do, what something means, etc.
example: The announcement caused a lot of confusion.
definition_zh: 一种对正在发生的事情、自己该怎么做、某件事的含义等感到不确定的状态。
example_zh: 这一公告引起了很大的混乱。

definition: to tell somebody that you are pleased about their success or achievements
example: I congratulated them all on their results.
definition_zh: 向某人表达你对其成功或成就的欣喜之情
example_zh: 我祝贺了他们所有人取得的成绩。

definition: a group of people who are gathered together in a church for a religious service, not including the priest and choir
example: The congregation stood to sing the hymn.
definition_zh: 聚集在教堂里参加宗教仪式的一群人，不包括神父和唱诗班
example_zh: 会众起立唱赞美诗。

definition: related to or belonging to a congress or the Congress in the US
example: a congressional committee/bill
definition_zh: 与美国国会或国会有关的，或隶属于美国国会的
example_zh: 国会委员会/法案

definition: to join together two or more things; to be joined together
example: connect A and B, The towns are connected by train and bus services.
definition_zh: 将两件或更多事物连接在一起；被连接在一起
example_zh: 连接A和B，这两个城镇之间有火车和公交车往来。

definition: (of two or more things or people) having a link between them
example: We do not believe that the incidents are connected.
definition_zh: （指两件或两类事物或两人或两人以上）之间存在某种联系
example_zh: 我们认为这些事件之间没有关联。

definition: something that connects two facts, ideas, etc.
example: connection between A and B, Scientists have established a connection between cholesterol levels and heart disease.
definition_zh: 将两个事实、观点等联系起来的东西。
example_zh: A与B之间的联系，科学家们已经证实了胆固醇水平与心脏病之间的联系。

definition: to take control of a country or city and its people by force
example: The Normans conquered England in 1066.
definition_zh: 以武力夺取一个国家或城市及其人民的控制权
example_zh: 1066年，诺曼人征服了英格兰。

definition: the part of your mind that tells you whether your actions are right or wrong
example: to have a clear/guilty conscience (= to feel that you have done right/wrong)
definition_zh: 你内心那个告诉你自己的行为是对是错的部分
example_zh: 良心安宁/良心不安（= 觉得自己做对了/做错了）

definition: aware of something; noticing something
example: conscious of something, She's very conscious of the problems involved.
definition_zh: 意识到某事；注意到某事
example_zh: 意识到某事，她非常清楚其中涉及的问题。

definition: the state of being able to use your senses and mental powers to understand what is happening
example: I can't remember any more—I must have lost consciousness.
definition_zh: 能够运用感官和思维能力来理解正在发生的事情的状态
example_zh: 我已经记不起来了——我当时肯定昏了过去。

definition: following one after another in a continuous series
example: She was absent for nine consecutive days.
definition_zh: 接二连三地出现，形成一个连续的系列
example_zh: 她连续缺勤了九天。

definition: an opinion that all members of a group agree with
example: consensus (about/on something), She is skilled at achieving consensus on sensitive issues.
definition_zh: 该群体所有成员都赞同的一种观点
example_zh: （关于某事的）共识，她擅长在敏感问题上达成共识。

definition: permission to do something, especially given by somebody in authority
example: The written consent of a parent is required.
definition_zh: 做某事的许可，尤其是由有权人士授予的许可
example_zh: 必须征得家长的书面同意。

definition: to agree to something or give your permission for something
example: When she told them what she intended, they readily consented.
definition_zh: 同意某事或批准某事
example_zh: 当她向他们说明了自己的打算后，他们欣然同意了。

definition: a result of something that has happened, especially an unpleasant result
example: Remember that actions have consequences.
definition_zh: 某件事发生后的结果，尤其是令人不快的结果
example_zh: 请记住，行动会带来后果。

definition: as a result; therefore
example: This poses a threat to agriculture and the food chain, and consequently to human health.
definition_zh: 因此；所以
example_zh: 这给农业和食品链带来了威胁，进而也威胁到人类健康。

definition: the protection of the natural environment
example: to be interested in wildlife conservation
definition_zh: 自然环境的保护
example_zh: 对野生动物保护感兴趣

definition: opposed to great or sudden social change; showing that you prefer traditional styles and values
example: the conservative views of his parents
definition_zh: 反对重大或突如其来的社会变革；表现出对传统风格和价值观的偏好
example_zh: 他父母的保守观点

definition: a conservative person
example: social/religious conservatives
definition_zh: 一个保守的人
example_zh: 社会/宗教保守派

definition: to protect something and prevent it from being changed or destroyed
example: new laws to conserve wildlife in the area
definition_zh: 保护某物，防止其被更改或破坏
example_zh: 旨在保护该地区野生动物的新法律

definition: to think about something carefully, especially in order to make a decision
example: I'd like some time to consider.
definition_zh: 仔细思考某事，尤其是为了做出决定
example_zh: 我想花点时间考虑一下。

definition: great in amount, size, importance, etc.
example: The project wasted a considerable amount of time and money.
definition_zh: 在数量、规模、重要性等方面都很出色。
example_zh: 该项目浪费了大量的时间和金钱。

definition: much; a lot
example: The need for sleep varies considerably from person to person.
definition_zh: 很多；相当多
example_zh: 不同人的睡眠需求差异很大。

definition: the act of thinking carefully about something
example: An employer is legally bound to give due consideration to the request.
definition_zh: 对某事进行仔细思考的行为
example_zh: 雇主在法律上有义务对该请求予以适当考虑。

definition: to be made up of particular parts or things
example: The team consists of ten members.
definition_zh: 由特定的部分或事物组成
example_zh: 该团队共有十名成员。

definition: the quality of always behaving in the same way or of having the same opinions, standard, etc.; the quality of being consistent
example: She has played with great consistency all season.
definition_zh: 总是以同样的方式行事，或持有相同的观点、标准等的特质；保持一致的特质
example_zh: 整个赛季以来，她的表现一直非常稳定。

definition: always behaving in the same way, or having the same opinions, standards, etc.
example: a consistent approach to the problem
definition_zh: 总是以同样的方式行事，或者持有相同的观点、标准等。
example_zh: 对该问题采取一致的做法

definition: always the same
example: Her work has been of a consistently high standard.
definition_zh: 总是那样
example_zh: 她的工作一直保持着很高的水准。

definition: to make a position of power or success stronger so that it is more likely to continue
example: With this new movie he has consolidated his position as the country's leading director.
definition_zh: 使一种权力或成功的地位更加稳固，从而使其更有可能持续下去
example_zh: 凭借这部新片，他巩固了自己作为该国顶尖导演的地位。

definition: a secret plan by a group of people to do something harmful or illegal
example: conspiracy (to do something), a conspiracy to overthrow the government
definition_zh: 一群人为了实施某种有害或非法的行为而制定的秘密计划
example_zh: 阴谋（做某事），推翻政府的阴谋

definition: happening all the time or repeatedly
example: There were constant interruptions.
definition_zh: 时常发生或反复发生
example_zh: 过程中不断有人打断。

definition: all the time; repeatedly
example: Fashion is constantly changing.
definition_zh: 一直；反复
example_zh: 时尚在不断变化。

definition: a district that elects its own representative to parliament
example: Unemployment is high in her constituency.
definition_zh: 一个可选举本选区议会代表的选区
example_zh: 她所在选区的失业率很高。

definition: to be considered to be something
example: Does such an activity constitute a criminal offence?
definition_zh: 被视为某种东西
example_zh: 此类行为是否构成刑事犯罪？

definition: the system of laws and basic principles that a state, a country or an organization is governed by
example: your right to vote under the constitution
definition_zh: 一个国家、一个地区或一个组织所遵循的法律体系和基本原则
example_zh: 宪法赋予你的投票权

definition: connected with or allowed by the constitution of a country
example: Freedom of speech is a constitutional right.
definition_zh: 与某国宪法有关或经该国宪法允许的
example_zh: 言论自由是一项宪法赋予的权利。

definition: a thing that limits something, or limits your freedom to do something
example: constraints of time/money/space
definition_zh: 一种限制某事，或限制你做某事自由的东西
example_zh: 时间、资金和空间的限制

definition: to build or make something such as a road, building or machine
example: construct something, The building was constructed in 1993.
definition_zh: 建造或制造某物，例如道路、建筑物或机器
example_zh: 建造某物，该建筑建于1993年。

definition: the process or method of building or making something, especially roads, buildings, bridges, etc.
example: Construction began this year and will take approximately 18 months.
definition_zh: 建造或制作某物（尤其是道路、建筑物、桥梁等）的过程或方法。
example_zh: 工程已于今年动工，预计工期约为18个月。

definition: to go to somebody for information or advice
example: consult somebody, If the pain continues, consult your doctor.
definition_zh: 向某人寻求信息或建议
example_zh: 请咨询他人；如果疼痛持续，请咨询医生。

definition: a person who knows a lot about a particular subject and is employed to give advice about it to other people
example: a technology/design consultant
definition_zh: 对某个特定领域知识渊博，并受雇向他人提供相关建议的人
example_zh: 一名技术/设计顾问

definition: the act of discussing something with somebody or with a group of people before making a decision about it
example: a consultation document/paper/period/process
definition_zh: 在就某事做出决定之前，与某人或一群人进行讨论的行为
example_zh: 咨询文件/报告/期间/流程

definition: to use something, especially fuel, energy or time
example: The electricity industry consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.
definition_zh: 消耗某物，尤其是燃料、能源或时间
example_zh: 电力行业消耗了大量化石燃料。

definition: a person who buys goods or uses services
example: consumer spending/demand
definition_zh: 购买商品或使用服务的人
example_zh: 消费者支出/需求

definition: the act of using energy, food or materials; the amount used
example: the production of fuel for domestic consumption (= to be used in the country where it is produced)
definition_zh: 使用能源、食物或材料的行为；使用量
example_zh: 用于国内消费（即在生产国境内使用）的燃料生产

definition: the act of communicating with somebody, especially regularly
example: contact with somebody, I don't have much contact with my uncle.
definition_zh: 与某人进行交流的行为，尤其是定期交流
example_zh: 与某人保持联系，我跟我叔叔联系并不多。

definition: to communicate with somebody, for example by phone, letter or email
example: I've been trying to contact you all day.
definition_zh: 与某人沟通，例如通过电话、信件或电子邮件
example_zh: 我今天一整天都在试着联系你。

definition: if something contains something else, it has that thing inside it or as part of it
example: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.
definition_zh: 如果某物包含另一物，则该物位于其中，或作为其组成部分
example_zh: 这种饮料不含任何酒精。

definition: a box, bottle, etc. in which something can be stored or transported
example: a plastic container
definition_zh: 用于存放或运输某物的盒子、瓶子等
example_zh: 一个塑料容器

definition: to think about whether you should do something, or how you should do something
example: contemplate something, You're too young to be contemplating retirement.
definition_zh: 思考是否应该做某事，或者应该如何做某事
example_zh: 思考某件事，你还太年轻，不该考虑退休了。

definition: belonging to the same time
example: We have no contemporary account of the battle (= written near the time that it happened).
definition_zh: 属于同一时期
example_zh: 我们没有关于这场战役的当代记载（即在事件发生后不久写成的记载）。

definition: the feeling that somebody/something is without value and deserves no respect at all
example: with contempt, She looked at him with contempt.
definition_zh: 认为某人或某物毫无价值，完全不值得尊重的感觉
example_zh: 带着蔑视，她蔑视地看着他。

definition: to say that something is true, especially in an argument
example: I would contend that the minister's thinking is flawed on this point.
definition_zh: 指某事属实，尤其是在争论中
example_zh: 我认为，部长在这点上的想法是有问题的。

definition: a person or team with a chance of winning a competition
example: contender (for something), a contender for a gold medal in the Olympics
definition_zh: 有希望在比赛中获胜的个人或团队
example_zh: （某项赛事的）竞争者，奥运会金牌的有力竞争者

definition: happy and satisfied with what you have
example: He seemed more content, less bitter.
definition_zh: 对现有的生活感到快乐和满足
example_zh: 他看起来更满足了，也少了些苦涩。

definition: the things that are contained in something
example: He tipped the contents of the bag onto the table.
definition_zh: 某物所包含的内容
example_zh: 他把袋子里的东西倒在了桌子上。

definition: anger between people who disagree
example: One area of contention is the availability of nursery care.
definition_zh: 意见相左的人之间的愤怒
example_zh: 一个有争议的问题是托儿服务的可获得性。

definition: a competition in which people try to win something
example: to hold a singing/talent contest
definition_zh: 一种人们试图赢得奖品的比赛
example_zh: 举办一场歌唱/才艺比赛

definition: to take part in a competition, election, etc. and try to win it
example: Three candidates contested the leadership.
definition_zh: 参加比赛、选举等，并力争获胜
example_zh: 共有三名候选人角逐领导职位。

definition: the situation in which something happens and that helps you to understand it
example: Such databases are being used in a wide range of contexts.
definition_zh: 指发生某件事的情况，而这种情况有助于你理解它
example_zh: 此类数据库正被应用于各种场景中。

definition: one of the large land masses of the earth such as Europe, Asia or Africa
example: the continent of Africa
definition_zh: 地球上的大型陆地之一，例如欧洲、亚洲或非洲
example_zh: 非洲大陆

definition: in a way that is repeated many times so that it is annoying
example: They argue continually about money.
definition_zh: 以一种反复出现、令人厌烦的方式
example_zh: 他们总是为钱争吵不休。

definition: to keep existing or happening without stopping
example: If the current trend continues, that number will increase 165 per cent by 2050.
definition_zh: 保持现状或持续进行，不间断
example_zh: 如果目前的趋势持续下去，到2050年，这一数字将增长165%。

definition: happening or existing for a period of time without being interrupted
example: Recovery after the accident will be a continuous process that may take several months.
definition_zh: 在一段时间内持续发生或存在，且未被中断
example_zh: 事故后的恢复将是一个持续的过程，可能需要数月时间。

definition: an official written agreement
example: All employees have a written contract of employment.
definition_zh: 一份正式的书面协议
example_zh: 所有员工都签订了书面劳动合同。

definition: to become less or smaller; to make something become less or smaller
example: Glass contracts as it cools.
definition_zh: 变得更少或更小；使某物变得更少或更小
example_zh: 玻璃在冷却时会收缩。

definition: a person or company that has a contract to do work or provide goods or services for another company
example: a building/roofing/electrical contractor
definition_zh: 与另一家公司签订合同，负责为其进行工作或提供货物或服务的个人或公司
example_zh: 建筑/屋面/电气承包商

definition: a lack of agreement between facts, opinions, actions, etc.
example: contradiction (between A and B), There is a contradiction between the two sets of figures.
definition_zh: 事实、观点、行动等之间缺乏一致性。
example_zh: 矛盾（A与B之间），这两组数据之间存在矛盾。

definition: completely different from or opposed to something
example: Contrary to expectations, the experiment was successful.
definition_zh: 与某事截然不同或截然相反
example_zh: 出乎意料的是，这次实验取得了成功。

definition: the opposite fact, event or situation
example: In the end the contrary was proved true: he was innocent and she was guilty.
definition_zh: 相反的事实、事件或情况
example_zh: 结果证明事实恰恰相反：他是无辜的，而她是罪魁祸首。

definition: a difference between two or more people or things that you can see clearly when they are compared or put close together; the fact of comparing two or more things in order to show the differences between them
example: The two cities make an interesting contrast.
definition_zh: 将两个或多个人和事物进行比较或并列时，能够清晰看到的差异；通过比较两个或多个事物以显示它们之间差异的行为
example_zh: 这两座城市形成了鲜明的对比。

definition: to compare two things in order to show the differences between them
example: contrast A and B, The poem contrasts youth and age.
definition_zh: 将两件事进行比较，以显示它们之间的差异
example_zh: 对比A和B，这首诗将青春与衰老进行了对比。

definition: to give something, especially money or goods, to help achieve or provide something
example: Do you wish to contribute?
definition_zh: 提供某物（尤其是金钱或物品），以帮助实现或提供某事
example_zh: 您想贡献一份力量吗？

definition: a gift or payment that is made to a person or an organization in order to help pay for something
example: All contributions will be gratefully received.
definition_zh: 为帮助支付某项费用而给予个人或组织的赠礼或款项
example_zh: 我们将衷心感谢所有捐款。

definition: a person who writes articles for a magazine, book or website, or who talks on a radio or television programme or at a meeting
example: a regular contributor to this magazine
definition_zh: 为杂志、书籍或网站撰写文章，或在广播、电视节目或会议上发言的人
example_zh: 本杂志的常驻撰稿人

definition: the power to make decisions about how a country, an area, an organization, etc. is run
example: control of somebody/something, The party expects to gain control of the council in the next election.
definition_zh: 对一个国家、一个地区、一个组织等的运作方式作出决策的权力
example_zh: 对某人/某事的控制权，该党预计将在下次选举中赢得市议会的控制权。

definition: to have power over a person, company, country, etc. so that you are able to decide what they must do or how it is run
example: By the age of 21 he controlled the company.
definition_zh: 对某人、某公司、某国等拥有控制权，从而能够决定他们必须做什么或如何运作
example_zh: 21岁时，他已掌控了这家公司。

definition: causing a lot of angry public discussion and disagreement
example: a highly controversial topic
definition_zh: 引发了大量愤怒的公众讨论和争议
example_zh: 一个极具争议的话题

definition: public discussion and argument about something that many people strongly disagree about, think is bad, or are shocked by
example: to arouse/cause controversy
definition_zh: 关于某件事的公开讨论和争论，而这件事让许多人持强烈反对意见、认为其不好，或感到震惊
example_zh: 引发/引起争议

definition: the quality of being useful, easy or suitable for somebody
example: We have provided seats for the convenience of our customers.
definition_zh: 对某人而言有用、容易或合适的特性
example_zh: 为了方便顾客，我们提供了座位。

definition: useful, easy or quick to do; not causing problems
example: Fruit is a convenient source of vitamins and energy.
definition_zh: 有用的、容易或快捷的；不会造成麻烦的
example_zh: 水果是获取维生素和能量的便捷来源。

definition: the way in which something is done that most people in a society expect and consider to be polite or the right way to do it
example: the rigid social conventions of Victorian Britain
definition_zh: 社会中大多数人所期待并认为符合礼仪或正确的做事方式
example_zh: 维多利亚时代英国僵化的社会习俗

definition: tending to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general; normal and ordinary, and perhaps not very interesting
example: conventional behaviour/morality
definition_zh: 倾向于遵循社会普遍的做法或被社会普遍认为可接受的行为；正常且普通，或许并不太有趣
example_zh: 传统行为/道德

definition: an informal talk involving a small group of people or only two; the activity of talking in this way
example: a phone conversation
definition_zh: 指一小群人或仅两人之间进行的非正式交谈；这种交谈活动
example_zh: 一次电话交谈

definition: the act or process of changing something from one form, use or system to another
example: Their main business is the conversion of farm buildings into family homes.
definition_zh: 将某物从一种形式、用途或体系转变为另一种形式、用途或体系的行为或过程
example_zh: 他们的主要业务是将农舍改建为家庭住宅。

definition: to change or make something change from one form, purpose, system, etc. to another
example: convert something, They took just nine months to convert the building.
definition_zh: 使某物从一种形式、目的、体系等转变为另一种形式、目的、体系等，或促使这种转变发生
example_zh: 改造某物，他们仅用九个月就完成了这栋建筑的改造。

definition: to make ideas, feelings, etc. known to somebody
example: convey something, Colours like red convey a sense of energy and strength.
definition_zh: 向某人表达想法、感受等
example_zh: 传达某种含义，像红色这样的颜色能传达出一种活力与力量的感觉。

definition: to decide and state officially in court that somebody is guilty of a crime
example: be convicted (of something), He was convicted of fraud.
definition_zh: 在法庭上裁定并正式宣布某人犯有某项罪行
example_zh: 被判有罪（某事），他因欺诈罪被判有罪。

definition: the act of finding somebody guilty of a crime in court; the fact of having been found guilty
example: He plans to appeal against his conviction.
definition_zh: 在法庭上判定某人犯有罪行的行为；已被判定有罪的事实
example_zh: 他计划对这一判决提出上诉。

definition: to make somebody/yourself believe that something is true
example: convince somebody/yourself, Are the prime minister's assurances enough to convince the public?
definition_zh: 让某人/自己相信某事是真实的
example_zh: 说服某人/自己，总理的保证是否足以说服公众？

definition: completely sure about something
example: Sam nodded but he didn't look convinced.
definition_zh: 对某事完全确信
example_zh: 萨姆点了点头，但看起来并不信服。

definition: that makes somebody believe that something is true
example: a convincing argument/explanation/case
definition_zh: 这会让某人相信某件事是真实的
example_zh: 有力的论点/解释/论据

definition: a person who cooks food or whose job is cooking
example: John is a very good cook (= he cooks well).
definition_zh: 做饭的人，或以烹饪为职业的人
example_zh: 约翰是个非常棒的厨师（=他厨艺很好）。

definition: to prepare food by heating it, for example by boiling, baking or frying it
example: Where did you learn to cook?
definition_zh: 通过加热来烹饪食物，例如煮、烤或炸
example_zh: 你是在哪里学会做饭的？

definition: a large piece of equipment for cooking food, containing an oven and gas or electric rings on top
example: a gas cooker
definition_zh: 一种用于烹饪食物的大型设备，内部设有烤箱，顶部配有燃气灶或电炉
example_zh: 一台燃气灶

definition: the process of preparing food by heating it
example: My husband does all the cooking.
definition_zh: 通过加热来制作食物的过程
example_zh: 做饭全由我丈夫负责。

definition: fairly cold; not hot or warm
example: cool air/water
definition_zh: 相当冷；既不热也不暖和
example_zh: 冷空气/水

definition: to become cool or cooler; to make somebody/something become cool or cooler
example: Glass contracts as it cools.
definition_zh: 变得酷或更酷；让某人/某物变得酷或更酷
example_zh: 玻璃在冷却时会收缩。

definition: to work together with somebody else in order to achieve something
example: The two groups agreed to cooperate with each other.
definition_zh: 与他人通力合作，以实现某项目标
example_zh: 双方同意相互合作。

definition: involving doing something together or working together with others towards a shared aim
example: Cooperative activity is essential to effective community work.
definition_zh: 指与他人共同做某事，或与他人通力合作以实现共同目标
example_zh: 合作活动是开展有效社区工作不可或缺的。

definition: to organize the different parts of an activity and the people involved in it so that it works well
example: coordinate something, They appointed a new manager to coordinate the work of the team.
definition_zh: 对一项活动的各个环节及参与人员进行统筹安排，以确保活动顺利进行
example_zh: 协调某事，他们任命了一位新经理来协调团队的工作。

definition: the act of making parts of something, groups of people, etc. work together in an efficient and organized way
example: The aim was to improve the coordination of services.
definition_zh: 使某事物的各个部分、人群等以高效且有条理的方式协同运作的行为
example_zh: 其目的是为了加强各项服务的协调。

definition: a person who organizes the different parts of an activity and the people involved in it so that it works well
example: The campaign needs an effective coordinator.
definition_zh: 负责统筹协调某项活动的各个环节及参与人员，以确保活动顺利进行的人
example_zh: 这项活动需要一位高效的协调员。

definition: a police officer
example: Somebody call the cops!
definition_zh: 一名警察
example_zh: 快叫警察来！

definition: to deal successfully with something difficult
example: I got to the stage where I wasn't coping any more.
definition_zh: 成功应对某件困难的事
example_zh: 我到了再也无法应对的地步。

definition: a chemical element. Copper is a soft red-brown metal used for making electric wires, pipes and coins.
example: a copper mine
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。铜是一种柔软的红褐色金属，用于制造电线、管道和硬币。
example_zh: 一座铜矿

definition: a thing that is made to be the same as something else, especially a document or a work of art
example: The thieves replaced the original painting with a copy.
definition_zh: 为了与某物（尤其是文件或艺术作品）保持一致而制作的东西
example_zh: 窃贼将原作换成了一幅复制品。

definition: to make something that is exactly like something else
example: copy something, He taught himself by copying paintings in the Louvre.
definition_zh: 制作出与某物完全一样的东西
example_zh: 临摹作品，他通过临摹卢浮宫的画作自学成才。

definition: if a person or an organization holds the copyright on a piece of writing, music, etc., they are the only people who have the legal right to publish, broadcast, perform it, etc., and other people must ask their permission to use it or any part of it
example: Copyright expires seventy years after the death of the author.
definition_zh: 如果某个人或某个组织拥有某篇文学作品、音乐作品等的著作权，那么只有他们才拥有出版、广播、表演等作品的合法权利，其他人若要使用该作品或其任何部分，必须征得他们的许可。
example_zh: 著作权在作者去世后七十年届满。

definition: most important; main or essential
example: core subjects (= subjects that all the students have to study) such as English and mathematics
definition_zh: 最重要的；主要的或必不可少的
example_zh: 核心科目（即所有学生都必须学习的科目），例如英语和数学

definition: the most important or central part of something
example: This report goes to the core of the argument.
definition_zh: 某事物的最重要或核心部分
example_zh: 这份报告切中了论点的核心。

definition: a part of something where two or more sides, lines or edges join
example: the four corners of a square
definition_zh: 由两个或多个面、线或边相交而成的部分
example_zh: 正方形的四个角

definition: connected with a large business company
example: corporate finance/profits/tax
definition_zh: 与一家大型企业有关
example_zh: 公司财务/利润/税收

definition: a large business company
example: multinational corporations
definition_zh: 一家大型企业
example_zh: 跨国公司

definition: accurate or true, without any mistakes
example: Do you have the correct time?
definition_zh: 准确或真实，没有任何错误
example_zh: 你现在的时间对吗？

definition: to make something right or accurate, for example by changing it or removing mistakes
example: correct something, to correct an error
definition_zh: 使某事正确或准确，例如通过修改或纠正错误来实现
example_zh: 更正某事，纠正错误

definition: a change that makes something more accurate than it was before
example: I've made a few small corrections to your report.
definition_zh: 一项使某事物比以前更准确的改变
example_zh: 我对你的报告做了一些小修改。

definition: in a way that is accurate or true, without any mistakes
example: Have you spelled it correctly?
definition_zh: 以准确或真实的方式，没有任何错误
example_zh: 你拼写对了吗？

definition: if two or more facts, figures, etc. correlate or if a fact, figure, etc. correlates with another, the facts are closely connected and affect or depend on each other
example: The figures do not seem to correlate.
definition_zh: 如果两个或多个事实、数据等之间存在关联，或者某个事实、数据等与另一个存在关联，则这些事实之间密切相关，并相互影响或相互依存。
example_zh: 这些数据似乎没有关联。

definition: a connection between two things in which one thing changes as the other does
example: correlation between A and B, There is a direct correlation between exposure to sun and skin cancer.
definition_zh: 两件事物之间的联系，其中一件事物随着另一件事物的变化而变化
example_zh: A与B之间的关联，日晒与皮肤癌之间存在直接关联。

definition: to be the same as or match something
example: Your account and hers do not correspond.
definition_zh: 与某物相同或一致
example_zh: 您的账户与她的账户不匹配。

definition: the letters, emails, etc. a person sends and receives
example: personal/private correspondence
definition_zh: 一个人收发的信件、电子邮件等
example_zh: 个人/私人信件

definition: a person who reports news from a particular country or on a particular subject for a newspaper or a television or radio station
example: She's the BBC's political correspondent.
definition_zh: 为报纸、电视台或广播电台报道某国新闻或特定主题的人
example_zh: 她是英国广播公司（BBC）的政治记者。

definition: matching or connected with something that you have just mentioned
example: A change in the money supply brings a corresponding change in expenditure.
definition_zh: 与你刚才提到的某件事相符或相关
example_zh: 货币供应量的变化会带来相应的支出变化。

definition: a long narrow passage in a building, with doors that open into rooms on either side
example: His room is along the corridor.
definition_zh: 建筑物内一条狭长的小通道，两侧的门通向不同的房间
example_zh: 他的房间就在走廊那头。

definition: willing to use their power to do dishonest or illegal things in return for money or to get an advantage
example: It was seen as the only way to overthrow a corrupt regime.
definition_zh: 愿意利用自己的权力做不诚实或非法的事情，以换取金钱或谋取私利
example_zh: 这被视为推翻腐败政权的唯一途径。

definition: dishonest or illegal behaviour, especially of people in authority
