definition: to make an action or a process possible or easier
example: The new trade agreement should facilitate more rapid economic growth.
definition_zh: 使某项行动或过程成为可能或更轻松
example_zh: 新的贸易协定应有助于推动更快速的经济增长。

definition: buildings, services, equipment, etc. that are provided for a particular purpose
example: leisure/sports facilities
definition_zh: 为特定目的而提供的建筑物、服务、设备等
example_zh: 休闲/体育设施

definition: a thing that is known to be true, especially when it can be proved
example: fact about something, First, some basic facts about healthy eating.
definition_zh: 已知为真的事情，尤其是能够被证明的事情
example_zh: 关于某事的知识，首先，关于健康饮食的一些基本知识。

definition: a small group of people within a larger one, whose members have some different aims and beliefs to those of the larger group
example: There are rival factions within the administration.
definition_zh: 一个较大群体内部的一个小群体，其成员的目标和信仰与该较大群体的成员有所不同
example_zh: 政府内部存在派系之争。

definition: one of several things that cause or influence something
example: Obesity is a major risk factor for heart disease.
definition_zh: 导致或影响某事的若干因素之一
example_zh: 肥胖是心脏病的主要危险因素。

definition: a building or group of buildings where goods are made, mainly by machine
example: a car factory
definition_zh: 一座或一组用于制造商品的建筑物，主要依靠机器进行生产
example_zh: 一家汽车厂

definition: a department or group of related departments in a college or university
example: the Faculty of Law
definition_zh: 一所学院或大学中的一个系或一组相关系
example_zh: 法学院

definition: to become or to make something become paler or less bright
example: The curtains had faded in the sun.
definition_zh: 变得或使某物变得更淡或不那么明亮
example_zh: 窗帘在阳光下褪了色。

definition: to not be successful in achieving something
example: Many diets fail because they are boring.
definition_zh: 未能成功实现某事
example_zh: 许多减肥方法之所以失败，是因为它们太乏味了。

definition: not successful
example: a failed writer
definition_zh: 未成功
example_zh: 一个失败的作家

definition: lack of success in doing or achieving something
example: The success or failure of the plan depends on you.
definition_zh: 在做某事或实现某事方面未能成功
example_zh: 该计划的成败取决于你。

definition: acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation
example: a fair deal/wage/price
definition_zh: 在特定情况下是可以接受且合适的
example_zh: 公平的交易/工资/价格

definition: to some extent but not very
example: fairly simple/easy/straightforward
definition_zh: 在某种程度上，但并不太……
example_zh: 相当简单/容易/直截了当

definition: the quality of treating people equally or in a way that is reasonable
example: The fairness of the judicial system is being questioned.
definition_zh: 平等对待他人或以合理方式对待他人的品质
example_zh: 司法体系的公正性正受到质疑。

definition: trust in somebody’s ability or knowledge; trust that somebody/something will do what has been promised
example: If the company can retain its customers' faith, it could become the market leader.
definition_zh: 相信某人的能力或知识；相信某人或某物会兑现承诺
example_zh: 如果该公司能保持客户的信任，就有可能成为市场领导者。

definition: not what somebody claims it is; appearing to be something it is not
example: There were a few stalls selling fake designer clothing.
definition_zh: 并非某人所声称的那样；表面上看起来并非其真实面目
example_zh: 有几个摊位在卖假名牌服装。

definition: an act of falling
example: I had a bad fall and broke my arm.
definition_zh: 一次坠落
example_zh: 我不小心摔了一跤，把胳膊摔断了。

definition: to drop down from a higher level to a lower level
example: The rain was falling steadily.
definition_zh: 从较高层次降至较低层次
example_zh: 雨下得绵绵不断。

definition: wrong; not correct or true
example: A whale is a fish. True or false?
definition_zh: 错误；不正确或不真实
example_zh: 鲸鱼是一种鱼。对还是错？

definition: the state of being known and talked about by many people
example: to achieve/win instant fame
definition_zh: 被许多人所熟知和谈论的状态
example_zh: 一举成名

definition: well known to you; often seen or heard and therefore easy to recognize
example: to look/sound/seem familiar
definition_zh: 你很熟悉；经常看到或听到，因此很容易辨认
example_zh: 看起来/听起来/感觉很熟悉

definition: connected with the family or a particular family
example: family life
definition_zh: 与该家庭或某个特定家庭有关
example_zh: 家庭生活

definition: a group consisting of one or two parents and their children
example: I introduced Neil to the other members of my family.
definition_zh: 由一名或两名父母及其子女组成的一组人
example_zh: 我把尼尔介绍给了家里的其他成员。

definition: known about by many people
example: a famous artist/actor
definition_zh: 为许多人所知
example_zh: 一位著名的艺术家/演员

definition: a person who admires somebody/something or enjoys watching or listening to somebody/something very much
example: sports/music fans
definition_zh: 非常欣赏某人/某事，或非常喜欢观看或聆听某人/某事的人
example_zh: 体育/音乐爱好者

definition: unusually complicated, often in an unnecessary way; intended to impress other people
example: a kitchen full of fancy gadgets
definition_zh: 异常复杂，往往毫无必要；意在给他人留下深刻印象
example_zh: 一个摆满各种新奇厨具的厨房

definition: to want something or want to do something
example: fancy something, Fancy a drink?
definition_zh: 想要某样东西或想做某事
example_zh: 想吃点什么吗？想喝点什么吗？

definition: extremely good; excellent
example: He's done a fantastic job.
definition_zh: 非常好；极好
example_zh: 他干得非常出色。

definition: a pleasant situation that you imagine but that is unlikely to happen
example: He spoke of his childhood fantasies about becoming a famous football player.
definition_zh: 一种你想象中的美好情景，但不太可能发生
example_zh: 他谈到了自己儿时梦想成为一名著名足球运动员的幻想。

definition: at a greater distance away from you
example: I saw her on the far side of the road.
definition_zh: 离你更远一些
example_zh: 我在马路对面看到了她。

definition: a long distance away
example: We didn't go far.
definition_zh: 很远的地方
example_zh: 我们没走多远。

definition: the money that you pay to travel by bus, plane, taxi, etc.
example: bus/taxi fares
definition_zh: 乘坐公交车、飞机、出租车等交通工具时支付的费用。
example_zh: 公交车/出租车票价

definition: an area of land, and the buildings on it, used for growing crops and/or keeping animals
example: a 200-hectare farm
definition_zh: 一块土地及其上的建筑物，用于种植农作物和/或饲养牲畜
example_zh: 一座占地200公顷的农场

definition: to use land for growing crops and/or keeping animals
example: The family has farmed in Kent for over two hundred years.
definition_zh: 将土地用于种植农作物和/或饲养牲畜
example_zh: 这个家族在肯特郡务农已有两百多年了。

definition: a person who owns or manages a farm
example: My parents are dairy farmers.
definition_zh: 拥有或经营农场的人
example_zh: 我的父母是奶农。

definition: the business of managing or working on a farm
example: to take up farming
definition_zh: 经营或从事农场工作的业务
example_zh: 开始务农

definition: extremely interesting and attractive
example: a fascinating story
definition_zh: 极其有趣且极具吸引力
example_zh: 一个引人入胜的故事

definition: a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time or place; the state of being popular
example: the latest fashion trends
definition_zh: 在特定时间或地点流行的服装、发型等风格；流行的一种状态
example_zh: 最新时尚潮流

definition: following a style that is popular at a particular time
example: fashionable clothes/ideas/styles
definition_zh: 遵循某个特定时期流行的风格
example_zh: 时尚服饰/创意/风格

definition: moving or able to move quickly
example: a fast car/horse
definition_zh: 正在移动或能够快速移动
example_zh: 一辆跑车/一匹快马

definition: quickly
example: Don't drive so fast!
definition_zh: 很快
example_zh: 别开那么快！

definition: to close or join together the two parts of something; to become closed or joined together
example: fasten something, Fasten your seat belts, please.
definition_zh: 将某物的两部分闭合或连接起来；变得闭合或连接在一起
example_zh: 系好某物，请系好安全带。

definition: having too much flesh on it and weighing too much
example: a big fat man/woman
definition_zh: 肉太多，而且太重了
example_zh: 一个又胖又大的人

definition: a white or yellow substance in the bodies of animals and humans, stored under the skin
example: excess body fat
definition_zh: 动物和人体内的一种白色或黄色物质，储存在皮下
example_zh: 过多的体脂

definition: causing or ending in death
example: a fatal accident/blow/illness
definition_zh: 导致或最终导致死亡
example_zh: 致命事故/打击/疾病

definition: the things, especially bad things, that will happen or have happened to somebody/something
example: The fate of the three men is unknown.
definition_zh: 将要发生或已经发生在某人/某物身上的事情，尤其是坏事
example_zh: 这三名男子的下落不明。

definition: a male parent of a child or an animal; a person who is acting as the father to a child
example: My father died in 2017.
definition_zh: 儿童或动物的父亲；充当某儿童父亲角色的人
example_zh: 我父亲于2017年去世。

definition: the responsibility for something wrong that has happened or been done
example: Why should I say sorry when it's not my fault?
definition_zh: 对已经发生或做错的事情所应承担的责任
example_zh: 这又不是我的错，我为什么要道歉？

definition: a thing that you do to help somebody
example: Could you do me a favour and pick up Sam from school today?
definition_zh: 为了帮助某人而做的一件事
example_zh: 你能帮个忙，今天去学校接一下萨姆吗？

definition: to prefer one system, plan, way of doing something, etc. to another
example: favour something, Many countries favour a presidential system of government.
definition_zh: 更倾向于某一系统、计划、做事方式等，而非另一种
example_zh: 支持某事，许多国家支持总统制。

definition: making people have a good opinion of somebody/something
example: She made a favourable impression on his parents.
definition_zh: 让人们对某人或某事产生好感
example_zh: 她在他的父母面前留下了良好的印象。

definition: liked more than others of the same kind
example: It's one of my favourite movies.
definition_zh: 比同类中的其他作品更受欢迎
example_zh: 这是我最喜欢的电影之一。

definition: a person or thing that you like more than the others of the same type
example: Which one's your favourite?
definition_zh: 指你比同类中的其他对象更喜欢的人或事物
example_zh: 你最喜欢哪一个？

definition: the bad feeling that you have when you are in danger or when a particular thing frightens you
example: Her eyes showed no fear.
definition_zh: 当你身处危险之中，或者被某件事吓到时，那种不祥的感觉
example_zh: 她的眼神里丝毫没有恐惧。

definition: to be frightened of somebody/something or frightened of doing something
example: fear somebody/something, All his employees fear him.
definition_zh: 害怕某人/某事，或害怕做某事
example_zh: 害怕某人/某事，他的所有员工都怕他。

definition: an action or a piece of work that needs skill, strength or courage
example: The tunnel is a remarkable feat of engineering.
definition_zh: 需要技巧、力量或勇气的行动或工作
example_zh: 这条隧道是一项了不起的工程壮举。

definition: one of the many soft light parts covering a bird’s body
example: a peacock feather
definition_zh: 覆盖在鸟类身体上的众多柔软部位之一
example_zh: 一只孔雀羽毛

definition: something important, interesting or typical of a place or thing
example: An interesting feature of the city is the old market.
definition_zh: 某地或某物中具有重要性、趣味性或代表性的东西
example_zh: 这座城市的一个有趣之处是老市场。

definition: to include a particular person or thing as a special feature
example: feature somebody/something as somebody/something, The film features Cary Grant as a professor.
definition_zh: 将某人或某物作为亮点纳入其中
example_zh: 由某人/某物饰演某人/某物，这部电影由加里·格兰特饰演一位教授。

definition: the 2nd month of the year, between January and March
example: She was born in February.
definition_zh: 这一年的第二个月，介于1月和3月之间
example_zh: 她出生于二月。

definition: having a system of government in which the individual states of a country have control over their own affairs, but are controlled by a central government for national decisions, etc.
example: a federal republic
definition_zh: 一种政体，其中一国的各州可自主管理本州事务，但在国家决策等方面受中央政府管辖。
example_zh: 联邦共和国

definition: an amount of money that you pay for professional advice or services
example: Employees are reimbursed for any legal fees incurred when they relocate.
definition_zh: 为获得专业建议或服务而支付的一笔款项
example_zh: 员工因搬迁而产生的任何法律费用均可获得报销。

definition: a meal of milk for a young baby; a meal for an animal
example: her morning feed
definition_zh: 给婴儿喝的一顿奶；给动物吃的一顿饭
example_zh: 她早上的喂食

definition: to give food to a person or an animal
example: feed somebody/something/yourself, Have you fed the cat yet?
definition_zh: 给人或动物喂食
example_zh: 给某人/某物/自己喂食，你给猫喂过饭了吗？

definition: advice, criticism or information about how good or useful something or somebody’s work is
example: customer/user feedback
definition_zh: 关于某事或某人作品的质量或实用性的建议、批评或信息
example_zh: 客户/用户反馈

definition: the feeling you get when you touch something or are touched
example: You can tell it's silk by the feel.
definition_zh: 触摸某物或被触碰时产生的感觉
example_zh: 摸起来就能感觉到这是真丝。

definition: to experience a particular feeling or emotion
example: + adj., The bus ride made me feel sick.
definition_zh: 体验某种特定的感受或情绪
example_zh: + 形容词，坐公交车让我感到不舒服。

definition: something that you feel through the mind or through the senses
example: a feeling of something, a feeling of guilt/helplessness/anger/sadness
definition_zh: 通过思维或感官所感知到的东西
example_zh: 某种感觉，一种内疚感/无助感/愤怒感/悲伤感

definition: used to describe somebody who is the same as you in some way, or in the same situation
example: fellow citizens/students
definition_zh: 用于形容某人在某些方面与你相同，或处于相同处境
example_zh: 各位同胞/同学们

definition: being a woman or a girl
example: a female student/employee/artist/athlete
definition_zh: 身为女性或女孩
example_zh: 一名女学生/女职员/女艺术家/女运动员

definition: an animal that can lay eggs or give birth to babies; a plant that can produce fruit
example: One adult female can lay 400 to 500 eggs.
definition_zh: 能产卵或生育幼崽的动物；能结果实的植物
example_zh: 一只成年雌性可产下400至500枚卵。

definition: having or based on the belief that women should have the same rights and opportunities as men
example: feminist demands/ideas/theories
definition_zh: 持有或基于这样一种信念：女性应享有与男性同等的权利和机会
example_zh: 女权主义的要求/思想/理论

definition: a person who supports the belief that women should have the same rights and opportunities as men
example: Nineteenth-century feminists demanded equal education and employment opportunities for single women.
definition_zh: 支持“女性应享有与男性同等的权利和机会”这一观点的人
example_zh: 十九世纪的女权主义者要求为单身女性提供平等的教育和就业机会。

definition: a structure made of wood or wire supported with posts that is put between two areas of land as a boundary, or around a garden, field, etc. to keep animals in, or to keep people and animals out
example: The two women chatted over the garden fence.
definition_zh: 一种由木头或铁丝制成、由立柱支撑的结构，通常设置在两块土地之间作为界限，或围绕花园、田地等区域，用于将动物圈养在内，或阻止人和动物进入
example_zh: 这两位女士隔着花园的篱笆聊了起来。

definition: a series of performances of music, plays, films, etc., usually organized in the same place once a year; a series of public events connected with a particular activity or idea
example: a film/music festival
definition_zh: 一系列音乐、戏剧、电影等演出，通常每年在同一地点举办一次；与某项特定活动或理念相关的系列公共活动
example_zh: 电影/音乐节

definition: a medical condition in which a person has a temperature that is higher than normal
example: He has a high fever.
definition_zh: 一种患者体温高于正常水平的病症
example_zh: 他发高烧了。

definition: used with plural nouns and a plural verb to mean ‘a small number’, ‘some’
example: We've had a few replies.
definition_zh: 与复数名词和复数动词搭配使用，表示“少数”、“一些”
example_zh: 我们已经收到了一些回复。

definition: used with plural nouns and a plural verb to mean ‘a small number’, ‘some’
example: We've had a few replies.
definition_zh: 与复数名词和复数动词搭配使用，表示“少数”、“一些”
example_zh: 我们已经收到了一些回复。

definition: a small number of people, things or places; some
example: I recognized a few of the other people.
definition_zh: 少数人、事物或地点；一些
example_zh: 我认出了其中几个人。

definition: the part of food that helps to keep a person healthy by keeping the bowels working and moving other food quickly through the body
example: dietary fibre
definition_zh: 食物中有助于维持人体健康的那部分，它能保持肠道正常运作，并促使其他食物迅速通过人体
example_zh: 膳食纤维

definition: a type of literature that describes imaginary people and events, not real ones
example: a work of popular fiction
definition_zh: 一种描述虚构人物和事件（而非真实人物和事件）的文学体裁
example_zh: 一部通俗小说

definition: an area of land in the country used for growing crops or keeping animals in, usually surrounded by a fence, etc.
example: We had to walk across a ploughed field.
definition_zh: 乡村中用于种植农作物或饲养牲畜的一块土地，通常四周有围栏等设施。
example_zh: 我们不得不穿过一片刚犁过的田地。

definition: angry and aggressive in a way that is frightening
example: a fierce dog
definition_zh: 以一种令人恐惧的方式表现出愤怒和攻击性
example_zh: 一只凶猛的狗

example: He's in the first fifteen.
example_zh: 他排在前十五名之内。

definition: 5th
example: Today is the fifth (of May).
definition_zh: 第5个
example_zh: 今天是五月五日。

example: She was born in the fifties.
example_zh: 她出生于五十年代。

definition: a struggle against somebody/something using physical force
example: a street/gang fight
definition_zh: 利用武力与某人/某物进行的搏斗
example_zh: 一场街头斗殴/帮派斗殴

definition: to take part in a war or battle against an enemy
example: soldiers trained to fight
definition_zh: 参加针对敌人的战争或战斗
example_zh: 受过战斗训练的士兵

definition: the activity of being involved in a battle against an enemy
example: Fighting broke out in three districts of the city last night.
definition_zh: 参与与敌人作战的活动
example_zh: 昨晚，该市三个区爆发了冲突。

definition: a number representing a particular amount, especially one given in official information
example: the latest sales/crime/unemployment figures
definition_zh: 表示特定数额的数字，尤其是官方信息中给出的数字
example_zh: 最新的销售、犯罪和失业数据

definition: to be part of a process, situation, etc. especially an important part
example: My feelings about the matter didn't seem to figure at all.
definition_zh: 成为某个过程、情况等的一部分，尤其是其中重要的一部分
example_zh: 我对此事的看法似乎完全没被考虑进去。

definition: a box or folded piece of card for keeping loose papers together and in order
example: a box file
definition_zh: 一个盒子或一张折叠好的卡片，用于将散落的纸张收拢并整理好
example_zh: 文件盒

definition: to put and keep paper documents in a particular place and in a particular order so that you can find them easily; to put a paper document in a box, file, etc.
example: file something (+ adv./prep.), The forms should be filed alphabetically.
definition_zh: 将纸质文件放在特定位置并按特定顺序整理，以便于查找；将纸质文件放入盒子、文件夹等容器中。
example_zh: 提交某物（+ 副词/介词），表格应按字母顺序提交。

definition: to make something full of something; to become full of something
example: fill something, Please fill this glass for me.
definition_zh: 使某物充满某物；变得充满某物
example_zh: 倒点什么，请帮我倒满这杯水。

definition: a series of moving pictures recorded with sound that tells a story, watched at a cinema or on a television or other device
example: Let's stay in and watch a film.
definition_zh: 一系列带有声音的动态画面，讲述一个故事，可在电影院、电视或其他设备上观看
example_zh: 咱们待在家里看部电影吧。

definition: to make a film of a story or a real event; to record somebody/something on film
example: They are filming in Moscow right now.
definition_zh: 将一个故事或真实事件拍成电影；将某人或某事拍摄下来
example_zh: 他们目前正在莫斯科拍摄。

definition: a person who directs or produces films
example: The film-maker won an award for her documentary.
definition_zh: 负责导演或制作电影的人
example_zh: 这位电影制作人凭借她的纪录片获得了一个奖项。

definition: a device containing paper, sand, chemicals, etc. that a liquid or gas is passed through in order to remove any materials that are not wanted
example: an air/oil filter
definition_zh: 一种内装有纸张、沙子、化学物质等材料的装置，液体或气体流经其中，以去除其中的任何不需要的物质
example_zh: 一个空气/机油滤清器

definition: to pass liquid, light, etc. through a special device, especially to remove something that is not wanted
example: All drinking water must be filtered.
definition_zh: 使液体、光线等通过某种特殊装置，尤其是为了去除其中不需要的成分
example_zh: 所有饮用水都必须经过过滤。

definition: being or happening at the end of a series of events, actions, statements, etc.
example: his final act as party leader
definition_zh: 发生在一系列事件、行动、陈述等结束时。
example_zh: 他作为党魁的最后一项举措

definition: the last of a series of games or competitions, in which the winner is decided
example: She reached the final of the 100m hurdles.
definition_zh: 一系列比赛或竞赛的最后一场，胜负在此决出
example_zh: 她闯入了100米跨栏决赛。

definition: after a long time, especially when there has been some difficulty or delay
example: The performance finally started half an hour late.
definition_zh: 经过很长时间，尤其是当遇到一些困难或延误时
example_zh: 演出最终推迟了半小时才开始。

definition: money used to run a business, an activity or a project
example: The project will only go ahead if they can raise the necessary finance.
definition_zh: 用于经营企业、开展活动或实施项目的资金
example_zh: 只有在他们能够筹集到所需资金的情况下，该项目才会继续推进。

definition: to provide money for a project
example: finance something, He took a job to finance his stay in Germany.
definition_zh: 为一个项目提供资金
example_zh: 为……筹集资金，他找了一份工作，以支付在德国的居留费用。

definition: connected with money and finance
example: the world's major financial markets/institutions
definition_zh: 与金钱和金融有关
example_zh: 全球主要金融市场/机构

definition: to discover somebody/something unexpectedly or by chance
example: find somebody/something, Look what I've found!
definition_zh: 意外地或偶然地发现某人/某物
example_zh: 找到某人/某物，快看我找到了什么！

definition: information that is discovered as the result of research into something
example: Our research findings indicate that pregnant women benefit from this treatment.
definition_zh: 通过对某事进行研究而发现的信息
example_zh: 我们的研究结果表明，孕妇从这种治疗中受益。

definition: in good health
example: ‘How are you?’ ‘Fine, thanks.’
definition_zh: 身体健康
example_zh: “你好吗？”“很好，谢谢。”

definition: a sum of money that must be paid as punishment for breaking a law or rule
example: I got a parking fine for parking on double yellow lines.
definition_zh: 因违反法律或规则而必须缴纳的一笔罚款
example_zh: 因为在双黄线处停车，我被开了一张停车罚单。

definition: to make somebody pay money as an official punishment
example: fine somebody (something), The magistrate fined him $400.
definition_zh: 作为正式处罚，责令某人缴纳罚款
example_zh: 对某人（某物）处以罚款，治安法官对他处以400美元的罚款。

definition: one of the four long thin parts that stick out from the hand (or five, if the thumb is included)
example: She ran her fingers through her hair.
definition_zh: 从手部伸出的四个细长部分之一（如果算上拇指的话，则是五个）
example_zh: 她用手指拨了拨头发。

definition: the last part or the end of something
example: It was a close finish as they had predicted.
definition_zh: 某事物的最后一部分或结尾
example_zh: 正如他们预料的那样，比赛结果十分胶着。

definition: to stop doing something or making something because it is complete
example: finish (something), Haven't you finished your homework yet?
definition_zh: 因为某事已经完成，所以停止做某事或制作某物
example_zh: 完成（某事），你还没写完作业吗？

definition: the flames, light and heat, and often smoke, that are produced when something burns
example: Most animals are afraid of fire.
definition_zh: 某物燃烧时产生的火焰、光和热，以及通常伴随的烟雾
example_zh: 大多数动物都怕火。

definition: to shoot bullets, etc. from a gun or other weapon
example: The officer ordered his men to fire.
definition_zh: 用枪或其他武器发射子弹等
example_zh: 那名军官命令手下开火。

definition: a gun that can be carried
example: The police were issued with firearms.
definition_zh: 一款便于随身携带的枪支
example_zh: 警方被配发了枪支。

definition: a person whose job is to put out fires
example: Firefighters were called to a house in Summertown.
definition_zh: 以灭火为职业的人
example_zh: 消防员被召至萨默敦的一处住宅。

definition: a small device containing powder that burns or explodes and produces bright coloured lights and loud noises, used especially at celebrations
example: (British English), to let off a few fireworks
definition_zh: 一种内装可燃烧或爆炸粉末的小型装置，能产生鲜艳的色彩和巨大的声响，主要在庆祝活动中使用
example_zh: （英式英语），放几支烟花

definition: fairly hard; not easy to press into a different shape
example: a firm bed/mattress
definition_zh: 相当硬；不容易压成其他形状
example_zh: 一张硬床/硬床垫

definition: a business or company
example: a law/consulting/research firm
definition_zh: 一家企业或公司
example_zh: 一家法律/咨询/研究公司

definition: in a strong or definite way
example: ‘I can manage,’ she said firmly.
definition_zh: 以一种强烈或明确的方式
example_zh: “我能应付，”她坚定地说。

definition: before anyone or anything else; at the beginning
example: ‘Do you want a drink?’ ‘I'll finish my work first.’
definition_zh: 在任何人和任何事物之前；在起初
example_zh: “想喝点什么吗？”“我先把工作做完。”

definition: happening or coming before all other similar things or people; 1st
example: her first husband
definition_zh: 发生或出现的时间早于所有其他类似的事物或人；第一
example_zh: 她的第一任丈夫

definition: the person or thing that comes or happens before all other similar people or things
example: I was the first in my family to go to college.
definition_zh: 在所有其他同类人或事物之前出现或发生的人或事物
example_zh: 我是家里第一个上大学的人。

definition: happening or coming before all other similar things or people; 1st
example: her first husband
definition_zh: 发生或出现的时间早于所有其他类似的事物或人；第一
example_zh: 她的第一任丈夫

definition: used to introduce the first of a list of points you want to make in a speech or piece of writing
example: There are two reasons for this decision: firstly…
definition_zh: 用于在演讲或文章中引出要阐述的一系列观点中的第一点
example_zh: 做出这一决定的原因有两个：首先……

definition: a creature that lives in water, breathes through gills, and uses fins and a tail for swimming
example: They caught several fish.
definition_zh: 一种生活在水中、通过鳃呼吸、并利用鳍和尾巴游泳的生物
example_zh: 他们钓到了好几条鱼。

definition: to try to catch fish with nets, a fishing line, etc.
example: The trawler was fishing off the coast of Iceland.
definition_zh: 试图用渔网、鱼线等工具捕鱼。
example_zh: 这艘拖网渔船当时正在冰岛近海捕鱼。

definition: the sport or business of catching fish
example: They often go fishing.
definition_zh: 捕鱼这项运动或行业
example_zh: 他们经常去钓鱼。

definition: healthy and strong, especially because you do regular physical exercise
example: Top athletes have to be very fit.
definition_zh: 身体健康、体格强健，特别是因为你坚持定期锻炼
example_zh: 顶尖运动员必须身体非常健康。

definition: a sudden attack of an illness, such as epilepsy, in which somebody becomes unconscious and their body may make violent movements
example: to have an epileptic fit
definition_zh: 某种疾病的突发发作，例如癫痫，患者会因此失去意识，身体可能会出现剧烈抽搐
example_zh: 发生癫痫发作

definition: to be the right shape and size for somebody/something
example: I tried the dress on but it didn't fit.
definition_zh: 对某人/某物来说，形状和大小都恰到好处
example_zh: 我试穿了那条连衣裙，但穿不上。

definition: the state of being physically healthy and strong
example: a magazine on health and fitness
definition_zh: 身体健康、体格强健的状态
example_zh: 一本关于健康与健身的杂志

example: There are only five cookies left.
example_zh: 只剩下五块饼干了。

definition: a solution to a problem, especially an easy or temporary one
example: Luckily there is an easy fix.
definition_zh: 问题的解决方案，尤其是简单或暂时的解决方案
example_zh: 幸运的是，有一个简单的解决办法。

definition: to repair or correct something
example: The car won't start—can you fix it?
definition_zh: 修复或纠正某事
example_zh: 车打不着火——你能修好吗？

definition: staying the same; not changing or able to be changed
example: These fixed prices give farmers a degree of financial security.
definition_zh: 保持不变；不发生变化或无法被改变
example_zh: 这些固定价格为农民提供了一定程度的经济保障。

definition: a sports event that has been arranged to take place on a particular date and at a particular place
example: There are plans to make the race an annual fixture.
definition_zh: 一项已安排在特定日期和特定地点举行的体育赛事
example_zh: 目前计划将这项赛事打造成一年一度的固定活动。

definition: a piece of cloth with a special coloured design on it that may be the symbol of a particular country or organization, may be used to give a signal or may have a particular meaning. A flag can be attached to a pole (= a long thin straight piece of wood or metal) or held in the hand.
example: the Italian flag
definition_zh: 一块印有特殊彩色图案的布，可能是某个国家或组织的象征，也可用于发出信号，或具有特定含义。国旗可以悬挂在旗杆上（即一根细长的直木棍或金属杆），也可以手持。
example_zh: 意大利国旗

definition: a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is on fire
example: the tiny yellow flame of a match
definition_zh: 一种来自燃烧物体的、炽热而明亮的燃烧气体流
example_zh: 火柴那微小的黄色火苗

definition: a sudden bright light that shines for a moment and then disappears
example: a flash of lightning
definition_zh: 一道突然出现、只闪现片刻便消失的强光
example_zh: 一道闪电

definition: to shine very brightly for a short time; to make something shine in this way
example: Lightning flashed in the distance.
definition_zh: 在短时间内发出非常耀眼的光芒；使某物以这种方式发光
example_zh: 远处闪过一道闪电。

definition: having a level surface, not curved or sloping, and without holes or any bits sticking out
example: low buildings with flat roofs
definition_zh: 表面平整，既不弯曲也不倾斜，且没有孔洞或任何凸起的部分
example_zh: 低矮的平顶建筑

definition: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building
example: They're renting a furnished flat on the third floor.
definition_zh: 一套用于居住的房间，通常位于建筑物的同一层
example_zh: 他们正在租一间位于三楼、带家具的公寓。

definition: how food or drink tastes
example: The tomatoes give extra flavour to the sauce.
definition_zh: 食物或饮料的味道如何
example_zh: 番茄为酱汁增添了额外的风味。

definition: a mistake in something that means that it is not correct or does not work correctly
example: The argument is full of fundamental flaws.
definition_zh: 某事中的错误，指该事不正确或无法正常运作
example_zh: 这一论点存在诸多根本性缺陷。

definition: having a flaw; not perfect or correct
example: seriously/fundamentally/fatally flawed
definition_zh: 存在缺陷；不完美或不正确
example_zh: 存在严重/根本性/致命缺陷

definition: to leave a person or place very quickly, especially because you are afraid of possible danger
example: She burst into tears and fled.
definition_zh: 迅速离开某人或某地，尤其是因为担心可能面临的危险
example_zh: 她放声大哭，然后逃走了。

definition: a group of military ships commanded by the same person
example: a fleet of destroyers
definition_zh: 由同一人指挥的一支军舰编队
example_zh: 一支驱逐舰编队

definition: the soft substance between the skin and bones of animal or human bodies
example: The trap had cut deeply into the rabbit's flesh.
definition_zh: 动物或人体皮肤与骨骼之间的软组织
example_zh: 捕兽夹深深地嵌进了兔子的肉里。

definition: the ability to change to suit new conditions or situations
example: The new system offers a much greater degree of flexibility in the way work is organized.
definition_zh: 适应新环境或新情况的能力
example_zh: 新系统在工作组织方式上提供了更大的灵活性。

definition: able to change to suit new conditions or situations
example: a more flexible approach
definition_zh: 能够根据新的条件或情况作出调整
example_zh: 一种更灵活的方法

definition: a journey made by air, especially in a plane
example: a smooth/comfortable/bumpy flight
definition_zh: 乘飞机进行的旅行，尤其是乘坐飞机进行的旅行
example_zh: 一次平稳/舒适/颠簸的飞行

definition: to move slowly on water or in the air
example: A group of swans floated by.
definition_zh: 在水面上或空中缓慢移动
example_zh: 一群天鹅悠然游过。

definition: a large amount of water covering an area that is usually dry
example: The heavy rain has caused floods in many parts of the country.
definition_zh: 大片水域覆盖了通常干燥的区域
example_zh: 暴雨导致该国许多地区发生洪涝灾害。

definition: if a place floods or something floods it, it becomes filled or covered with water
example: The cellar floods whenever it rains heavily.
definition_zh: 如果某个地方发生洪水，或者有什么东西被水淹没，那里就会被水填满或覆盖
example_zh: 每逢大雨，地下室就会进水。

definition: the surface of a room that you walk on
example: a wooden/concrete/tiled floor
definition_zh: 房间里你行走的地面
example_zh: 木地板/水泥地/瓷砖地

definition: a fine white or brown powder made from grain, especially wheat, and used in cooking for making bread, cakes, etc.
example: Sift the flour and salt into a bowl.
definition_zh: 一种由谷物（尤其是小麦）制成的细白或棕色粉末，用于烹饪中制作面包、蛋糕等。
example_zh: 将面粉和盐过筛到碗里。

definition: to develop quickly and become successful or common
example: Few businesses are flourishing in the present economic climate.
definition_zh: 迅速发展并取得成功或变得普遍
example_zh: 在当前的经济形势下，鲜有企业能蓬勃发展。

definition: the steady and continuous movement of something/somebody in one direction
example: the flow of an electric current
definition_zh: 某物或某人朝着一个方向的平稳且持续的运动
example_zh: 电流的流动

definition: to move steadily and continuously in one direction
example: She lost control and the tears began to flow.
definition_zh: 朝着一个方向稳步、持续地前进
example_zh: 她失控了，眼泪开始流下来。

definition: the coloured part of a plant from which the seed or fruit develops. Flowers usually grow at the end of a stem and last only a short time.
example: The plant has a beautiful bright red flower.
definition_zh: 植物上产生种子或果实的彩色部分。花通常生长在茎的顶端，花期很短。
example_zh: 这种植物开着一朵鲜艳的红花。

definition: a serious disease caused by a virus, that causes a high temperature, severe pains and weakness
example: The whole family has the flu.
definition_zh: 一种由病毒引起的严重疾病，会导致高烧、剧烈疼痛和全身无力
example_zh: 全家人都得了流感。

definition: a liquid; a substance that can flow
example: body fluids (= for example, blood)
definition_zh: 液体；一种能够流动的物质
example_zh: 体液（例如：血液）

definition: a small flying insect with two wings. There are many different types of fly and many of them spread disease.
example: A fly was buzzing against the window.
definition_zh: 一种长有两只翅膀的小型飞虫。苍蝇种类繁多，其中许多会传播疾病。
example_zh: 一只苍蝇在窗户上嗡嗡地飞来飞去。

definition: to move through the air, using wings
example: Penguins can't fly.
definition_zh: 利用翅膀在空中飞行
example_zh: 企鹅不会飞。

definition: able to fly
example: flying insects
definition_zh: 能够飞行
example_zh: 飞虫

definition: travelling in an aircraft
example: I'm terrified of flying.
definition_zh: 乘坐飞机旅行
example_zh: 我非常害怕坐飞机。

definition: the thing or person that people are most interested in; the act of paying special attention to something and making people interested in it
example: focus of something, It was the main focus of attention at the meeting.
definition_zh: 人们最感兴趣的事物或人物；对某事给予特别关注并引起人们兴趣的行为
example_zh: 某事的焦点，这是会议上的主要关注点。

definition: to give attention, effort, etc. to one particular subject, situation or person rather than another
example: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.
definition_zh: 将注意力、精力等集中于某个特定的主题、情况或人，而非其他
example_zh: 她心不在焉，很难集中注意力。

definition: a part of something, especially cloth, that is folded or hangs as if it had been folded
example: the folds of her dress
definition_zh: 某物（尤其是布料）的一部分，其被折叠或悬垂，看起来仿佛曾被折叠过
example_zh: 她裙子的褶皱

definition: to bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part lies on top of another part
example: fold something, First, fold the paper in half/in two.
definition_zh: 将某物（尤其是纸或布）折叠，使其中一部分叠在另一部分之上
example_zh: 折叠某物，首先，将纸对折。

definition: that can be folded, so that it can be carried or stored in a small space
example: a folding chair/bike/knife
definition_zh: 可以折叠，以便携带或存放在狭小空间内
example_zh: 一把折叠椅/一辆自行车/一把刀

definition: traditional and typical of the ordinary people of a country or community
example: We visited an exhibition of folk art.
definition_zh: 一个国家或社区中普通民众所特有的、典型的
example_zh: 我们参观了一场民间艺术展。

definition: people in general
example: ordinary working-class folk
definition_zh: 一般人
example_zh: 普通工薪阶层

definition: to come or go after or behind somebody/something
example: follow somebody/something, Follow me please.
definition_zh: 跟在某人/某物后面或之后来或去
example_zh: 关注某人/某事，请关注我。

definition: that is/are going to be mentioned next
example: Answer the following questions.
definition_zh: 接下来将要提到的
example_zh: 请回答以下问题。

definition: the thing or things that you will mention next; the person or people that you will mention next
example: The following is a summary of events.
definition_zh: 你接下来要提到的那个或那些事物；你接下来要提到的那个人或那些人
example_zh: 以下是事件摘要。

definition: after or as a result of a particular event
example: He took charge of the family business following his father's death.
definition_zh: 在某事件之后或因该事件而起
example_zh: 父亲去世后，他接管了家族企业。

definition: having warm or loving feelings for somebody, especially somebody you have known for a long time
example: Over the years, I have grown quite fond of her.
definition_zh: 对某人怀有温暖或亲切的情感，尤其是对相识已久的人
example_zh: 这些年来，我已经非常喜欢她了。

definition: things that people or animals eat
example: Pat had prepared food and drink for the work party.
definition_zh: 人或动物吃的食物
example_zh: 帕特为这次工作聚会准备了食物和饮料。

definition: a person who you think behaves or speaks in a way that lacks intelligence or good judgement
example: Don't be such a fool!
definition_zh: 你认为其言行缺乏智慧或判断力的人
example_zh: 别这么傻！

definition: the lowest part of the leg, below the ankle, on which a person or an animal stands
example: My feet are aching.
definition_zh: 腿部最下端，位于脚踝下方，人或动物站立时所倚靠的部分
example_zh: 我的脚好疼。

definition: part of a film showing a particular event
example: old film footage of the moon landing
definition_zh: 一部电影中展现特定事件的片段
example_zh: 月球登陆的旧影像资料

definition: a game played by two teams of 11 players, using a round ball that players kick up and down the playing field. Teams try to kick the ball into the other team’s goal.
example: The kids were outside playing football.
definition_zh: 一项由两支各11名球员组成的球队进行的游戏，球员们用一个圆球在赛场上来回踢动。各队都试图将球踢入对方球门。
example_zh: 孩子们正在外面踢足球。

definition: used to show who is intended to have or use something or where something is intended to be put
example: There's a letter for you.
definition_zh: 用于表示某物打算由谁拥有或使用，或打算放在何处
example_zh: 有一封信是给你的。

definition: to order somebody not to do something; to order that something must not be done
example: forbid somebody (from doing something), He forbade them from mentioning the subject again.
definition_zh: 命令某人不要做某事；下令某事不得做
example_zh: 禁止某人（做某事），他禁止他们再提这个话题。

definition: violent physical action used to obtain or achieve something
example: The release of the hostages could not be achieved without the use of force.
definition_zh: 为获取或实现某事而采取的暴力行为
example_zh: 如果不使用武力，就无法实现人质的获释。

definition: to make somebody do something that they do not want to do
example: be forced into doing something, The President was forced into resigning.
definition_zh: 迫使某人做他不愿意做的事
example_zh: 被迫做某事，总统被迫辞职。

definition: a statement about what will happen in the future, based on information that is available now
example: The sales forecasts are encouraging.
definition_zh: 基于目前可获得的信息，对未来将发生的事情所作的陈述
example_zh: 销售预测令人鼓舞。

definition: to say what you think will happen in the future based on information that you have now
example: forecast something, Experts are forecasting a recovery in the economy.
definition_zh: 根据你目前掌握的信息，预测未来可能会发生什么
example_zh: 预测……，专家们预测经济将复苏。

definition: in or from a country that is not your own
example: What foreign languages do you speak?
definition_zh: 在非本国境内或从非本国出发
example_zh: 你会说哪些外语？

definition: a person who comes from a different country
example: The fact that I was a foreigner was a big disadvantage.
definition_zh: 来自另一个国家的人
example_zh: 作为外国人，这一点对我来说是一个很大的劣势。

definition: a large area of land that is thickly covered with trees
example: a tropical/pine forest
definition_zh: 一片树木茂密的大片土地
example_zh: 热带/松林

definition: used to say that a particular situation or state will always exist
example: I'll love you forever!
definition_zh: 常用来表示某种特定情况或状态将永远存在
example_zh: 我会永远爱你！

definition: to put a lot of effort into making something successful or strong so that it will last
example: a move to forge new links between management and workers
definition_zh: 为使某事取得成功或变得强大而付出巨大努力，使其能够长久延续
example_zh: 旨在在管理层与员工之间建立新联系的举措

definition: to not remember to do something that you ought to do, or to bring or buy something that you ought to bring or buy
example: ‘Why weren't you at the meeting?’ ‘Sorry—I forgot.’
definition_zh: 忘记去做本该做的事，或者忘记带或买本该带或买的东西
example_zh: “你为什么没去开会？”“抱歉——我忘了。”

definition: to stop feeling angry with somebody who has done something to harm, annoy or upset you; to stop feeling angry with yourself
example: forgive somebody, Can you ever forgive me?
definition_zh: 不再对那个曾伤害、惹恼或让你难过的人感到生气；不再对自己感到生气
example_zh: 原谅某人，你能原谅我吗？

definition: a tool with a handle and three or four sharp points (called prongs), used for picking up and eating food
example: to eat with a knife and fork
definition_zh: 一种带有手柄、有三到四个尖端（称为“叉齿”）的工具，用于夹取和食用食物
example_zh: 用刀叉吃饭

definition: a type or variety of something
example: all the millions of different life forms on the planet today
definition_zh: 某事物的某种类型或品种
example_zh: 当今地球上数以百万计的各种生命形式

definition: to produce something in a particular way or make it have a particular shape
example: form something, Bend the wire so that it forms a ‘V’.
definition_zh: 以某种特定方式制作某物，或使其呈现某种特定形状
example_zh: 将金属丝弯成“V”形。

definition: very correct and suitable for official or important occasions
example: ladies in formal evening wear
definition_zh: 非常得体，适合正式或重要场合
example_zh: 身着正式晚礼服的女士们

definition: the general arrangement, plan, design, etc. of something
example: The format of the new quiz show has proved popular.
definition_zh: 某事物的总体布局、方案、设计等
example_zh: 这档新问答节目的形式已证明颇受欢迎。

definition: the action of forming something; the process of being formed
example: the formation of a new government
definition_zh: 形成某物的行为；被形成的過程
example_zh: 新政府的组建

definition: that existed in earlier times
example: This fine ruin was, in former times, a royal castle.
definition_zh: 在早先时期曾存在过的
example_zh: 这座壮丽的废墟，在过去曾是一座皇家城堡。

definition: in the past
example: Namibia, formerly known as South West Africa
definition_zh: 过去
example_zh: 纳米比亚，原名西南非

definition: a series of letters, numbers or symbols that represent a rule or law
example: This formula is used to calculate the area of a circle.
definition_zh: 由一串字母、数字或符号组成的、代表某条规则或法律的表达式
example_zh: 该公式用于计算圆的面积。

definition: to create or prepare something carefully, giving particular attention to the details
example: formulate something, to formulate a policy/theory/plan/proposal
definition_zh: 仔细地制作或准备某物，特别注重细节
example_zh: 制定某事，制定一项政策/理论/计划/提案

definition: away from a place; out
example: They set forth at dawn.
definition_zh: 离开某地；出去
example_zh: 他们破晓时分出发了。

definition: going to happen, be published, etc. very soon
example: the forthcoming elections
definition_zh: 即将发生、即将出版等
example_zh: 即将举行的选举

definition: having or bringing an advantage, an opportunity, a piece of good luck, etc.
example: Remember those less fortunate than yourselves.
definition_zh: 带来或拥有某种优势、机会、好运等。
example_zh: 请记住那些比你们更不幸的人。

definition: by good luck
example: I was late, but fortunately the meeting hadn't started.
definition_zh: 托好运之福
example_zh: 我迟到了，但幸运的是会议还没开始。

definition: a large amount of money
example: He made a fortune in real estate.
definition_zh: 一大笔钱
example_zh: 他在房地产行业赚了一大笔钱。

definition: the number 40
example: There are forty students in the class.
definition_zh: 数字40
example_zh: 班上有四十名学生。

definition: an event or medium where people can exchange opinions and ideas on a particular issue; a meeting organized for this purpose
example: forum (on something), to hold an international forum on drug abuse
definition_zh: 人们可以就特定问题交流意见和想法的活动或平台；为此目的而组织的会议
example_zh: 论坛（关于某事），举办关于药物滥用的国际论坛

definition: directed or moving towards the front
example: The door opened, blocking his forward movement.
definition_zh: 指向或朝前方移动的
example_zh: 门开了，挡住了他的去路。

definition: towards a place or position that is in front
example: She leaned forward and kissed him on the cheek.
definition_zh: 朝向位于前方的地点或位置
example_zh: 她俯身向前，在他脸颊上亲了一下。

definition: the parts of a dead animal or a plant that have become hard and turned into rock
example: fossils over two million years old
definition_zh: 已死亡的动物或植物中那些变硬并变成岩石的部分
example_zh: 有两百万年以上历史的化石

definition: to encourage something to develop
example: The club's aim is to foster better relations within the community.
definition_zh: 促进某事的发展
example_zh: 该俱乐部的宗旨是促进社区内部关系的改善。

definition: to start something, such as an organization or an institution, especially by providing money
example: to found a club/company/school
definition_zh: 创办某事物，例如一个组织或机构，尤其是通过提供资金来创办
example_zh: 创办一个俱乐部/公司/学校

definition: a principle, an idea or a fact that something is based on and that it grows from
example: Respect and friendship provide a solid foundation for marriage.
definition_zh: 某事物所依据并由此发展而来的原则、思想或事实
example_zh: 尊重与友谊为婚姻奠定了坚实的基础。

definition: a person who starts an organization, institution, etc. or causes something to be built
example: the founder and president of the company
definition_zh: 指创立组织、机构等，或促成某事物建成的人
example_zh: 该公司的创始人兼总裁

definition: the number 4
example: The table has four legs.
definition_zh: 数字4
example_zh: 这张桌子有四条桌腿。

definition: the number 14
example: My brother is fourteen years old.
definition_zh: 数字14
example_zh: 我弟弟十四岁。

definition: 4th
example: Today is the fourth (of May).
definition_zh: 第4个
example_zh: 今天是（5月）4日。

definition: a small part or amount of something
example: Only a small fraction of a bank's total deposits will be withdrawn at any one time.
definition_zh: 某事物的微小部分或微量
example_zh: 在任何特定时刻，银行总存款中只有极小一部分会被提取。

definition: easily broken or damaged
example: fragile china/glass/bones
definition_zh: 容易破损或受损
example_zh: 易碎的瓷器/玻璃/骨头

definition: a small part of something that has broken off or comes from something larger
example: fragment (of something), Police found fragments of glass near the scene.
definition_zh: 某物断裂后脱落或从较大物体上分离出来的一小部分
example_zh: 碎片（某物的），警方在案发现场附近发现了玻璃碎片。

definition: a strong border or structure of wood, metal, etc. that holds a picture, door, piece of glass, etc. in position
example: a picture/photo frame
definition_zh: 由木材、金属等材料制成的坚固边框或框架，用于固定画作、门、玻璃板等物品的位置
example_zh: 相框

definition: to put or make a frame or border around something
example: be framed, The photograph had been framed.
definition_zh: 在某物周围添加或制作一个边框
example_zh: 装裱，这张照片已经被装裱好了。

definition: the parts of a building or an object that support its weight and give it shape
example: built on a wooden framework
definition_zh: 建筑物或物体中支撑其重量并赋予其形状的部件
example_zh: 建在木制框架上

definition: formal permission given by a company to somebody who wants to sell its goods or services in a particular area; formal permission given by a government to somebody who wants to operate a public service as a business
example: a franchise agreement/company
definition_zh: 公司授予希望在特定区域销售其商品或服务的人士的正式许可；政府授予希望以营利性方式经营公共服务的人士的正式许可
example_zh: 特许经营协议/公司

definition: in an honest and direct way that people might not like
example: He spoke frankly about the ordeal.
definition_zh: 以一种坦率直白的方式，这种方式可能不会让人喜欢
example_zh: 他坦率地谈到了那段艰难的经历。

definition: the crime of cheating somebody in order to get money or goods illegally
example: She was charged with credit card fraud.
definition_zh: 为了非法获取金钱或财物而欺骗他人的犯罪行为
example_zh: 她被指控犯有信用卡诈骗罪。

definition: without particular plans or arrangements; not busy
example: Are you free on Saturday? We're having a barbecue.
definition_zh: 没有特别的计划或安排；不忙
example_zh: 周六你有空吗？我们要举办一场烧烤聚会。

definition: without payment
example: Children under five travel free.
definition_zh: 无需付款
example_zh: 五岁以下儿童可免费乘车。

definition: to allow somebody to leave prison or somewhere they have been kept against their will
example: free somebody, The hijackers agreed to free a further ten hostages.
definition_zh: 允许某人离开监狱或其被强制拘禁的地方
example_zh: 释放某人，劫机者同意再释放十名人质。

definition: the power or right to do or say what you want without anyone stopping you
example: to defend/protect academic freedom
definition_zh: 不被任何人阻止，随心所欲地做或说任何事情的权力或权利
example_zh: 捍卫/保护学术自由

definition: without anyone trying to prevent or control something
example: the country’s first freely elected president
definition_zh: 没有任何人试图阻止或控制某件事
example_zh: 该国首位民选总统

definition: to become hard, and often turn to ice, as a result of extreme cold; to make something do this
example: Water freezes at 0°C.
definition_zh: 因极度寒冷而变硬，并常结成冰；使某物发生这种变化
example_zh: 水在0°C时结冰。

definition: the rate at which something happens or is repeated
example: Fatal road accidents have decreased in frequency over recent years.
definition_zh: 某事发生或重复的频率
example_zh: 近年来，致命道路交通事故的发生频率有所下降。

definition: happening or doing something often
example: He is a frequent visitor to this country.
definition_zh: 经常发生或做某事
example_zh: 他经常来这个国家。

definition: often
example: Buses run frequently between the city and the airport.
definition_zh: 经常
example_zh: 市区与机场之间的公交车班次很频繁。

definition: recently produced or picked and not frozen, dried or preserved in tins or cans
example: Is this milk fresh?
definition_zh: 最近生产或采摘的，且未经冷冻、干燥或罐装保存的
example_zh: 这牛奶新鲜吗？

definition: the day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday
example: It's Friday today, isn't it?
definition_zh: 周四之后、周六之前的那个星期几
example_zh: 今天是星期五，对吧？

definition: a piece of electrical equipment in which food is kept cold so that it stays fresh
example: The kids tend to raid the fridge when they get home from school.
definition_zh: 一种用于将食物冷藏以保持其新鲜的电器
example_zh: 孩子们放学回家后，往往会冲进冰箱翻找食物。

definition: a person you know well and like, and who is not usually a member of your family
example: This is my friend Tom.
definition_zh: 一个你很熟悉且喜欢的人，通常不是你的家人
example_zh: 这是我的朋友汤姆。

definition: behaving in a kind and pleasant way because you like somebody or want to help them
example: a warm and friendly person
definition_zh: 因为喜欢某人或想帮助某人，而表现得友善、和蔼
example_zh: 一个热情友善的人

definition: a relationship between friends
example: They formed a close friendship at college.
definition_zh: 朋友之间的关系
example_zh: 他们在大学期间结下了深厚的友谊。

definition: to make somebody suddenly feel afraid
example: frighten (somebody), Sorry, I didn't mean to frighten you.
definition_zh: 使某人突然感到害怕
example_zh: 吓唬（某人），对不起，我不是故意要吓唬你的。

definition: afraid; feeling fear
example: a frightened child
definition_zh: 害怕；感到恐惧
example_zh: 一个受惊的孩子

definition: making you feel afraid
example: a frightening experience/prospect/thought
definition_zh: 让你感到害怕
example_zh: 一次令人恐惧的经历/前景/想法

definition: a small animal with smooth skin, that lives both on land and in water (= is an amphibian). Frogs have very long back legs for jumping, and no tail.
example: the croaking of frogs
definition_zh: 一种皮肤光滑的小动物，既能在陆地上生活，也能在水中生活（即属于两栖动物）。青蛙的后腿非常长，便于跳跃，而且没有尾巴。
example_zh: 青蛙的呱呱叫声

definition: used to show where somebody/something starts
example: She began to walk away from him.
definition_zh: 用于表示某人或某事从何处开始
example_zh: 她开始朝他走开。

definition: on or at the front of something
example: (British English), the front garden
definition_zh: 在……上或……前面
example_zh: （英国英语），前院

definition: the part or side of something that faces forward; the side of something that you look at first
example: The front of the building was covered with ivy.
definition_zh: 某物朝前的一面或一侧；你首先看到的一面
example_zh: 大楼的正面爬满了常春藤。

definition: kept at a very low temperature in order to preserve it
example: frozen peas/fish/pizza
definition_zh: 为了保存它，将其保存在极低的温度下
example_zh: 冷冻豌豆/鱼/披萨

definition: the part of a plant that consists of one or more seeds and a soft inner part, can be eaten as food and usually tastes sweet
example: tropical fruits, such as bananas and pineapples
definition_zh: 植物中由一颗或多颗种子及柔软的内层组成的部分，可作为食物食用，通常味道甜美
example_zh: 热带水果，例如香蕉和菠萝

definition: feeling annoyed and impatient because you cannot do or achieve what you want
example: It's very easy to get frustrated in this job.
definition_zh: 因为无法做到或实现自己想要的事情而感到恼火和不耐烦
example_zh: 做这份工作很容易让人感到沮丧。

definition: causing you to feel annoyed and impatient because you cannot do or achieve what you want
example: It's frustrating to have to wait so long.
definition_zh: 这会让你感到烦躁和不耐烦，因为你无法做到或实现自己想要的
example_zh: 不得不等这么久，真让人沮丧。

definition: the feeling of being frustrated
example: in frustration, Dave thumped the table in frustration.
definition_zh: 那种沮丧的感觉
example_zh: 戴夫一气之下，重重地拍了一下桌子。

definition: to cook something in hot fat or oil; to be cooked in hot fat or oil
example: fry (something), fried fish
definition_zh: 用热油脂或热油烹饪某种食物；在热油脂或热油中烹饪
example_zh: 煎（某物）、炸鱼

definition: any material that produces heat or power, usually when it is burnt
example: diesel/jet/rocket fuel
definition_zh: 任何在燃烧时能产生热量或动力的物质
example_zh: 柴油/喷气燃料/火箭燃料

definition: to supply something with material that can be burnt to produce heat or power
example: Uranium is used to fuel nuclear plants.
definition_zh: 为某物提供可燃烧以产生热量或动力的燃料
example_zh: 铀用于为核电站提供燃料。

definition: to do or achieve what was hoped for or expected
example: to fulfil your dream/ambition/potential
definition_zh: 做到或实现原本希望或预期的目标
example_zh: 实现你的梦想/抱负/潜力

definition: containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space
example: a full bottle of wine
definition_zh: 装有或容纳尽可能多的东西；没有空隙
example_zh: 一整瓶葡萄酒

definition: for all the hours of a week during which people normally work or study, rather than just for a part of it
example: students in full-time education
definition_zh: 指一周中人们通常工作或学习的所有时间，而不仅仅是其中的一部分
example_zh: 全日制学生

definition: for all the hours of a week during which people normally work or study, rather than just for a part of it
example: students in full-time education
definition_zh: 指一周中人们通常工作或学习的所有时间，而不仅仅是其中的一部分
example_zh: 全日制学生

definition: completely
example: I fully understand your motives.
definition_zh: 完全地
example_zh: 我完全理解你的动机。

definition: that you enjoy
example: She's really fun to be with.
definition_zh: 你喜欢的
example_zh: 和她在一起真的很有趣。

definition: the feeling of enjoying yourself; activities that you enjoy
example: We had a lot of fun at Sarah's party.
definition_zh: 乐在其中的感觉；自己喜欢的活动
example_zh: 我们在莎拉的派对上玩得很开心。

definition: a special activity or purpose of a person or thing
example: The club serves a useful function as a meeting place.
definition_zh: 某人或某物的特殊活动或目的
example_zh: 该俱乐部作为聚会场所发挥着重要作用。

definition: to work in the correct way
example: We now have a functioning shower.
definition_zh: 以正确的方式运作
example_zh: 现在我们已经有一间能正常使用的淋浴间了。

definition: practical and useful; with little or no decoration
example: Bathrooms don't have to be purely functional.
definition_zh: 实用且有价值；几乎没有或完全没有装饰
example_zh: 卫生间并不一定非得仅具实用功能。

definition: an amount of money that has been saved or has been made available for a particular purpose
example: a disaster relief fund
definition_zh: 为特定目的而存下的或已拨出的款项
example_zh: 一项救灾基金

definition: to provide money for something, usually something official
example: Who is funding this research?
definition_zh: 为某事提供资金，通常指官方事务
example_zh: 这项研究的资金来自哪里？

definition: serious and very important; affecting the most central and important parts of something
example: the fundamental principles of scientific method
definition_zh: 严重且极其重要；涉及某事的核心和最重要部分
example_zh: 科学方法的基本原则

definition: in every way that is important; completely
example: The two approaches are fundamentally different.
definition_zh: 在所有重要的方面；完全地
example_zh: 这两种方法在根本上有所不同。

definition: money for a particular purpose; the act of providing money for such a purpose
example: federal/state funding
definition_zh: 用于特定目的的资金；为该目的提供资金的行为
example_zh: 联邦/州政府拨款

definition: the activity of collecting money for a charity or organization, often by organizing social events or entertainments
example: The hospice is planning a major fundraising event for June.
definition_zh: 为慈善机构或组织筹集资金的活动，通常通过组织社交活动或娱乐活动来进行
example_zh: 这家临终关怀机构计划于6月举办一场大型筹款活动。

definition: a ceremony, often a religious one, for burying or cremating (= burning) a dead person
example: Hundreds of people attended the funeral.
definition_zh: 一种仪式（通常是宗教仪式），用于安葬或火化（即焚烧）逝者
example_zh: 数百人参加了葬礼。

definition: making you laugh
example: a funny story/joke
definition_zh: 逗你笑
example_zh: 一个有趣的故事/笑话

definition: the soft thick mass of hair that grows on the body of some animals
example: The cat carefully licked its fur.
definition_zh: 某些动物身上生长的那种柔软浓密的毛发
example_zh: 那只猫仔细地舔了舔自己的毛。

definition: very angry
example: Their incompetence made me furious.
definition_zh: 非常生气
example_zh: 他们的无能让我气得要命。

definition: objects that can be moved, such as tables, chairs and beds, that are put into a house or an office to make it suitable for living or working in
example: garden/office furniture
definition_zh: 可以移动的物品，例如桌子、椅子和床，这些物品被放置在住宅或办公室中，以使其适合居住或工作
example_zh: 花园/办公家具

definition: more; additional
example: Cook for a further 2 minutes.
definition_zh: 更多；另外
example_zh: 再煮2分钟。

definition: at or to a greater distance
example: We had walked a bit further than I had realized.
definition_zh: 在……处或更远的地方
example_zh: 我们走得比我意识到的还要远一些。

definition: in addition to what has just been stated. Furthermore is used especially to add a point to an argument.
example: He said he had not discussed the matter with her. Furthermore, he had not even contacted her.
definition_zh: 除了刚才所说的内容之外。“此外”一词通常用于在论点中补充一个观点。
example_zh: 他说他没有和她讨论过这件事。此外，他甚至都没有联系过她。

definition: taking place or existing at a time after the present
example: The land will remain untouched for future generations to enjoy.
definition_zh: 发生或存在于现在之后的某个时间
example_zh: 这片土地将保持原貌，供子孙后代欣赏。

definition: the time that will come after the present or the events that will happen then
example: We need to plan for the future.
definition_zh: 当前之后将要到来的时期，或届时将要发生的事情
example_zh: 我们需要为未来做规划。

definition: an increase in the amount of something, especially in wealth or weight
example: The opposition made unexpected gains in the last election.
definition_zh: 某事物数量的增加，尤其是财富或重量的增加
example_zh: 反对派在上一届选举中取得了出人意料的进展。

definition: to obtain or win something, especially something that you need or want
example: gain something, They managed to gain access to secret files.
definition_zh: 获得或赢得某物，尤其是自己需要或想要的东西
example_zh: 获得某些东西，他们设法获取了机密文件。

definition: a room or building for showing works of art, especially to the public
example: a picture gallery
definition_zh: 用于展示艺术作品的房间或建筑，尤其是向公众展示的
example_zh: 图片库

definition: a unit for measuring liquid. In the UK, Canada and other countries it is equal to about 4.5 litres; in the US it is equal to about 3.8 litres. There are four quarts in a gallon.
example: The tankers carried 130 000 gallons of fuel.
definition_zh: 一种液体计量单位。在英国、加拿大和其他国家，1夸脱约等于4.5升；在美国，1夸脱约等于3.8升。1加仑等于4夸脱。
example_zh: 这些油轮载有130 000加仑的燃料。

definition: the activity of playing games of chance for money and of betting on horses, etc.
example: online/internet gambling
definition_zh: 以金钱为赌注参与赌博活动以及进行赛马投注等行为。
example_zh: 在线/网络赌博

definition: an activity that you do to have fun, often one that has rules and that you can win or lose; the equipment for a game
example: The kids were playing a game with their balloons.
definition_zh: 为了娱乐而进行的一项活动，通常有规则，且会有胜负之分；游戏的器材
example_zh: 孩子们正拿着气球玩游戏。

definition: playing computer games
example: online/mobile/console gaming
definition_zh: 玩电脑游戏
example_zh: 在线/移动/主机游戏

definition: an organized group of criminals
example: criminal gangs
definition_zh: 一个有组织的犯罪团伙
example_zh: 犯罪团伙

definition: a space where something is missing
example: Extra funding is needed to plug the gap.
definition_zh: 一个缺了点什么的地方
example_zh: 需要额外的资金来填补这一缺口。

definition: a building for keeping one or more cars or other vehicles in
example: a double garage (= one for two cars)
definition_zh: 用于停放一辆或多辆汽车或其他车辆的建筑物
example_zh: 双车位车库（即可停放两辆车的车库）

definition: a piece of land next to or around your house where you can grow flowers, fruit, vegetables, etc., usually with a lawn (= an area of grass)
example: a front/back/rear garden
definition_zh: 你家旁边或周围的一块地，可以在上面种植花卉、水果、蔬菜等，通常还带有一片草坪（即一片长满草的区域）
example_zh: 前院/后院/后花园

definition: any substance like air that is neither a solid nor a liquid, for example hydrogen or oxygen
example: Air is a mixture of gases.
definition_zh: 任何像空气一样既非固体也非液体的物质，例如氢或氧
example_zh: 空气是由多种气体组成的混合物。

definition: a barrier like a door that is used to close an opening in a fence or a wall outside a building
example: the front/main gate
definition_zh: 一种类似门的屏障，用于封闭建筑物外围围栏或墙壁上的开口
example_zh: 正门/主门

definition: to come together, or bring people together, in one place to form a group
example: A crowd soon gathered.
definition_zh: 聚集在一起，或将人们聚集到一处，形成一个群体
example_zh: 很快，人群便聚集起来。

definition: a meeting of people for a particular purpose
example: a social/family gathering
definition_zh: 人们为特定目的而举行的聚会
example_zh: 社交/家庭聚会

definition: sexually attracted to people of the same sex
example: gay men
definition_zh: 对同性产生性吸引力
example_zh: 男同性恋者

definition: a long, steady look at somebody/something
example: He met her gaze (= looked at her while she looked at him).
definition_zh: 长时间、专注地注视某人/某物
example_zh: 他与她四目相对（=在她注视他的同时，他也注视着她）。

definition: to look steadily at somebody/something for a long time, either because you are very interested or surprised, or because you are thinking of something else
example: She gazed at him in amazement.
definition_zh: 长时间凝视某人或某物，要么是因为非常感兴趣或感到惊讶，要么是因为心不在焉
example_zh: 她惊讶地望着他。

definition: equipment in a vehicle that changes the relation between engine speed (or pedal speed on a bicycle) and the speed of the wheels moving forwards or backwards
example: Careless use of the clutch may damage the gears.
definition_zh: 车辆中用于改变发动机转速（或自行车上的踏板转速）与车轮前进或后退速度之间关系的装置
example_zh: 如果不慎操作离合器，可能会损坏齿轮。

definition: the fact of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, rather than differences in biology; members of a particular gender as a group
example: issues of class, race and gender
definition_zh: 作为男性或女性这一事实，尤其是从社会和文化差异的角度来考虑，而非生物学上的差异；作为群体存在的特定性别成员
example_zh: 阶级、种族和性别问题

definition: a unit inside a cell that controls a particular quality in a living thing that has been passed on from its parents
example: a dominant/recessive gene
definition_zh: 细胞内的一种单位，它控制着生物体中某项特定的性状，并由其父母遗传而来
example_zh: 显性/隐性基因

definition: affecting all or most people, places or things
example: books of general interest (= of interest to most people)
definition_zh: 影响所有或绝大多数人、地点或事物
example_zh: 大众读物（即大多数人感兴趣的书籍）

definition: by or to most people
example: The initiative was generally considered a success.
definition_zh: 由……或对大多数人而言
example_zh: 该举措普遍被认为取得了成功。

definition: to produce energy, especially electricity
example: The wind turbines are used to generate electricity.
definition_zh: 生产能源，尤其是电力
example_zh: 风力发电机用于发电。

definition: all the people who were born at about the same time
example: the younger/older generation
definition_zh: 所有大约在同一时期出生的人
example_zh: 年轻一代/老一辈

definition: shared by, including or typical of a whole group of things; not specific
example: ‘Vine fruit’ is the generic term for currants and raisins.
definition_zh: 由……所共有、包含……或具有……的典型特征；非特定的
example_zh: “葡萄果”是黑加仑和葡萄干的统称。

definition: giving or willing to give freely; given freely
example: The gallery was named after its most generous benefactor.
definition_zh: 慷慨给予或愿意慷慨给予；慷慨给予的
example_zh: 该画廊是以其最慷慨的捐助者命名的。

definition: connected with genes (= the units in the cells of a living thing that control its physical characteristics) or genetics (= the study of genes)
example: genetic and environmental factors
definition_zh: 与基因（即生物细胞中控制其体征的单位）或遗传学（即对基因的研究）有关
example_zh: 遗传和环境因素

definition: unusually great intelligence, skill or artistic ability
example: the genius of Shakespeare
definition_zh: 非凡的智慧、技能或艺术才能
example_zh: 莎士比亚的天才

definition: the murder of a large number of people from a particular nation or ethnic group, with the aim of destroying that nation or group
example: Refugees gave accounts of the mass genocide.
definition_zh: 针对特定国家或族群的大规模屠杀，其目的是摧毁该国家或族群
example_zh: 难民们讲述了那场大规模种族灭绝的经过。

definition: a particular type or style of literature, art, film or music that you can recognize because of its special features
example: literary/musical genres
definition_zh: 一种特定的文学、艺术、电影或音乐类型或风格，因其独特的特征而易于辨认
example_zh: 文学/音乐流派

definition: calm and kind; doing things in a quiet and careful way
example: a kind and gentle man
definition_zh: 沉着而和蔼；做事沉稳而谨慎
example_zh: 一位善良温和的人

definition: a man who is polite and well educated, who has excellent manners and always behaves well
example: You acted like a true gentleman.
definition_zh: 一位彬彬有礼、受过良好教育、举止得体且始终表现得体的人
example_zh: 你的表现真像一位绅士。

definition: real; exactly what it appears to be; not artificial
example: Is the painting a genuine Picasso?
definition_zh: 真实的；完全就是它看起来的样子；不是人造的
example_zh: 这幅画是毕加索的真迹吗？

definition: truly; in a way that is exactly what it appears to be and is not artificial
example: There are some genuinely funny moments in the film.
definition_zh: 确实；从某种意义上说，它正是表面所呈现的那样，没有任何做作之处
example_zh: 这部电影里确实有一些非常搞笑的片段。

definition: the scientific study of the earth’s surface, physical features, divisions, products, population, etc.
example: recent work in economic geography
definition_zh: 对地球地表、自然特征、地域划分、自然资源、人口等方面的科学研究。
example_zh: 经济地理学领域的最新研究成果

definition: a movement that you make with your hands, your head or your face to show a particular meaning
example: He made a rude gesture at the driver of the other car.
definition_zh: 用手、头部或面部做出的、用来表达特定含义的动作
example_zh: 他向另一辆车的司机做了一个粗鲁的手势。

definition: to receive something
example: I got a call from Dave this morning.
definition_zh: 收到某物
example_zh: 今天早上，我接到戴夫打来的电话。

definition: the spirit of a dead person that a living person believes they can see or hear
example: Do you believe in ghosts (= believe that they exist)?
definition_zh: 活人认为自己能够看到或听到的死者的灵魂
example_zh: 你相信鬼吗（即相信鬼是真实存在的）？

definition: very large; much larger or more important than similar things usually are
example: The match was shown on a giant screen outside the town hall.
definition_zh: 非常大；比同类事物通常要大得多或重要得多
example_zh: 这场比赛在市政厅外的巨型屏幕上进行了直播。

definition: (in stories) a very large strong person who is often cruel and stupid
example: tales of giants and ogres
definition_zh: （在故事中）一个身材高大、力大无穷的人，通常既残忍又愚蠢
example_zh: 关于巨人与食人魔的故事

definition: a thing that you give to somebody, especially on a special occasion or to say thank you
example: to give/receive a gift
definition_zh: 送给某人的东西，尤其是在特殊场合或为了表示感谢时
example_zh: 送/收礼物

definition: a performance by musicians playing popular music or jazz in front of an audience; a similar performance by a comedian
example: They're doing a gig in Boston tonight.
definition_zh: 音乐家在观众面前演奏流行音乐或爵士乐的演出；喜剧演员进行的类似演出
example_zh: 他们今晚要在波士顿开演唱会。

definition: a female child
example: a little girl of six
definition_zh: 一名女童
example_zh: 一个六岁的小女孩

definition: a girl or a woman that somebody is having a romantic relationship with
example: He’s got a new girlfriend.
definition_zh: 与某人处于恋爱关系中的女孩或女人
example_zh: 他交了个新女朋友。

definition: to hand something to somebody so that they can look at it, use it or keep it for a time
example: give something to somebody, Give the letter to your mother when you've read it.
definition_zh: 把某物递给某人，以便对方查看、使用或暂时保管
example_zh: 把某物交给某人，读完这封信后把它交给你的母亲。

definition: pleased; happy
example: ‘I passed the test!’ ‘I’m so glad.’
definition_zh: 高兴；开心
example_zh: “我通过考试了！”“太好了。”

definition: a quick look
example: to take/have a glance at the newspaper headlines
definition_zh: 快速浏览
example_zh: 浏览一下报纸的头条新闻

definition: to look quickly at something/somebody
example: She glanced at her watch.
definition_zh: 快速看一眼某物/某人
example_zh: 她瞥了一眼手表。

definition: a hard, usually clear, substance used, for example, for making windows and bottles
example: a sheet/pane of glass
definition_zh: 一种坚硬、通常透明的物质，例如用于制造窗户和瓶子
example_zh: 一块玻璃

definition: a sight of somebody/something for a very short time, when you do not see the person or thing completely
example: glimpse (of somebody/something), He caught a glimpse of her in the crowd.
definition_zh: 对某人或某物的一瞥，时间非常短暂，且未能看清其全貌
example_zh: 一瞥（某人/某物），他在人群中瞥见了她。

definition: covering or affecting the whole world
example: This year the global economy will grow by about 4 per cent.
definition_zh: 涵盖或影响整个世界
example_zh: 今年，全球经济将增长约4%。

definition: the process by which businesses and cultures become connected worldwide
example: Globalization has increased international trade.
definition_zh: 企业与文化在全球范围内相互联结的过程
example_zh: 全球化促进了国际贸易的发展。

definition: the world (used especially to emphasize its size)
example: tourists from every corner of the globe
definition_zh: 世界（尤指强调其规模时）
example_zh: 来自世界各地的游客

definition: deserving or bringing great success and making somebody/something famous
example: We congratulate you on this glorious victory.
definition_zh: 值得……或带来巨大成功，并使某人/某事声名鹊起
example_zh: 我们祝贺你们取得这一辉煌的胜利。

definition: great success that brings somebody praise and honour and makes them famous
example: Olympic glory in the 100 metres
definition_zh: 巨大的成功，它能为某人赢得赞誉和荣誉，并使他声名远扬
example_zh: 100米赛跑的奥运荣耀

definition: a piece of clothing for the hand, made of wool, leather, etc. with separate parts for each finger and the thumb
example: a pair of gloves
definition_zh: 一种戴在手上的衣物，由羊毛、皮革等材料制成，每个手指和拇指都有独立的部分
example_zh: 一副手套

definition: a person’s turn to move or play in a game or an activity
example: Whose go is it?
definition_zh: 在游戏或活动中，某人该走棋或该行动的轮次
example_zh: 该谁走棋了？

definition: to move or travel from one place to another
example: + adv./prep., She went into her room and shut the door behind her.
definition_zh: 从一个地方移动或前往另一个地方
example_zh: + 副词/介词，她走进自己的房间，身后关上了门。

definition: a frame with a net into which players must kick or hit the ball in order to score a point
example: He headed the ball into an open goal (= one that had nobody defending it).
definition_zh: 一个带网的框架，球员必须将球踢入或击入其中才能得分
example_zh: 他头球将球顶进了空门（即无人防守的球门）。

definition: the being or spirit that is worshipped and is believed to have created the universe
example: Do you believe in God?
definition_zh: 被人们崇拜、并被认为创造了宇宙的神灵或精魂
example_zh: 你相信上帝吗？

definition: bright yellow in colour, like gold
example: The company name was spelled out in gold letters.
definition_zh: 颜色为鲜黄色，像黄金一样
example_zh: 公司名称用金色字母写了出来。

definition: a chemical element. Gold is a yellow precious metal used for making coins, jewellery, beautiful objects, etc.
example: gold coins/jewellery
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。黄金是一种黄色的贵金属，用于制造硬币、首饰、工艺品等。
example_zh: 金币/珠宝

definition: made of gold
example: a golden crown
definition_zh: 由黄金制成
example_zh: 一顶金冠

definition: a game played over a large area of ground using sticks with a special shape to hit a small hard ball (a golf ball) into a series of 9 or 18 holes, using as few shots as possible
example: I play golf every weekend.
definition_zh: 一种在广阔场地进行的运动，使用特殊形状的球杆将一个小而硬的球（高尔夫球）击入9个或18个球洞，并力求用尽可能少的击球次数完成。
example_zh: 我每个周末都打高尔夫球。

definition: of high quality or an acceptable standard
example: a good book
definition_zh: 质量上乘或达到可接受的标准
example_zh: 一本好书

definition: behaviour that is morally right or acceptable
example: Do they even know the difference between good and evil?
definition_zh: 在道德上正确或可接受的行为
example_zh: 他们连善恶之分都分不清吗？

definition: used when you are leaving somebody or when somebody else is leaving
example: Goodbye! It was great to meet you.
definition_zh: 用于与某人道别或他人离开时
example_zh: 再见！很高兴认识你。

definition: used when you are leaving somebody or when somebody else is leaving
example: Goodbye! It was great to meet you.
definition_zh: 用于与某人道别或他人离开时
example_zh: 再见！很高兴认识你。

definition: the quality of being good
example: the essential goodness of human nature
definition_zh: “好”这一品质
example_zh: 人性本善

definition: things that are produced to be sold
example: to produce/buy/sell goods
definition_zh: 为销售而生产的产品
example_zh: 生产/购买/销售商品

definition: very beautiful and attractive; giving great pleasure
example: a gorgeous girl/man
definition_zh: 非常美丽且迷人；令人倍感愉悦
example_zh: 一位绝美的女孩/男孩

definition: to legally control a country or its people and be responsible for introducing new laws, organizing public services, etc.
example: The country is governed by elected representatives of the people.
definition_zh: 依法管理一个国家或其人民，并负责制定新法律、组织公共服务等。
example_zh: 该国由人民选举产生的代表来治理。

definition: the activity of governing a country or controlling a company or an organization; the way in which a country is governed or a company or institution is controlled
example: He emphasized the company's commitment to high standards of corporate governance.
definition_zh: 治理国家、管理公司或组织的行为；国家、公司或机构的管理方式
example_zh: 他强调了公司对高标准公司治理的承诺。

definition: the group of people who are responsible for controlling a country or a state
example: to lead/form a government
definition_zh: 负责管理一个国家或政体的群体
example_zh: 领导/组建政府

definition: a person who is the official head of a country or region that is governed by another country
example: the former governor of the colony
definition_zh: 某国或某地区的官方领导人，该国或该地区受另一国管辖
example_zh: 该殖民地的前总督

definition: to take or hold somebody/something with your hand suddenly or roughly
example: grab somebody/something, She grabbed his arm as he got up to leave.
definition_zh: 用手突然或粗暴地抓住或攥住某人或某物
example_zh: 抓住某人/某物，当他站起来准备离开时，她抓住了他的胳膊。

definition: an attractive quality of movement that is smooth and done with control; a simple and beautiful quality
example: She moves with the natural grace of a ballerina.
definition_zh: 一种迷人的动作特质，既流畅又充满控制力；一种简约而优美的特质
example_zh: 她的举止如芭蕾舞者般自然优雅。

definition: a mark given in an exam or for a piece of school work
example: (British English), She got good grades in her exams.
definition_zh: 考试或学校作业中给出的分数
example_zh: (英式英语)，她在考试中取得了不错的成绩。

definition: to give a grade to a student or to a piece of their written work
example: grade somebody/something, I spent all weekend grading papers.
definition_zh: 给学生或其书面作业打分
example_zh: 给某人/某事打分，我整个周末都在批改试卷。

definition: slowly, over a long period of time
example: to gradually increase/decrease
definition_zh: 缓慢地，在很长的一段时间内
example_zh: 逐渐增加/减少

definition: a person who has a university degree
example: job prospects for graduates
definition_zh: 拥有大学学位的人
example_zh: 毕业生的就业前景

definition: to get a degree, especially your first degree, from a university or college
example: She taught in France after she graduated.
definition_zh: 从大学或学院获得学位，尤其是你的第一个学位
example_zh: 她毕业后曾在法国任教。

definition: the small hard seeds of food plants such as wheat, rice, etc.; a single seed of such a plant
example: Russia sold 12 million tons of grain abroad last year.
definition_zh: 小麦、水稻等食用植物的小而坚硬的种子；此类植物的一粒种子
example_zh: 去年，俄罗斯向国外出口了1200万吨谷物。

definition: impressive and large or important
example: It's not a very grand house.
definition_zh: 令人印象深刻且规模宏大或意义重大
example_zh: 这房子并不怎么气派。

definition: the father of your father or mother
example: The firm had been founded by his grandfather.
definition_zh: 你父亲或母亲的父亲
example_zh: 这家公司是由他的祖父创立的。

definition: the mother of your father or mother
example: I always loved going to visit my grandmother.
definition_zh: 你父亲或母亲的母亲
example_zh: 我一直都很喜欢去探望我的奶奶。

definition: the father or mother of your father or mother
example: The children are staying with their grandparents.
definition_zh: 你父亲或母亲的父亲或母亲
example_zh: 孩子们现在和祖父母住在一起。

definition: a sum of money that is given by the government or by another organization to be used for a particular purpose
example: government/federal grants
definition_zh: 政府或其他组织为特定用途而提供的款项
example_zh: 政府/联邦拨款

definition: to agree to give somebody what they ask for, especially formal or legal permission to do something
example: grant something, My request was granted.
definition_zh: 同意给予某人其所请求之物，尤其是给予其进行某项行为的正式或法律许可
example_zh: 批准某事，我的请求得到了批准。

definition: connected with drawings and design, especially in the production of books, magazines, websites, etc.
example: graphic design
definition_zh: 与插图和设计相关，特别是在书籍、杂志、网站等制作方面。
example_zh: 平面设计

definition: designs, drawings or pictures that are used especially in the production of books, magazines, websites, etc.
example: Text and graphics are prepared separately and then combined.
definition_zh: 专门用于书籍、杂志、网站等制作的设计、图纸或图片。
example_zh: 文字和图形是分别制作，然后合并在一起的。

definition: a strong hold of somebody/something or control over somebody/something
example: I grabbed him, but he slipped from my grasp.
definition_zh: 对某人/某事拥有牢固的掌控或控制权
example_zh: 我一把抓住他，但他却从我手中溜走了。

definition: to take a strong hold of somebody/something
example: He grasped my hand and shook it warmly.
definition_zh: 牢牢抓住某人/某物
example_zh: 他握住我的手，热情地摇了摇。

definition: a common wild plant with narrow green leaves and stems that are eaten by cows, horses, sheep, etc.
example: a blade of grass
definition_zh: 一种常见的野生植物，叶片狭长呈绿色，茎秆可作为牛、马、羊等动物的饲料。
example_zh: 一株草

definition: feeling or showing thanks because somebody has done something kind for you or has done as you asked
example: Thank you for doing this. I really am so grateful.
definition_zh: 因为某人对你做了件好事，或者按照你的要求做了事，而感到或表达感谢
example_zh: 谢谢你这么做。我真的非常感激。

definition: very serious and important; giving you a reason to feel worried
example: The police have expressed grave concern about the missing child's safety.
definition_zh: 非常严重且重要；让你有理由感到担忧
example_zh: 警方对这名失踪儿童的安全表示了严重关切。

definition: a place in the ground where a dead person is buried
example: We visited Grandma's grave.
definition_zh: 地下埋葬死者的地方
example_zh: 我们去探望了奶奶的坟墓。

definition: the force that attracts objects in space towards each other, and that on the earth pulls them towards the centre of the planet, so that things fall to the ground when they are dropped
example: Newton’s law of gravity
definition_zh: 一种使空间中的物体相互吸引的力量，在地球上，这种力量将物体向地球中心拉去，因此当物体被松手时，它们就会落向地面
example_zh: 牛顿万有引力定律

definition: very good or pleasant
example: He's a great bloke.
definition_zh: 非常好或很愉快
example_zh: 他是个很棒的人。

definition: very much
example: People's reaction to the film has varied greatly.
definition_zh: 非常
example_zh: 人们对这部电影的反应各不相同。

definition: having the colour of grass or the leaves of most plants and trees
example: green grass/leaves/vegetables
definition_zh: 呈草色或大多数植物和树木叶子的颜色
example_zh: 绿草/绿叶/蔬菜

definition: the colour of grass and the leaves of most plants and trees
example: light/pale green
definition_zh: 草以及大多数植物和树木的叶子的颜色
example_zh: 浅绿色/淡绿色

definition: a building with glass walls and a glass roof used for growing plants
example: They grow tomatoes in a greenhouse.
definition_zh: 一座带有玻璃墙和玻璃屋顶、用于种植植物的建筑
example_zh: 他们在温室里种番茄。

definition: to say hello to somebody or to welcome them
example: greet somebody, He greeted all the guests warmly as they arrived.
definition_zh: 向某人打招呼或欢迎他们
example_zh: 向某人问好，当客人们陆续到来时，他热情地向每位客人问好。

definition: having the colour of smoke or ashes
example: grey eyes/hair
definition_zh: 呈烟色或灰色的
example_zh: 灰色的眼睛/头发

definition: the colour of smoke or ashes
example: the dull grey of the sky
definition_zh: 烟或灰烬的颜色
example_zh: 天空那片沉闷的灰色

definition: a pattern of straight lines, usually crossing each other to form squares
example: New York’s grid of streets
definition_zh: 由直线组成的图案，通常相互交叉形成正方形
example_zh: 纽约的棋盘式街道布局

definition: a very sad feeling, especially when somebody dies
example: She was overcome with grief when her husband died.
definition_zh: 一种非常悲伤的感觉，尤其是当有人去世的时候
example_zh: 丈夫去世后，她悲痛欲绝。

definition: a wide smile
example: She gave a broad grin.
definition_zh: 灿烂的笑容
example_zh: 她咧嘴笑了。

definition: to smile widely
example: They grinned with delight when they heard our news.
definition_zh: 开怀大笑
example_zh: 听到我们的消息后，他们高兴地咧嘴笑了。

definition: to break or press something into very small pieces between two hard surfaces or using a special machine
example: to grind coffee/corn
definition_zh: 将某物夹在两个硬物之间，或使用专用机器将其压碎或碾成极细小的碎片
example_zh: 用于研磨咖啡/玉米

definition: an act of holding somebody/something tightly; a particular way of doing this
example: Keep a tight grip on the rope.
definition_zh: 紧紧抱住某人或某物的动作；这样做的特定方式
example_zh: 紧紧抓住绳子。

definition: to hold something tightly
example: grip something, ‘Please don't go,’ he said, gripping her arm.
definition_zh: 紧紧抓住某物
example_zh: 抓住某物，“‘求你别走，’他说着，抓住了她的胳膊。”

definition: a shop that sells food and other things used in the home. In American English ‘grocery store’ is often used to mean ‘supermarket’.
example: the corner grocery store
definition_zh: 一家出售食品及其他家居用品的商店。在美国英语中，“grocery store”通常指“超市”。
example_zh: 街角的杂货店

definition: being the total amount of something before anything is taken away
example: gross weight (= including the container or wrapping)
definition_zh: 指在扣除任何部分之前某事物的总数
example_zh: 毛重（即包括容器或包装在内）

definition: the solid surface of the earth
example: on the ground, I found her lying on the ground.
definition_zh: 地球的固体表面
example_zh: 在地面上，我发现她躺在地上。

definition: a number of people or things that are together in the same place or that are connected in some way
example: group of somebody/something, a group of people/students/friends
definition_zh: 指聚集在同一地点或以某种方式相互关联的一群人或事物
example_zh: 某人/某物的群体，一群人/学生/朋友

definition: to increase in size, number, strength or quality
example: The sector is growing at a phenomenal rate.
definition_zh: 在规模、数量、实力或质量上有所增长
example_zh: 该行业正以惊人的速度增长。

definition: the process in people, animals or plants of growing physically, mentally or emotionally
example: Lack of water will stunt the plant's growth.
definition_zh: 人类、动物或植物在身体、智力或情感方面成长的过程
example_zh: 缺水会阻碍植物的生长。

definition: a formal promise that you will do something or that something will happen
example: They are demanding certain guarantees before they sign the treaty.
definition_zh: 一种正式的承诺，表示你会做某事或某事将会发生
example_zh: 他们在签署条约之前，要求获得某些保证。

definition: to promise to do something; to promise something will happen
example: guarantee something, Basic human rights, including freedom of speech, are now guaranteed.
definition_zh: 承诺做某事；承诺某事会发生
example_zh: 保障……，基本人权，包括言论自由，现已得到保障。

definition: a person, such as a soldier, a police officer or a prison officer, who protects a place or people, or prevents prisoners from escaping
example: prison/border guards
definition_zh: 指负责保护某地或某群人，或防止囚犯逃跑的人员，例如士兵、警察或狱警
example_zh: 监狱/边防警卫

definition: to protect property, places or people from attack or danger
example: Armed officers guarded the entrance.
definition_zh: 保护财产、场所或人员免受攻击或危险
example_zh: 入口处有全副武装的警员把守。

definition: a member of a small group of soldiers who are not part of an official army and who fight against official soldiers, usually to try to change the government
example: urban guerrillas (= those who fight in towns)
definition_zh: 一个由少数士兵组成的小团体，他们不隶属于正规军，并与正规军作战，通常是为了试图推翻现政府
example_zh: 城市游击队员（即在城镇中作战的人）

definition: an attempt to give an answer or an opinion when you cannot be certain if you are right
example: (British English), to have/make a guess
definition_zh: 在无法确定自己是否正确的情况下，仍试图给出答案或发表意见
example_zh: （英式英语），猜测

definition: to try and give an answer or make a judgement about something without being sure of all the facts
example: I don't really know. I'm just guessing.
definition_zh: 在尚未掌握全部事实的情况下，试图对某事给出答案或作出判断
example_zh: 我也不太清楚。我只是在猜。

definition: a person that you have invited to your house or to a particular event that you are paying for
example: They only use the dining room when they have guests.
definition_zh: 你邀请到家里或参加由你支付费用的某项活动的人
example_zh: 他们只有在有客人来的时候才会使用餐厅。

definition: help or advice that is given to somebody, especially by somebody older or with more experience
example: guidance for teachers on how to use video in the classroom
definition_zh: 给予某人的帮助或建议，尤其是由年长者或经验更丰富的人提供的
example_zh: 关于教师如何在课堂上使用视频的指导
