example: calls for government intervention to save the steel industry
definition_zh: 为改善或帮助某种情况而采取的行动
example_zh: 呼吁政府介入以拯救钢铁行业

definition: a formal meeting at which somebody is asked questions to see if they are suitable for a particular job, or for a course of study at a college, university, etc.
example: a job interview
definition_zh: 一种正式的面试，旨在通过向某人提问，以评估其是否适合某份工作，或适合进入学院、大学等机构攻读某门课程。
example_zh: 一次求职面试

definition: to talk to somebody and ask them questions at a formal meeting to find out if they are suitable for a job, course of study, etc.
example: interview somebody, The university interviews all potential candidates.
definition_zh: 在正式会议上与某人交谈并向其提问，以了解其是否适合某份工作、某门课程等。
example_zh: 面试某人，该大学会对所有潜在候选人进行面试。

definition: having a close and friendly relationship
example: intimate friends
definition_zh: 保持亲密友好的关系
example_zh: 挚友

definition: to a position in or inside something
example: Come into the house.
definition_zh: 位于某物之中或内部的位置
example_zh: 进屋吧。

definition: very interesting because of being unusual or not having an obvious answer
example: These discoveries raise intriguing questions.
definition_zh: 因为不同寻常或没有显而易见的答案，所以非常有趣
example_zh: 这些发现引发了一些耐人寻味的问题。

definition: to tell two or more people who have not met before what each other’s names are; to tell somebody what your name is
example: introduce somebody, Allow me to introduce my mother.
definition_zh: 向两个或两个以上素未谋面的人介绍彼此的名字；向某人报上自己的名字
example_zh: 介绍某人，请允许我介绍一下我的母亲。

definition: the first part of a book or speech that gives a general idea of what is to follow
example: a book with an excellent introduction and notes
definition_zh: 书籍或演讲的开篇部分，用于概述后续内容
example_zh: 一本导言和注释都非常出色的书

definition: to enter a country, town, etc. using military force in order to take control of it
example: Troops invaded on August 9th that year.
definition_zh: 利用军事力量进入某国、某城镇等，以期控制该地区
example_zh: 当年8月9日，军队发动了入侵。

definition: the act of an army entering another country by force in order to take control of it
example: the German invasion of Poland in 1939
definition_zh: 指一支军队为控制他国而武力入侵该国的行为
example_zh: 1939年德国入侵波兰

definition: to produce or design something that has not existed before
example: Who invented the steam engine?
definition_zh: 创造或设计出此前不存在的事物
example_zh: 谁发明了蒸汽机？

definition: a thing or an idea that has been invented
example: Fax machines were a wonderful invention at the time.
definition_zh: 一种已被发明出来的事物或想法
example_zh: 传真机在当时是一项了不起的发明。

definition: to buy property, shares in a company, etc. in the hope of making a profit
example: Now is a good time to invest.
definition_zh: 为了获利而购买房产、公司股票等
example_zh: 现在正是投资的好时机。

definition: to carefully examine the facts of a situation, an event, a crime, etc. to find out the truth about it or how it happened
example: The FBI has been called in to investigate.
definition_zh: 仔细查明某情况、某事件、某犯罪等的事实，以查明其真相或事件的经过
example_zh: 联邦调查局（FBI）已被请来展开调查。

definition: an official examination of the facts about a situation, crime, etc.
example: a criminal/murder/police investigation
definition_zh: 对某一情况、犯罪等事实进行的正式调查。
example_zh: 犯罪/谋杀/警方调查

definition: a person who examines a situation such as an accident or a crime to find out the truth
example: air safety investigators
definition_zh: 指调查事故或犯罪等事件以查明真相的人
example_zh: 航空安全调查员

definition: the act of investing money in something
example: foreign/private investment
definition_zh: 将资金投入某事的行为
example_zh: 外资/私人投资

definition: a person or an organization that invests money in something
example: small investors (= private people)
definition_zh: 向某事物投资资金的个人或组织
example_zh: 小投资者（即个人投资者）

definition: that cannot be seen
example: a wizard who could make himself invisible
definition_zh: 看不见的
example_zh: 一位能让自己隐形的巫师

definition: a spoken or written request to somebody to do something or to go somewhere
example: to issue/extend an invitation
definition_zh: 口头或书面形式向某人提出的请求，要求其做某事或去某地
example_zh: 发出/延长邀请

definition: to ask somebody to come to a social event
example: invite somebody to something, Have you been invited to their party?
definition_zh: 邀请某人参加社交活动
example_zh: 邀请某人参加某事，你被邀请参加他们的聚会了吗？

definition: to mention or use a law, rule, etc. as a reason for doing something
example: It is unlikely that libel laws will be invoked.
definition_zh: 以某项法律、规则等作为采取某种行动的理由
example_zh: 诽谤法不太可能被援引。

definition: if a situation, an event or an activity involves something, that thing is an important or necessary part or result of it
example: involve something, Any investment involves an element of risk.
definition_zh: 如果某种情况、事件或活动涉及某事物，那么该事物就是其重要或必要的组成部分或结果
example_zh: 涉及……，任何投资都存在一定程度的风险。

definition: taking part in something; being part of something or connected with something
example: Some people tried to stop the fight but I didn't want to get involved.
definition_zh: 参与某事；是某事的一部分或与某事有关
example_zh: 有人试图制止这场打架，但我不想卷入其中。

definition: the act of taking part in something or dealing with somebody
example: involvement in something, US involvement in European wars
definition_zh: 参与某事或与某人打交道的行为
example_zh: 参与某事，美国参与欧洲战争

definition: a chemical element. Iron is a hard strong metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.
example: iron gates/bars/railings
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。铁是一种坚硬且坚韧的金属，用于制造钢，在血液和食物中也含有微量。
example_zh: 铁门/铁栅栏/铁栏杆

definition: to make clothes, etc. smooth by using an iron
example: He was ironing when I arrived.
definition_zh: 用熨斗将衣服等熨平
example_zh: 我到的时候，他正在熨衣服。

definition: showing that you really mean the opposite of what you are saying; expressing irony
example: an ironic comment
definition_zh: 表明你实际上是说反话；表达讽刺
example_zh: 一句讽刺的话

definition: in a way that shows that you really mean the opposite of what you are saying; in a way that expresses irony
example: He smiled ironically.
definition_zh: 以一种表明你实际上是反其道而行之的方式；以一种表达讽刺意味的方式
example_zh: 他露出一丝讽刺的笑容。

definition: the funny or strange aspect of a situation that is very different from what you expect; a situation like this
example: It was one of life's little ironies.
definition_zh: 一种与你的预期大相径庭的、令人发笑或感到奇怪的情况；像这样的情况
example_zh: 这算是人生中的一点小小的讽刺。

definition: not important to or connected with a situation
example: totally/completely/largely irrelevant
definition_zh: 与某情况无关或不重要
example_zh: 完全/彻底/基本上无关

definition: a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water
example: a small/tiny island
definition_zh: 一块四面环水的土地
example_zh: 一座小岛/微型岛屿

definition: to separate somebody/something physically or socially from other people or things
example: isolate somebody/yourself/something, Patients with the disease should be isolated.
definition_zh: 将某人或某物在物理上或社交上与其他人或事物隔离开来
example_zh: 隔离某人/自己/某物，患有该疾病的患者应予以隔离。

definition: far away from any others
example: isolated rural areas
definition_zh: 远离其他一切
example_zh: 偏远农村地区

definition: the act of separating somebody/something; the state of being separate
example: geographical isolation
definition_zh: 将某人/某物分开的行为；处于分离的状态
example_zh: 地理上的隔绝

definition: an important topic that people are discussing or arguing about
example: a key/major issue
definition_zh: 人们正在讨论或争论的一个重要话题
example_zh: 一个关键问题/主要问题

definition: to make something known formally
example: issue something, They issued a joint statement denying the charges.
definition_zh: 正式公布某事
example_zh: 发布某项声明，他们发表了一份联合声明，否认了这些指控。

definition: the study and use of electronic processes and equipment to store and send information of all kinds, including words, pictures and numbers (the abbreviation for ‘information technology’)
example: the increasing use of IT in all aspects of today's society
definition_zh: 对电子流程和设备的研习与应用，用于存储和传输各类信息，包括文字、图片和数字（“信息技术”的缩写）
example_zh: 当今社会各领域对信息技术的应用日益广泛

definition: used to refer to an animal or a thing that has already been mentioned or that is being talked about now
example: ‘Where's your car?’ ‘It's in the garage.’
definition_zh: 用于指代已经提过或正在谈论的动物或事物
example_zh: “你的车在哪儿？”“在车库里。”

definition: one thing on a list of things to buy, do, talk about, etc.
example: What's the next item on the agenda?
definition_zh: 待办事项清单中的一件事，包括要买的东西、要做的事、要谈的话题等。
example_zh: 议程上的下一项是什么？

definition: belonging to or connected with a thing, an animal or a baby
example: Turn the box on its side.
definition_zh: 属于或与某物、某动物或某婴儿有关的
example_zh: 将盒子侧放。

definition: used when the animal or thing that does an action is also affected by it
example: The cat was washing itself.
definition_zh: 用于描述执行某项动作的动物或事物本身也受到该动作影响的情况
example_zh: 那只猫正在舔毛。

definition: a piece of clothing worn on the top half of the body over a shirt, etc. that has arms and fastens down the front; a short, light coat
example: a leather/denim/tweed jacket
definition_zh: 一种穿在上半身、套在衬衫等衣物外面的服装，带有袖子，并在前面系扣；一种短款轻便的外套
example_zh: 一件皮革/牛仔布/粗花呢夹克

definition: a prison
example: She spent a year in jail.
definition_zh: 一座监狱
example_zh: 她在监狱里待了一年。

definition: to put somebody in prison
example: be jailed (for something), He was jailed for life for murder.
definition_zh: 将某人送进监狱
example_zh: 因……入狱，他因谋杀罪被判处无期徒刑。

definition: a thick sweet substance made by boiling fruit with sugar, often sold in jars and spread on bread
example: strawberry jam
definition_zh: 一种将水果与糖一起煮制而成的浓稠甜味物质，通常装在罐子里出售，可涂抹在面包上
example_zh: 草莓果酱

definition: the 1st month of the year, between December and February
example: She was born in January.
definition_zh: 一年中的第一个月，介于12月和2月之间
example_zh: 她出生于一月。

definition: a type of music with strong rhythms, in which the players often improvise (= make up the music as they are playing), originally created by African American musicians at the beginning of the 20th century
example: traditional/modern jazz
definition_zh: 一种节奏强烈的音乐类型，演奏者通常会即兴演奏（即边演奏边创作音乐），最初由非裔美国音乐家于20世纪初创立
example_zh: 传统/现代爵士乐

definition: trousers made of denim (= a type of strong cotton)
example: I always wear jeans.
definition_zh: 用牛仔布（即一种结实的棉布）制成的裤子
example_zh: 我总是穿牛仔裤。

definition: a plane driven by jet engines
example: a jet aircraft/fighter/airliner
definition_zh: 一架由喷气发动机驱动的飞机
example_zh: 喷气式飞机/战斗机/客机

definition: objects such as rings and necklaces that people wear as decoration
example: silver/gold jewellery
definition_zh: 人们作为装饰佩戴的物品，例如戒指和项链
example_zh: 银/金首饰

definition: work for which you receive regular payment
example: I don't have a job at present.
definition_zh: 您能从中获得定期报酬的工作
example_zh: 我目前没有工作。

definition: to fix or connect two or more things together
example: join A to/onto B, Join one section of pipe to the next.
definition_zh: 将两个或多个物体固定或连接在一起
example_zh: 将A与B连接，将一段管道与下一段管道连接。

definition: involving two or more people together
example: a joint account (= a bank account in the name of more than one person, for example shared by a couple)
definition_zh: 涉及两人或两人以上共同参与
example_zh: 联名账户（即以两人以上名义开设的银行账户，例如夫妻共同持有的账户）

definition: a place where two bones are joined together in the body in a way that enables them to bend and move
example: inflammation of the knee joint
definition_zh: 人体中两块骨头连接在一起，使其能够弯曲和活动的地方
example_zh: 膝关节炎症

definition: something that you say or do to make people laugh, for example a funny story that you tell
example: I can't tell jokes.
definition_zh: 你所说或所做能让别人发笑的事情，例如你讲的一个有趣的故事
example_zh: 我不会讲笑话。

definition: to say something to make people laugh; to tell a funny story
example: She was laughing and joking with the children.
definition_zh: 说些让人发笑的话；讲个有趣的故事
example_zh: 她正和孩子们说说笑笑。

definition: a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or profession
example: a scientific/an academic journal
definition_zh: 一本专门报道特定主题或职业的报纸或杂志
example_zh: 一本科学期刊/一本文学期刊

definition: the work of collecting and writing news stories for newspapers, magazines, radio, television or online news sites; the news stories that are written
example: I'd like a career in journalism.
definition_zh: 为报纸、杂志、广播、电视或在线新闻网站收集和撰写新闻报道的工作；所撰写的新闻报道
example_zh: 我想从事新闻工作。

definition: a person whose job is to collect and write news stories for newspapers, magazines, radio, television or online news sites
example: a freelance journalist
definition_zh: 专门为报纸、杂志、广播、电视或在线新闻网站收集和撰写新闻报道的人
example_zh: 一名自由撰稿人

definition: an act of travelling from one place to another, especially when they are far apart
example: They went on a long train journey across India.
definition_zh: 从一地前往另一地的行为，尤其是当两地相距较远时
example_zh: 他们踏上了穿越印度的漫长火车之旅。

definition: a feeling of great happiness
example: Her books have brought joy to millions.
definition_zh: 一种极大的幸福感
example_zh: 她的书给数百万读者带来了欢乐。

definition: a person in a court who has the authority to decide how criminals should be punished or to make legal decisions
example: a High Court judge
definition_zh: 法庭中有权决定如何惩罚罪犯或作出法律裁决的人
example_zh: 一名高等法院法官

definition: to form an opinion about somebody/something, based on the information you have
example: As far as I can judge, all of them are to blame.
definition_zh: 根据已掌握的信息，对某人或某事形成看法
example_zh: 据我所知，他们全都难辞其咎。

definition: the ability to make sensible decisions after carefully considering the best thing to do
example: good/poor/sound judgement
definition_zh: 在仔细权衡最佳方案后，做出明智决定的能力
example_zh: 良好/差/明智的判断

definition: connected with a court, a judge or legal judgement
example: judicial powers
definition_zh: 与法院、法官或法律判决有关
example_zh: 司法权

definition: the liquid that comes from fruit or vegetables; a drink made from this
example: a glass of fruit juice
definition_zh: 从水果或蔬菜中提取的液体；用这种液体制成的饮料
example_zh: 一杯果汁

definition: the 7th month of the year, between June and August
example: in July, She was born in July.
definition_zh: 该年的第7个月，介于6月和8月之间
example_zh: 7月，她出生于7月。

definition: an act of jumping
example: to do a parachute jump
definition_zh: 跳跃的动作
example_zh: 进行一次跳伞

definition: to move quickly off the ground or away from a surface by pushing yourself with your legs and feet
example: ‘Quick, jump!’ he shouted.
definition_zh: 通过用腿和脚蹬地，迅速从地面或某表面上起跳或离开
example_zh: “快，跳！”他喊道。

definition: the place where two or more roads or railway lines meet
example: It was near the junction of City Road and Old Street.
definition_zh: 两条或多条道路或铁路线交汇的地方
example_zh: 那是在城市路和老街的交汇处附近。

definition: the 6th month of the year, between May and July
example: She was born in June.
definition_zh: 该年的第6个月，介于5月和7月之间
example_zh: 她出生于6月。

definition: having a low rank in an organization or a profession
example: a junior partner/minister/officer
definition_zh: 在某个组织或职业中地位较低
example_zh: 初级合伙人/部长/官员

definition: the authority that an official organization has to make legal decisions about somebody/something
example: jurisdiction over somebody/something, The English court had no jurisdiction over the defendants.
definition_zh: 一个官方组织就某人或某事作出法律决定的权限
example_zh: 对某人/某事拥有管辖权，英国法院对被告没有管辖权。

definition: a group of members of the public who listen to the facts of a case in a court and decide whether or not somebody is guilty of a crime, or whether a claim has been proved
example: members of the jury
definition_zh: 一群在法庭上听取案件事实、并裁定某人是否犯有罪行或某项主张是否已得到证实的公众成员
example_zh: 陪审团成员

definition: that most people consider to be morally fair and reasonable
example: a just decision/law/society
definition_zh: 大多数人认为在道德上公平且合理的
example_zh: 公正的裁决/法律/社会

definition: only
example: There is just one method that might work.
definition_zh: 仅
example_zh: 只有一种方法可能有效。

definition: the fair treatment of people
example: She spent her life fighting for social justice and equality for women.
definition_zh: 对人的公平对待
example_zh: 她毕生致力于为社会正义和妇女平等而奋斗。

definition: a good reason why something exists or is done
example: justification for doing something, I can see no possible justification for any further tax increases.
definition_zh: 某事物存在或被做出的充分理由
example_zh: 做某事的理由，我看不出有任何理由可以为进一步增税辩护。

definition: to show that somebody/something is right or reasonable
example: justify doing something, How can they justify paying such huge salaries?
definition_zh: 为了证明某人或某事是正确的或合理的
example_zh: 为某事辩解，他们怎么能为支付如此高昂的薪水辩解呢？

definition: wanting to do something or wanting something to happen very much
example: keen to do something, John was very keen to help.
definition_zh: 非常想做某事或非常希望某事发生
example_zh: 热衷于做某事，约翰非常热衷于提供帮助。

definition: to continue to have something and not give it back or throw it away
example: He kept all her letters.
definition_zh: 继续拥有某样东西，既不归还也不丢弃
example_zh: 他把她的所有信都留了下来。

definition: most important; essential
example: the key issue/factor/point
definition_zh: 最重要的；必不可少的
example_zh: 关键问题/因素/要点

definition: a piece of metal with a special shape used for locking a door, starting a car, etc.
example: to put/turn the key in the lock
definition_zh: 一种形状特殊的金属片，用于锁门、启动汽车等。
example_zh: 将钥匙插入锁孔/转动钥匙

definition: to put information into a computer using a keyboard
example: key something, I was busy keying data.
definition_zh: 使用键盘将信息输入计算机
example_zh: 输入……，当时我正忙着录入数据。

definition: the set of keys for operating a computer or typewriter, or the set of letters that you can touch to write on a smartphone or tablet
example: The program locks the keyboard until a password is given.
definition_zh: 用于操作计算机或打字机的键盘，或者在智能手机或平板电脑上通过触摸输入的字母组合
example_zh: 该程序会锁定键盘，直到输入密码为止。

definition: a movement with the foot or the leg, usually to hit something with the foot
example: the first kick of the game
definition_zh: 用脚或腿做出的动作，通常是为了用脚踢中某物
example_zh: 本场比赛的第一脚射门

definition: to hit somebody/something with your foot
example: Stop kicking—it hurts!
definition_zh: 用脚踢某人/某物
example_zh: 别再踢了——好痛！

definition: a child or young person
example: Do you have any kids?
definition_zh: 儿童或青少年
example_zh: 你有孩子吗？

definition: to take somebody away illegally and keep them as a prisoner, especially in order to get money or something else for returning them
example: Two businessmen have been kidnapped by terrorists.
definition_zh: 非法绑架某人并将其扣为人质，尤其是为了索要赎金或其他报酬才将其释放
example_zh: 两名商人被恐怖分子绑架了。

definition: either of the two organs in the body that remove waste products from the blood and produce urine
example: a kidney infection
definition_zh: 人体内负责从血液中清除代谢废物并产生尿液的两个器官中的任何一个
example_zh: 肾脏感染

definition: to make somebody/something die
example: kill (somebody/something), Cancer kills thousands of people every year.
definition_zh: 导致某人/某物死亡
example_zh: 杀死（某人/某物），癌症每年夺走数千人的生命。

definition: an act of killing somebody deliberately
example: Their leader condemned the torture and killing of innocent civilians.
definition_zh: 故意杀害他人的行为
example_zh: 他们的领导人谴责了对无辜平民的酷刑和杀戮。

definition: a unit for measuring distance; 1 000 metres
example: The industrial estate is 6 kilometres from the city centre.
definition_zh: 一种距离单位；1 000 米
example_zh: 该工业园区距离市中心6公里。

definition: caring about others; gentle, friendly and generous
example: a very kind and helpful person
definition_zh: 关心他人；温和、友善且慷慨
example_zh: 一位非常友善且乐于助人的人

definition: a group of people or things that are the same in some way; a particular variety or type
example: kind of somebody/something, three kinds of cakes/cake
definition_zh: 在某些方面具有共同特征的一群人或事物；某种特定的种类或类型
example_zh: 某类人/某类事物，三种蛋糕/一种蛋糕

definition: the male ruler of an independent state that has a royal family
example: the kings and queens of England
definition_zh: 拥有王室的独立国家的男性统治者
example_zh: 英格兰的国王和女王

definition: a country that has a king or queen as head of state (= official leader of the country)
example: the United Kingdom
definition_zh: 一个以国王或女王为国家元首（=该国的正式领导人）的国家
example_zh: 英国

definition: the act of kissing somebody/something
example: Come here and give me a kiss!
definition_zh: 亲吻某人/某物的行为
example_zh: 过来，亲我一下！

definition: to touch somebody with your lips as a sign of love or sexual desire or when saying hello or goodbye
example: They stood in a doorway kissing (= kissing each other).
definition_zh: 用嘴唇轻触某人，以此表达爱意或性欲，或是在打招呼或道别时
example_zh: 他们站在门廊里接吻（=互相亲吻）。

definition: a set of tools or equipment that you use for a particular purpose
example: a first-aid kit
definition_zh: 用于特定目的的一套工具或设备
example_zh: 急救包

definition: a room in which meals are cooked or prepared
example: We ate at the kitchen table.
definition_zh: 用于烹饪或准备餐食的房间
example_zh: 我们在厨房的餐桌旁吃了饭。

definition: the joint between the top and bottom parts of the leg where it bends in the middle
example: a knee injury
definition_zh: 腿部上下两部分在中间弯曲处的接合处
example_zh: 膝盖受伤

definition: a sharp blade (= metal edge) with a handle, used for cutting or as a weapon
example: knives and forks
definition_zh: 带手柄的锋利刀片（=金属刃），用于切割或作为武器
example_zh: 刀叉

definition: the sound of somebody hitting a door, window, etc. with their hand or with something hard to attract attention
example: knock on/at something, There was a knock at the door.
definition_zh: 某人用手或硬物敲打门、窗等物体以引起注意的声音
example_zh: 敲某物，有人敲门。

definition: to hit a door, etc. in order to attract attention
example: He knocked three times and waited.
definition_zh: 拍打门等，以引起注意
example_zh: 他敲了三下门，然后等了一会儿。

definition: to have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it
example: know something, No one knows the answer.
definition_zh: 由于经验，或者因为学习或被告知，而将信息记在脑海中
example_zh: 知道些什么，其实谁都不知道答案。

definition: the information, understanding and skills that you gain through education or experience
example: scientific/technical knowledge and skills
definition_zh: 通过教育或经验获得的知识、理解和技能
example_zh: 科学技术知识和技能

definition: a laboratory
example: a computer/research lab
definition_zh: 一个实验室
example_zh: 计算机/研究实验室

definition: a piece of paper, etc. that is attached to something and that gives information about it
example: Always read the label carefully.
definition_zh: 一张纸等，附在某物上并提供有关该物信息的
example_zh: 请务必仔细阅读标签。

definition: to fix a label on something or write information on something
example: label something, Make sure that your luggage is clearly labelled.
definition_zh: 在某物上贴标签或在某物上写下信息
example_zh: 贴上标签，请确保您的行李上贴有清晰的标签。

definition: a room or building used for scientific research, experiments, testing, etc.
example: a clinical/research laboratory
definition_zh: 用于科学研究、实验、测试等的房间或建筑物。
example_zh: 临床/研究实验室

definition: work, especially physical work
example: manual labour (= work using your hands)
definition_zh: 工作，尤其是体力劳动
example_zh: 体力劳动（即用手进行的工作）

definition: the state of not having something or not having enough of something
example: lack of something, a lack of understanding/knowledge
definition_zh: 没有某物或某物不足的状态
example_zh: 某物的缺乏，理解或知识的缺乏

definition: to have none or not enough of something
example: to lack confidence/experience/resources/power
definition_zh: 没有某样东西，或者某样东西不够
example_zh: 缺乏信心/经验/资源/权力

definition: a boy or young man
example: Things have changed since I was a lad.
definition_zh: 男孩或年轻男子
example_zh: 自从我还是个小伙子的时候起，情况就变了。

definition: a piece of equipment for climbing up and down a wall, the side of a building, etc., consisting of two lengths of wood or metal that are joined together by steps or rungs
example: to climb up/fall off a ladder
definition_zh: 一种用于攀爬或下墙、建筑物外墙等的设备，由两根木条或金属条组成，其间通过台阶或横档连接而成
example_zh: 爬上/从梯子上摔下来

definition: a word used to mean ‘woman’ that some people, especially older people, consider is more polite
example: There's a lady waiting to see you.
definition_zh: 一个用来指代“女性”的词，有些人（尤其是老年人）认为它更礼貌
example_zh: 有一位女士在等您。

definition: a large area of water that is surrounded by land
example: in a lake, We swam in the lake.
definition_zh: 一片被陆地环绕的广阔水域
example_zh: 在湖里，我们在湖里游泳。

definition: a device that uses electricity, oil or gas to produce light
example: a desk/bedside lamp
definition_zh: 一种利用电力、石油或天然气来发光设备
example_zh: 台灯/床头灯

definition: the surface of the earth that is not sea
example: The new project will reclaim the land from the sea.
definition_zh: 地球上除海洋以外的陆地
example_zh: 这个新项目将从海中填海造地。

definition: to come down through the air onto the ground or another surface
example: The plane landed safely.
definition_zh: 从空中降落到地面或其他表面上
example_zh: 飞机安全降落了。

definition: an act of bringing an aircraft or a spacecraft down to the ground after a journey
example: a perfect/smooth/safe landing
definition_zh: 指飞行器或航天器在完成飞行后降落至地面的过程
example_zh: 一次完美/平稳/安全的着陆

definition: a person or company from whom you rent a room, a house, an office, etc.
example: a buy-to-let landlord (= who buys houses and flats in order to rent them out)
definition_zh: 指向其租住房间、房屋、办公室等的人或公司。
example_zh: 买房出租的房东（即购买房屋和公寓以便出租的人）

definition: something, such as a large building, that you can see clearly from a distance and that will help you to know where you are
example: The Empire State Building is a familiar landmark on the New York skyline.
definition_zh: 某样东西，比如一栋大型建筑，你可以在远处清晰地看到它，并且它能帮助你确定自己的位置
example_zh: 帝国大厦是纽约天际线上一处耳熟能详的地标。

definition: everything you can see when you look across a large area of land, especially in the country
example: the woods and fields that are typical features of the English landscape
definition_zh: 放眼望去，在广阔的土地上所能看到的一切，尤其是在乡下
example_zh: 作为英格兰风景典型特征的树林和田野

definition: a narrow road in the country
example: winding country lanes
definition_zh: 乡间的一条狭窄小路
example_zh: 蜿蜒的乡村小路

definition: the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area
example: the English language
definition_zh: 某个国家或地区的人们所使用的口头和书面交流体系
example_zh: 英语

definition: the top part of your legs that forms a flat surface when you are sitting down
example: on somebody's lap, There's only one seat so you'll have to sit on my lap.
definition_zh: 坐下时，大腿上部形成的一片平坦区域
example_zh: 坐在某人的腿上，只有一个座位，所以你得坐在我腿上。

definition: a small computer that can work with a battery and be easily carried
example: I opened my laptop and started typing.
definition_zh: 一种可使用电池供电且便于携带的小型计算机
example_zh: 我打开笔记本电脑，开始打字。

definition: big in size or quantity
example: a large group/city/area/crowd/family
definition_zh: 体积或数量很大
example_zh: 一大群人/城市/地区/人群/家庭

definition: involving many people or things, especially over a wide area
example: Large areas of the forest will be cleared for ranching as part of a large-scale development plan.
definition_zh: 涉及许多人或事物，尤其是在广阔的范围内
example_zh: 作为一项大规模开发计划的一部分，大片森林将被砍伐，用于发展牧场。

definition: to a great extent; mostly or mainly
example: The manager was largely responsible for the team’s victory.
definition_zh: 在很大程度上；大多或主要是
example_zh: 这支球队的胜利主要归功于主教练。

definition: a device that gives out light in which all the waves oscillate (= change direction and strength) together, typically producing a powerful beam of light that can be used for cutting metal, in medical operations, etc.
example: a laser beam
definition_zh: 一种发光装置，其中所有波都同步振荡（即同时改变方向和强度），通常能产生强光束，可用于切割金属、医疗手术等。
example_zh: 一束激光

definition: after anyone or anything else; at the end
example: He came last in the race.
definition_zh: 在任何人或任何事物之后；最后
example_zh: 他在比赛中垫底。

definition: happening or coming after all other similar things or people
example: We caught the last bus home.
definition_zh: 发生在所有其他类似事物或人之后，或者紧随其后
example_zh: 我们赶上了回家的末班车。

definition: the person or thing that comes or happens after all other similar people or things
example: Sorry I'm late—am I the last?
definition_zh: 在所有其他类似的人或事物之后出现或发生的人或事物
example_zh: 抱歉我来晚了——我是最后一个吗？

definition: to continue for a particular period of time
example: Each game lasts about an hour.
definition_zh: 在特定时间段内继续
example_zh: 每场比赛大约持续一个小时。

definition: arriving, happening or done after the expected, arranged or usual time
example: I'm sorry I'm late.
definition_zh: 在预期、约定或通常时间之后到达、发生或完成
example_zh: 抱歉我来晚了。

definition: after the expected, arranged or usual time
example: I got up late.
definition_zh: 在预期、约定或通常的时间之后
example_zh: 我起得很晚。

definition: recently; in the recent past
example: Have you seen her lately?
definition_zh: 最近；在不久前
example_zh: 最近见过她吗？

definition: coming after something else or at a time in the future
example: Rembrandt's later works
definition_zh: 紧随其后，或发生在未来的某个时间点
example_zh: 伦勃朗的晚期作品

definition: at a time in the future; after the time you are talking about
example: See you later.
definition_zh: 在未来的某个时候；在你所说的那个时间之后
example_zh: 回头见。

definition: the most recent or newest
example: the latest craze/fashion/trend
definition_zh: 最新的
example_zh: 最新的热潮/时尚/潮流

definition: the most recent or the newest thing or piece of news
example: the latest (in something), This is the latest in robot technology.
definition_zh: 最新或最前期的事情或新闻
example_zh: （某领域的）最新，这是机器人技术的最新成果。

definition: used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned
example: He chose the latter option.
definition_zh: 用于指代所提到的两件事或两人中的第二件或第二人
example_zh: 他选择了后一种方案。

definition: the second of two things or people mentioned
example: He presented two solutions. The latter seems much better.
definition_zh: 所提到的两件事或两人中的第二件或第二人
example_zh: 他提出了两种解决方案。后一种似乎要好得多。

definition: the sound you make when you think that something is funny or silly
example: to give a laugh
definition_zh: 当你觉得某件事好笑或傻气时发出的声音
example_zh: 逗人发笑

definition: to make the sounds and movements of your face that show you think something is funny or silly
example: to laugh out loud
definition_zh: 做出能表达你觉得某件事好笑或傻气的面部表情和动作
example_zh: 开怀大笑

definition: the act or sound of laughing
example: to roar/howl with laughter
definition_zh: 笑的动作或声音
example_zh: 笑得前仰后合

definition: the action of launching something
example: a missile/rocket launch
definition_zh: 发射某物的动作
example_zh: 导弹/火箭发射

definition: to start an activity, especially an organized one
example: The government recently launched a national road safety campaign.
definition_zh: 开展一项活动，尤其是有组织的活动
example_zh: 政府最近发起了一项全国性的道路安全宣传活动。

definition: a rule that deals with a particular crime, agreement, etc.
example: to pass a law (= officially make it part of the system of laws)
definition_zh: 一项针对特定犯罪、协议等的规定。
example_zh: 通过一项法律（即正式将其纳入法律体系）

definition: an area of ground covered in short grass in a garden or park, or used for playing a game on
example: In summer we have to mow the lawn twice a week.
definition_zh: 花园或公园中一片长着短草的地面，或用于进行体育活动的场地
example_zh: 夏天我们每周要割两次草。

definition: a claim or complaint against somebody that a person or an organization can make in court
example: He filed a lawsuit against his record label.
definition_zh: 个人或组织可在法庭上针对某人提出的索赔或投诉
example_zh: 他对自己的唱片公司提起了诉讼。

definition: a person who is trained and qualified to advise people about the law and to represent them in court, and to write legal documents
example: to hire a lawyer
definition_zh: 指受过专业培训且具备相应资格，能够就法律问题向他人提供咨询、在法庭上代理当事人，并起草法律文件的人
example_zh: 聘请律师

definition: to put somebody/something in a particular position, especially when it is done gently or carefully
example: lay somebody/something + adv./prep., He laid a hand on my arm.
definition_zh: 将某人/某物置于特定位置，尤其是以温和或谨慎的方式进行时
example_zh: 将某人/某物 + 副词/介词，他把手搭在我的胳膊上。

definition: a quantity or sheet of something that lies over a surface or between surfaces
example: layer (of something), A thin layer of dust covered everything.
definition_zh: 覆盖在某个表面上或位于两个表面之间的某物的一定数量或一张
example_zh: （某物的）一层，一层薄薄的灰尘覆盖了所有东西。

definition: the way in which the parts of something such as the page of a book, a website, a garden or a building are arranged
example: the layout of streets
definition_zh: 某事物（如书页、网站、花园或建筑物）各部分的排列方式
example_zh: 街道布局

definition: unwilling to work or be active; doing as little as possible
example: He was not stupid, just lazy.
definition_zh: 不愿工作或活动；尽量少做点事
example_zh: 他并不笨，只是懒而已。

definition: the position of being ahead of others in a competition or activity
example: Our team took the lead in the second half.
definition_zh: 在竞争或活动中领先于他人的地位
example_zh: 下半场，我们队取得了领先。

definition: to go with or in front of a person or an animal to show the way or to make them go in the right direction
example: If you lead, I'll follow.
definition_zh: 走在人或动物前面，或与人或动物同行，以指引方向或引导其朝正确方向前进
example_zh: 如果你带头，我就跟上。

definition: a person who leads a group of people, especially the head of a country, an organization, etc.
example: party/world leaders
definition_zh: 领导一群人的一个人，尤其是国家、组织等的负责人。
example_zh: 政党/世界领导人

definition: the state or position of being a leader
example: a leadership role/position
definition_zh: 作为领导者的状态或地位
example_zh: 领导角色/职位

definition: most important or most successful
example: a leading expert/authority/figure/member
definition_zh: 最重要的或最成功的
example_zh: 一位顶尖专家/权威人士/重要人物/成员

definition: a flat green part of a plant, growing from a stem or branch or from the root
example: lettuce/cabbage/oak leaves
definition_zh: 植物上从茎、枝或根部长出的扁平绿色部分
example_zh: 生菜/卷心菜/橡叶生菜

definition: a printed sheet of paper or a few printed pages that are given free to advertise or give information about something
example: We picked up a few leaflets on local places of interest.
definition_zh: 一张或几张印有文字的纸张，免费分发以宣传或提供有关某事的信息
example_zh: 我们拿了几份关于当地景点的小册子。

definition: a group of sports teams who all play each other to earn points and find which team is best
example: Castleford have led the league for most of the season.
definition_zh: 由多支运动队组成的一组，这些队伍相互比赛以获得积分，并决出哪支队伍最强
example_zh: 卡斯尔福德在本赛季的大部分时间里都领跑联赛。

definition: a small hole that lets liquid or gas flow in or out of something by accident
example: a leak in the roof
definition_zh: 一个小孔，使液体或气体意外地流入或流出某物
example_zh: 屋顶漏水

definition: to allow liquid or gas to get in or out through a small hole
example: a leaking pipe
definition_zh: 使液体或气体能通过一个小孔进入或流出
example_zh: 一条漏水的管道

definition: to bend or move from a straight position to a sloping position
example: I leaned back in my chair.
definition_zh: 从笔直的状态弯曲或移动到倾斜的状态
example_zh: 我向后靠在椅子上。

definition: a long or high jump
example: a leap of six metres
definition_zh: 一次跳得很远或很高的动作
example_zh: 六米的跳跃

definition: to jump high or a long way
example: + adv./prep., A dolphin leapt out of the water.
definition_zh: 跳得高或跳得远
example_zh: + 副词/介词，一只海豚从水中跃出。

definition: to gain knowledge or skill by studying, from experience, from being taught, etc.
example: learn something, to learn a language/skill/trade
definition_zh: 通过学习、实践、受教等方式获得知识或技能。
example_zh: 学点东西，学习一门语言/技能/手艺

definition: the process of learning something
example: lifelong/adult learning
definition_zh: 学习某事的过程
example_zh: 终身学习/成人学习

definition: to the smallest degree
example: He always turns up just when you least expect him.
definition_zh: 哪怕是一点点
example_zh: 他总是会在你最意想不到的时候出现。

definition: smallest in size, amount, degree, etc.
example: He's the best teacher, even though he has the least experience.
definition_zh: 在大小、数量、程度等方面最小的。
example_zh: 虽然他经验最少，但他却是最棒的老师。

definition: smallest in size, amount, degree, etc.
example: He's the best teacher, even though he has the least experience.
definition_zh: 在大小、数量、程度等方面最小的。
example_zh: 虽然他经验最少，但他却是最棒的老师。

definition: material made by removing the hair or fur from animal skins and preserving the skins using special processes
example: a leather jacket
definition_zh: 通过去除动物皮毛，并采用特殊工艺对皮革进行防腐处理而制成的材料
example_zh: 一件皮夹克

definition: a period of time when you are allowed to be away from work for a holiday or for a special reason
example: to take a month’s paid/unpaid leave
definition_zh: 因休假或特殊原因而获准暂时离开工作岗位的一段时间
example_zh: 休一个月带薪/无薪假

definition: to go away from a person or a place
example: Come on, it's time we left (= time for us to leave).
definition_zh: 离开某人或某地
example_zh: 来吧，该走了（= 我们该走了）。

definition: a talk that is given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course
example: to go to/attend a lecture
definition_zh: 面向一群人进行的演讲，旨在向他们讲授某个特定主题，通常作为大学或学院课程的一部分
example_zh: 去听讲座/参加讲座

definition: to give a talk or a series of talks to a group of people on a subject, especially as a way of teaching in a university or college
example: He has taught and lectured at the University of Pretoria.
definition_zh: 就某个主题向一群人做一次或一系列讲座，尤其是作为大学或学院的教学方式
example_zh: 他曾在比勒陀利亚大学任教并做过讲座。

definition: on the side of your body that is towards the west when you are facing north
example: Fewer people write with their left hand than with their right.
definition_zh: 当你面向北方时，身体朝向西侧的那一边
example_zh: 用左手写字的人比用右手写字的人少。

definition: on or to the left side
example: Turn left at the intersection.
definition_zh: 在……上或左侧
example_zh: 在十字路口向左转。

definition: the left side or direction
example: on the left, Take the next road on the left.
definition_zh: 左侧或方向
example_zh: 在左侧，沿左侧下一条路前行。

definition: one of the long parts that connect the feet to the rest of the body
example: Sit on the floor, stretching your legs out in front of you.
definition_zh: 连接脚与身体其他部位的较长部分之一
example_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿向前伸直。

definition: money or property that is given to you by somebody when they die
example: They each received a legacy of $5 000.
definition_zh: 某人去世后留给你的钱或财产
example_zh: 他们每人获得了一笔5 000美元的遗产。

definition: connected with the law
example: the legal profession/system
definition_zh: 与法律有关
example_zh: 法律职业/法律体系

definition: a story from ancient times about people and events, that may or may not be true; this type of story
example: The film is based on the legend of Robin Hood.
definition_zh: 一个关于古时人物和事件的故事，其真实性尚无定论；这类故事
example_zh: 这部电影改编自罗宾汉的传说。

definition: very famous and talked about a lot by people
example: a legendary figure
definition_zh: 非常有名，大家都在热议
example_zh: 一位传奇人物

definition: a law or a set of laws passed by a parliament
example: an important piece of legislation
definition_zh: 议会通过的一项法律或一系列法律
example_zh: 一项重要的立法

definition: connected with the act of making and passing laws
example: a legislative assembly/body/council
definition_zh: 与制定和通过法律的行为有关
example_zh: 立法议会/机构/委员会

definition: a group of people who have the power to make and change laws
example: a democratically elected legislature
definition_zh: 一群有权制定和修改法律的人
example_zh: 一个经民主选举产生的立法机构

definition: for which there is a fair and acceptable reason
example: a legitimate grievance
definition_zh: 对此有正当且合理的理由
example_zh: 正当的申诉

definition: time when you are not working or studying; free time
example: These days we have more money and more leisure to enjoy it.
definition_zh: 不工作或不学习的时候；空闲时间
example_zh: 如今，我们不仅手头宽裕，而且有更多的闲暇时间来享受生活。

definition: a yellow citrus fruit with juice that has a bitter, sharp taste. Slices of lemon and lemon juice are used in cooking and drinks.
example: Add a squeeze of lemon juice.
definition_zh: 一种黄色的柑橘类水果，其果汁味道苦涩、辛辣。柠檬片和柠檬汁常用于烹饪和调制饮料。
example_zh: 挤入少许柠檬汁。

definition: to give something to somebody or allow them to use something that belongs to you, which they have to return to you later
example: lend something, They will lend equipment free of charge.
definition_zh: 把某样东西送给某人，或允许对方使用属于你的东西，但对方日后必须归还给你
example_zh: 借点东西，他们会免费出借设备。

definition: the size or measurement of something from one end to the other
example: Measure the length of the line from A to B.
definition_zh: 某物从一端到另一端的尺寸或长度
example_zh: 测量从A到B的线段长度。

definition: very long, and often too long, in time or size
example: lengthy delays
definition_zh: 非常长，而且往往过长，无论是时间上还是篇幅上
example_zh: 长时间的延误

definition: a curved piece of glass or plastic that makes things look larger, smaller or clearer when you look through it
example: a pair of glasses with tinted lenses
definition_zh: 一块弯曲的玻璃或塑料片，透过它看，物体会显得更大、更小或更清晰
example_zh: 一副带色镜片的眼镜

definition: sexually attracted to other women; connected with lesbians
example: the lesbian and gay community
definition_zh: 对其他女性产生性吸引力；与女同性恋者有关
example_zh: 女同性恋和男同性恋群体

definition: to a smaller degree; not so much
example: less expensive/likely/intelligent
definition_zh: 程度较轻；没那么明显
example_zh: 更便宜/更可能/更聪明

definition: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a smaller amount of’
example: less something, less butter/time/importance
definition_zh: 用于不可数名词，表示“少量”
example_zh: 少一点什么，少一点黄油/时间/重要性

definition: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a smaller amount of’
example: less something, less butter/time/importance
definition_zh: 用于不可数名词，表示“少量”
example_zh: 少一点什么，少一点黄油/时间/重要性

definition: not as great in size, amount or importance as something/somebody else
example: people of lesser importance
definition_zh: 在规模、数量或重要性上都不如某物/某人
example_zh: 地位较低的人

definition: a period of time in which somebody is taught something
example: She gives piano lessons.
definition_zh: 某人接受某项知识或技能培训的一段时间
example_zh: 她教钢琴课。

definition: used for making suggestions or as a polite way of telling people what you want them to do
example: ‘Shall we check it again?’ ‘Yes, let's.’
definition_zh: 用于提出建议，或作为一种礼貌的方式来告诉别人你希望他们做什么
example_zh: “我们再检查一下好吗？”“好，我们再检查一下吧。”

definition: causing or able to cause death
example: She had been given a lethal dose of poison.
definition_zh: 导致或可能导致死亡
example_zh: 她被喂食了致命剂量的毒药。

definition: a written, typed or printed message that is put in an envelope or attached to an email and sent to somebody
example: to write/send (somebody) a letter
definition_zh: 写在纸上、打字或打印的讯息，装入信封或作为电子邮件附件发送给某人
example_zh: 给（某人）写/寄一封信

definition: having a flat surface that does not slope
example: Pitch the tent on level ground.
definition_zh: 表面平坦，无坡度
example_zh: 请在平坦的地面上搭帐篷。

definition: the height of something in relation to the ground or to what it used to be
example: The cables are buried one metre below ground level.
definition_zh: 某物相对于地面或相对于其原有高度的高度
example_zh: 这些电缆埋在地下一米深处。

definition: to make something flat or smooth
example: level something out, The first coat of plaster levels out the surface of the wall.
definition_zh: 使某物变得平整或光滑
example_zh: 将某物抹平，第一层石膏可将墙面抹平。

definition: legally responsible for paying the cost of something
example: You will be liable for any damage caused.
definition_zh: 依法有责任支付某项费用
example_zh: 您将对造成的任何损失承担责任。

definition: willing to understand and respect other people’s behaviour, opinions, etc., especially when they are different from your own; believing people should be able to choose how they behave
example: liberal attitudes/views/opinions
definition_zh: 愿意理解和尊重他人的行为、观点等，尤其是当这些与自己的不同时；认为人们应该能够自主选择自己的行为方式
example_zh: 自由主义的态度/观点/看法

definition: a person who understands and respects other people’s opinions and behaviour, especially when they are different from their own
example: He liked to think of himself as a liberal.
definition_zh: 能够理解并尊重他人观点和行为的人，尤其是当这些观点和行为与自己不同时
example_zh: 他喜欢把自己视为一名自由派。

definition: the act or process of freeing a country or a person from the control of somebody else
example: a war of liberation
definition_zh: 使一个国家或一个人摆脱他人控制的行为或过程
example_zh: 一场解放战争

definition: freedom to live as you choose without too many limits from government or authority
example: the fight for justice and liberty
definition_zh: 自由地按照自己的意愿生活，不受政府或当局过多限制
example_zh: 为正义与自由而战

definition: a building in which collections of books, newspapers, etc. and sometimes films and recorded music are kept for people to read, study or borrow
example: a public/university/school library
definition_zh: 一座用于收藏书籍、报纸等，有时还收藏电影和录音资料，供人们阅读、研究或借阅的建筑
example_zh: 公共图书馆/大学图书馆/学校图书馆

definition: an official document that shows that permission has been given to do, own or use something
example: Applicants must hold a valid driving licence.
definition_zh: 一份证明已获准从事、拥有或使用某事的官方文件
example_zh: 申请人必须持有有效的驾驶证。

definition: to give somebody official permission to do, own, or use something
example: license something, The new drug has not yet been licensed in the US.
definition_zh: 授予某人从事、拥有或使用某物的正式许可
example_zh: 某物获得许可，这种新药尚未在美国获得许可。

definition: a statement made by somebody knowing that it is not true
example: to tell a lie
definition_zh: 某人明知某事不属实却仍所作的陈述
example_zh: 说谎

definition: to be or put yourself in a flat position so that you are not standing or sitting
example: lie + adv./prep., to lie on your back/side/front
definition_zh: 保持或让自己处于平躺的姿势，即既不站立也不坐着
example_zh: lie + 副词/介词，指仰卧/侧卧/俯卧

definition: to say or write something that you know is not true
example: You could see from his face that he was lying.
definition_zh: 明知某事不真实，却仍说或写出来
example_zh: 从他的表情就能看出来，他在说谎。

definition: the ability to breathe, grow, produce young, etc. that people, animals and plants have before they die and that objects do not have
example: This could mean the difference between life and death.
definition_zh: 人类、动物和植物在死亡之前所具备的、而物体所不具备的呼吸、生长、繁殖等能力
example_zh: 这可能关乎生死。

definition: lasting or existing all through your life
example: Paul became his lifelong friend.
definition_zh: 贯穿你的一生
example_zh: 保罗成了他一生的挚友。

definition: the way in which a person or a group of people lives and works
example: Many people are trying to adopt a healthy lifestyle these days.
definition_zh: 一个人或一群人的生活和工作方式
example_zh: 如今，许多人都在努力养成健康的生活方式。

definition: the length of time that somebody lives or that something lasts
example: a lifetime of experience
definition_zh: 某人活着的时间长度，或某物持续的时间长度
example_zh: 一生的经验

definition: a machine that carries people or goods up and down to different levels in a building or a mine
example: It's on the sixth floor—let's take the lift.
definition_zh: 一种将人员或货物运送至建筑物或矿井内不同楼层或层位的机器
example_zh: 它在六楼——我们坐电梯上去吧。

definition: to raise somebody/something or be raised to a higher position or level
example: lift somebody/something, I lifted the lid of the box and peered in.
definition_zh: 将某人/某物提拔至更高的职位或级别，或被提拔至更高的职位或级别
example_zh: 抬起某人/某物，我掀开盒盖往里张望。

definition: pale in colour
example: He's got light blue eyes.
definition_zh: 颜色浅
example_zh: 他有一双浅蓝色的眼睛。

definition: the energy from the sun, a lamp, etc. that makes it possible to see things
example: bright/dim light
definition_zh: 来自太阳、灯等光源的能量，使人们能够看清事物
example_zh: 亮光/暗光

definition: to make something start to burn
example: She lit a candle.
definition_zh: 使某物开始燃烧
example_zh: 她点了一支蜡烛。

definition: the arrangement or type of light in a place
example: electric/natural lighting
definition_zh: 某处灯光的布置或类型
example_zh: 人工照明/自然采光

definition: the things that you like
example: We all have different likes and dislikes.
definition_zh: 你喜欢的东西
example_zh: 我们每个人都有不同的喜好。

definition: similar to somebody/something
example: She's wearing a dress like mine.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物相似
example_zh: 她穿的裙子跟我的一样。

definition: to find somebody/something pleasant, attractive or of a good enough standard; to enjoy something
example: like somebody/something, She's nice. I like her.
definition_zh: 觉得某人/某物令人愉快、有吸引力或水平足够高；对某事感到满意
example_zh: 喜欢某人/某事，她人很好。我喜欢她。

definition: the chance of something happening; how likely something is to happen
example: There is very little likelihood of that happening.
definition_zh: 某事发生的可能性；某事发生的概率
example_zh: 这种情况发生的可能性非常小。

definition: having a good chance of happening or being something; probable or expected
example: the most likely explanation/outcome/scenario
definition_zh: 很有可能发生或成为某种情况；可能的或预期的
example_zh: 最可能的解释/结果/情况

definition: the same; in a similar way
example: He voted for the change and he expected his colleagues to do likewise.
definition_zh: 一样；以类似的方式
example_zh: 他投票支持这项变更，并希望他的同事们也能这样做。

definition: an arm or a leg; a similar part of an animal, such as a wing
example: an artificial limb
definition_zh: 一只胳膊或一条腿；动物的类似部位，例如翅膀
example_zh: 假肢

definition: the greatest or smallest amount of something that is allowed
example: They imposed a strict spending limit.
definition_zh: 某事物允许的最大或最小数量
example_zh: 他们制定了严格的开支限额。

definition: to stop something from increasing beyond a particular amount or level
example: measures to limit carbon dioxide emissions
definition_zh: 防止某事物超过特定数量或水平而继续增加
example_zh: 限制二氧化碳排放的措施

definition: the act or process of limiting or controlling somebody/something
example: They would resist any limitation of their powers.
definition_zh: 限制或控制某人/某事的行为或过程
example_zh: 他们会抵制任何对其权力的限制。

definition: not very great in amount or extent
example: We are doing our best with the limited resources available.
definition_zh: 数量或范围都不大
example_zh: 在现有有限资源的条件下，我们正在尽最大努力。

definition: a long, thin mark on a surface
example: a straight/solid/dotted/dashed line
definition_zh: 表面上的一道细长的痕迹
example_zh: 实线/虚线/点线/破折线

definition: to cover the inside of something with a layer of another material, especially to keep it clean or make it stronger
example: Butter and line a 25 cm cake tin.
definition_zh: 用另一层材料覆盖某物的内侧，尤其是为了保持其清洁或增强其强度
example_zh: 在25厘米的蛋糕模具内涂抹黄油并铺上烘焙纸。

definition: the people who are going to take part in a particular event
example: an impressive line-up of speakers
definition_zh: 将参加某项活动的人
example_zh: 阵容强大的演讲嘉宾

definition: of or in lines
example: In his art he broke the laws of scientific linear perspective.
definition_zh: 关于或涉及线路的
example_zh: 在他的艺术作品中，他打破了科学透视法的规则。

definition: to continue to exist for longer than expected
example: The faint smell of her perfume lingered in the room.
definition_zh: 比预期存续更久
example_zh: 她香水那淡淡的香气在房间里萦绕不散。

definition: a connection between two or more people or things
example: link between A and B, Police suspect there may be a link between the two murders.
definition_zh: 两个人或事物之间的联系
example_zh: A与B之间的关联，警方怀疑这两起谋杀案之间可能存在关联。

definition: to make a physical or electronic connection between one object, machine, place, etc. and another
example: link A to B, The video cameras are linked to a powerful computer.
definition_zh: 在某个物体、机器、地点等与另一个之间建立物理或电子连接
example_zh: 将A与B连接起来，这些摄像机与一台高性能计算机相连。

definition: a large, powerful animal of the cat family that hunts in groups and lives in parts of Africa and southern Asia. Lions have yellow-brown fur and the male has a mane (= long, thick hair round its neck).
example: The lion shook its mane and roared.
definition_zh: 猫科的一种体型庞大、力量强大的动物，通常群居狩猎，栖息于非洲和南亚的部分地区。狮子身上长着黄褐色的皮毛，雄狮颈部周围长有鬃毛（即颈部周围长而浓密的毛发）。
example_zh: 狮子抖了抖鬃毛，发出了一声咆哮。

definition: either of the two soft edges at the opening to the mouth
example: The assistant pursed her lips.
definition_zh: 口腔开口处的两个软腭中的任意一个
example_zh: 那位助理抿了抿嘴唇。

definition: in the form of a liquid; not a solid or a gas
example: liquid nitrogen
definition_zh: 呈液体状态；既非固体也非气体
example_zh: 液氮

definition: a substance that flows freely and is not a solid or a gas, for example water or oil
example: She poured the dark brown liquid down the sink.
definition_zh: 一种能够自由流动、既非固体也非气体的物质，例如水或油
example_zh: 她把那深褐色的液体倒进了水槽。

definition: a series of names, items, figures, etc., especially when they are written or printed
example: The guest list includes numerous celebrities.
definition_zh: 一系列名称、项目、数字等，尤其是以书写或印刷形式呈现时
example_zh: 宾客名单上包括众多名人。

definition: to write a list of things in a particular order
example: We were asked to list our ten favourite songs.
definition_zh: 按特定顺序列出一份清单
example_zh: 有人让我们列出自己最喜欢的十首歌。

definition: to pay attention to somebody/something that you can hear
example: Listen! What's that noise? Can you hear it?
definition_zh: 留意你能听到的某人或某事
example_zh: 听！那是什么声音？你听到了吗？

definition: a person who listens
example: a good listener (= somebody who you can rely on to listen with attention or sympathy)
definition_zh: 一个善于倾听的人
example_zh: 善于倾听的人（= 值得信赖、能专注且富有同情心地倾听的人）

definition: a list, especially an official or published list of people or things, often arranged in alphabetical order
example: a comprehensive listing of all airlines
definition_zh: 一份清单，尤其是关于人物或事物的官方或公开发布的清单，通常按字母顺序排列
example_zh: 所有航空公司的完整列表

definition: the ability to read and write
example: a campaign to promote adult literacy
definition_zh: 读写能力
example_zh: 一项旨在提高成人识字率的活动

definition: in a literal way
example: The word ‘planet’ literally means ‘wandering body’.
definition_zh: 从字面意义上说
example_zh: “行星”一词的字面意思是“游移的天体”。

definition: connected with literature
example: literary criticism/theory
definition_zh: 与文学有关
example_zh: 文学批评/理论

definition: pieces of writing that are valued as works of art, especially novels, plays and poems (in contrast to technical books and newspapers, magazines, etc.)
example: English/American/French literature
definition_zh: 被视为艺术作品的文学作品，尤其是小说、戏剧和诗歌（与技术类书籍、报纸、杂志等相对）
example_zh: 英国/美国/法国文学

definition: a unit for measuring volume, equal to 1.76 British pints or 2.11 American pints
example: 3 litres of water
definition_zh: 一种体积单位，等于1.76英制品脱或2.11美制品脱
example_zh: 3升水

definition: small pieces of rubbish such as paper, cans and bottles, that people have left lying in a public place
example: There will be fines for people who drop litter.
definition_zh: 人们随意丢弃在公共场所的小块垃圾，例如纸张、易拉罐和瓶子等
example_zh: 乱扔垃圾者将被处以罚款。

definition: not big; small; smaller than others
example: a little house
definition_zh: 不大；小；比其他的小
example_zh: 一间小房子

definition: to a small degree
example: She seemed a little afraid of going inside.
definition_zh: 在一定程度上
example_zh: 她似乎有点害怕进去。

definition: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a small amount’, ‘some’
example: a little milk/sugar/tea
definition_zh: 用于不可数名词，表示“少量”、“一些”
example_zh: 一点牛奶/糖/茶

definition: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a small amount’, ‘some’
example: a little milk/sugar/tea
definition_zh: 用于不可数名词，表示“少量”、“一些”
example_zh: 一点牛奶/糖/茶

definition: living; not dead
example: live animals
definition_zh: 活着；没有死
example_zh: 活体动物

definition: broadcast at the time of an actual event; played or recorded at an actual performance
example: The show is going out live.
definition_zh: 在实际事件发生时进行直播；在实际演出中播放或录制
example_zh: 节目正在直播。

definition: to have your home in a particular place
example: to live in a house/a flat/an apartment
definition_zh: 在某个地方安家
example_zh: 住在一栋房子里/一间公寓里

definition: full of life and energy; active and enthusiastic
example: an intelligent and lively young woman
definition_zh: 充满活力和朝气；积极向上、热情洋溢
example_zh: 一位聪明活泼的年轻女子

definition: a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile
example: liver disease
definition_zh: 人体内一个大型器官，负责净化血液并分泌胆汁
example_zh: 肝病

definition: alive now
example: all living things
definition_zh: 现在还活着
example_zh: 所有生物

definition: money to buy the things that you need in life
example: She earns her living as a freelance journalist.
definition_zh: 买生活必需品的钱
example_zh: 她靠做自由撰稿人谋生。

definition: something that is being carried (usually in large amounts) by a person, vehicle, etc.
example: The trucks waited at the warehouse to pick up their loads.
definition_zh: 由人、车辆等（通常是大量）所运载的物品。
example_zh: 卡车们在仓库里等待装货。

definition: to put a large quantity of things or people onto or into something
example: load something, We loaded the car in ten minutes.
definition_zh: 将大量物品或人放进或装进某物中
example_zh: 装点东西，我们十分钟就装好了车。

definition: money that an organization such as a bank lends and somebody borrows
example: to take out/repay a loan (= to borrow money/pay it back)
definition_zh: 银行等机构放贷、某人借入的资金
example_zh: 申请/偿还贷款（= 借钱/还钱）

definition: a large area inside the entrance of a public building where people can meet and wait
example: a hotel lobby
definition_zh: 公共建筑入口处的一片宽敞区域，供人们在此聚会和等候
example_zh: 一家酒店的大堂

definition: to try to influence a politician or the government and, for example, persuade them to support or oppose a change in the law
example: Farmers will lobby Congress for higher subsidies.
definition_zh: 试图影响某位政界人士或政府，例如说服他们支持或反对某项法律的修改
example_zh: 农民将向国会游说，争取获得更高的补贴。

definition: belonging to or connected with the particular place or area that you are talking about or with the place where you live
example: local people/residents/businesses
definition_zh: 属于或与你正在谈论的特定地点或地区有关，或与你居住的地方有关
example_zh: 当地人/居民/企业

definition: a person who lives in a particular place or district
example: The locals are very friendly.
definition_zh: 居住在某个特定地方或地区的人
example_zh: 当地人非常友好。

definition: to find the exact position of somebody/something
example: The mechanic located the fault immediately.
definition_zh: 找出某人/某物的确切位置
example_zh: 修理工立刻查出了故障。

definition: if something is located in a particular place, it exists there or has been put there
example: a small town located 30 miles south of Chicago
definition_zh: 如果某物位于某个特定地方，说明它存在于那里，或者被放在那里
example_zh: 一个位于芝加哥以南30英里处的小镇

definition: a place where something happens or exists; the position of something
example: a honeymoon in a secret location
definition_zh: 某事发生或存在的地方；某物的所在位置
example_zh: 在神秘地点度蜜月

definition: a device that keeps a door, window, box, etc. shut, usually needing a key to open it
example: She turned the key in the lock.
definition_zh: 一种用于将门、窗、箱子等锁住的装置，通常需要钥匙才能打开
example_zh: 她把钥匙插进锁孔里转了转。

definition: to fasten something with a lock; to be fastened with a lock
example: Did you lock the door?
definition_zh: 用锁将某物锁住；被锁住
example_zh: 你把门锁上了吗？

definition: a thick piece of wood that is cut from or has fallen from a tree
example: logs for the fire
definition_zh: 从树上砍下或从树上掉落的一块厚木头
example_zh: 生火用的木柴

definition: to put information in an official record or write a record of events
example: The police log all phone calls.
definition_zh: 将信息载入正式记录或撰写事件记录
example_zh: 警方会记录所有电话通话。

definition: a way of thinking or explaining something
example: I fail to see the logic behind his argument.
definition_zh: 一种思考或解释事物的方式
example_zh: 我看不出来他这一论点的逻辑所在。

definition: seeming natural, reasonable or sensible
example: It was a logical conclusion from the child's point of view.
definition_zh: 看起来自然、合理或合情合理
example_zh: 从孩子的角度来看，这是一个合乎逻辑的结论。

definition: a printed design or symbol that a company or an organization uses as its special sign
example: All over the world there are red and white paper cups bearing the company logo.
definition_zh: 公司或组织用作其专属标志的印刷图案或符号
example_zh: 世界各地都能看到印有该公司标志的红白相间的纸杯。

definition: unhappy because you have no friends or people to talk to
example: She lives alone and often feels lonely.
definition_zh: 因为没有朋友或没有可以聊天的人而感到不开心
example_zh: 她独自生活，经常感到孤独。

definition: measuring or covering a great length or distance, or a greater length or distance than usual
example: She had long dark hair.
definition_zh: 指长度或距离很大，或比通常情况更长、更远
example_zh: 她有一头乌黑的长发。

definition: for a long time
example: Have you been here long?
definition_zh: 很长一段时间
example_zh: 你来这里多久了？

definition: that has existed or lasted for a long time
example: a long-standing relationship
definition_zh: 已经存在或持续了很长时间的
example_zh: 长期的合作关系

definition: lasting or having an effect over a long period of time
example: Our long-term goal is to lower operating costs by 10 per cent.
definition_zh: 持久的，或其影响持续较长时间的
example_zh: 我们的长期目标是将运营成本降低10%。

definition: over a long period of time
example: to benefit/affect somebody long-term
definition_zh: 在相当长的一段时间内
example_zh: 对某人产生长期的益处/影响

definition: having been the particular thing mentioned for a long time
example: his long-time colleague
definition_zh: 长期以来一直被提及的那个特定事物
example_zh: 他的老同事

definition: an act of looking at somebody/something
example: look at somebody/something, Here, have a look at this.
definition_zh: 注视某人/某物的行为
example_zh: 看看某人/某物，来，看看这个。

definition: to turn your eyes in a particular direction
example: Look closely and tell me what you see.
definition_zh: 将视线转向某个方向
example_zh: 仔细看看，然后告诉我你看到了什么。

definition: to appear as a large shape that is not clear, especially in a frightening way
example: A dark shape loomed up ahead of us.
definition_zh: 呈现为一个轮廓模糊的大形体，尤其是以一种令人恐惧的方式
example_zh: 前方浮现出一道黑影。

definition: a shape like a curve or circle made by a line curving right round
example: The road went in a huge loop around the lake.
definition_zh: 一条线向右弯曲形成的、类似曲线或圆形的形状
example_zh: 这条路绕着湖蜿蜒成一个巨大的环形。

definition: not securely fixed where it should be; able to become separated from something
example: a loose button/tooth
definition_zh: 未在应有的位置牢固固定；可能与某物脱离
example_zh: 一颗松动的纽扣/牙齿

definition: (in the UK) a man of high rank in the nobility (= people of high social class), or somebody who has been given the title ‘lord’ as an honour
example: She's married to a lord.
definition_zh: （在英国）贵族阶层中地位显赫的人（即社会地位较高的人），或因受封而获“勋爵”头衔的人
example_zh: 她嫁给了一位男爵。

definition: a large vehicle for carrying heavy loads by road
example: a lorry driver
definition_zh: 一种用于在公路上运输重物的重型车辆
example_zh: 一名卡车司机

definition: to be unable to find something/somebody
example: I've lost my keys.
definition_zh: 找不到某物/某人
example_zh: 我把钥匙弄丢了。

definition: the state of no longer having something or as much of something; the process that leads to this
example: I want to report the loss of a package.
definition_zh: 不再拥有某物或某物数量减少的状态；导致这种状态的过程
example_zh: 我想申报一个包裹丢失。

definition: unable to find your way; not knowing where you are
example: We always get lost in London.
definition_zh: 找不到路；不知道自己在哪里
example_zh: 我们在伦敦总是会迷路。

definition: used with verbs to mean ‘a great amount’
example: I care a lot about you.
definition_zh: 与动词连用时，表示“大量”
example_zh: 我非常在乎你。

definition: a large number or amount of somebody/something
example: What a lot of presents!
definition_zh: 大量的人或事物
example_zh: 礼物真多啊！

definition: a large number or amount
example: ‘How many do you need?’ ‘A lot.’
definition_zh: 大量或大数
example_zh: “你需要多少？”“很多。”

definition: a way of raising money for a government, charity, etc. by selling tickets that have different numbers on them that people have chosen. Numbers are then chosen by chance and the people who have those numbers on their tickets win prizes.
example: the national/state lottery
definition_zh: 一种为政府、慈善机构等筹集资金的方式，即出售印有不同号码的彩票，这些号码由参与者自行选择。随后通过随机抽取号码，持有中奖号码的彩票持有者即可获得奖品。
example_zh: 国家/州彩票

definition: making a lot of noise
example: loud laughter
definition_zh: 闹得沸沸扬扬
example_zh: 阵阵笑声

definition: in a way that makes a lot of noise or can be easily heard
example: Do you have to play that music so loud?
definition_zh: 以一种会发出很大声音或很容易被听见的方式
example_zh: 你非得把音乐放得那么大声吗？

definition: in a way that makes a lot of noise
example: She screamed as loudly as she could.
definition_zh: 以一种会发出很大噪音的方式
example_zh: 她拼命地尖叫起来。

definition: a very strong feeling of liking and caring for somebody/something, especially a member of your family or a friend
example: She has earned the love and respect of many people.
definition_zh: 对某人或某事——尤其是家人或朋友——怀有非常强烈的喜爱和关怀之情
example_zh: 她赢得了许多人的爱戴和尊重。

definition: to have very strong feelings of liking and caring for somebody
example: I love you.
definition_zh: 对某人怀有非常强烈的喜爱和关怀之情
example_zh: 我爱你。

definition: beautiful; attractive
example: She looked particularly lovely that night.
definition_zh: 美丽的；迷人的
example_zh: 那晚，她显得格外迷人。

definition: not high or tall; not far above the ground
example: a low wall/building/table
definition_zh: 不高；离地面不远
example_zh: 矮墙/建筑物/桌子

definition: in or into a low position, not far above the ground
example: to crouch/bend low
definition_zh: 处于或进入较低的位置，离地面不远
example_zh: 蹲下/弯腰

definition: a low level or point; a low figure
example: The temperature reached a record low in London last night.
definition_zh: 较低的水平或点位；较低的数值
example_zh: 昨晚伦敦的气温创下了历史新低。

definition: to reduce something or to become less in value, quality, etc.
example: lower something, He lowered his voice to a whisper.
definition_zh: 指某物减少，或其价值、质量等降低。
example_zh: “把……放低一点”，他压低了声音，轻声说道。

definition: remaining constant in your support of somebody/something
example: a loyal friend/supporter
definition_zh: 始终如一地支持某人/某事
example_zh: 一位忠实的朋友/支持者

definition: the quality of being constant in your support of somebody/something
example: Can I count on your loyalty?
definition_zh: 对某人或某事始终如一地给予支持的品质
example_zh: 我能指望你的忠诚吗？

definition: good things that happen to you by chance, not because of your own efforts or abilities
example: with (any) luck, With any luck, we'll be home before dark.
definition_zh: 那些偶然降临在你身上的好事，并非源于你自身的努力或能力
example_zh: 如果（有点）运气的话，如果运气好的话，天黑前我们就能到家了。

definition: having good luck
example: lucky to do something, His friend was killed and he knows he is lucky to be alive.
definition_zh: 运气好
example_zh: 能做点什么真是幸运，他的朋友遇害了，而他深知自己能活下来是何等幸运。

definition: a meal eaten in the middle of the day
example: She's gone to lunch.
definition_zh: 中午吃的一顿饭
example_zh: 她去吃午饭了。

definition: either of the two organs in the chest that you use for breathing
example: Her father died of lung cancer.
definition_zh: 胸腔内用于呼吸的两个器官中的任何一个
example_zh: 她的父亲死于肺癌。

definition: expensive and of very high quality
example: a luxury hotel/car/apartment
definition_zh: 价格昂贵，但质量极佳
example_zh: 一家豪华酒店/一辆豪华轿车/一套豪华公寓

definition: the fact of enjoying special and expensive things, particularly food and drink, clothes and places
example: a life of unimaginable luxury
definition_zh: 享受特殊且昂贵的事物——尤其是美食美酒、服饰和场所——这一事实
example_zh: 一种难以想象的奢华生活

definition: the words of a popular song
example: music and lyrics by Rodgers and Hart
definition_zh: 一首流行歌曲的歌词
example_zh: 曲词均由罗杰斯和哈特创作

definition: a piece of equipment with many parts that work together to do a particular task. The power used to work a machine may be electricity, steam, gas, etc. or human power.
example: Machines have replaced human labour in many industries.
definition_zh: 一种由许多部件组成、共同协作以完成特定任务的设备。驱动机器运行的动力可以是电力、蒸汽、燃气等，也可以是人力。
example_zh: 在许多行业中，机器已经取代了人力劳动。

definition: machines as a group, especially large ones
example: agricultural/industrial machinery
definition_zh: 机器作为一个整体，尤其是大型机器
example_zh: 农业/工业机械

definition: very stupid; not at all sensible
example: You must be mad to risk it.
definition_zh: 非常愚蠢；完全不合常理
example_zh: 你得疯了才会冒这个险。

definition: a type of large thin book with a paper cover that you can buy every week or month, containing articles, photographs, etc., often on a particular topic; a similar collection of articles, etc. that appears regularly online
example: a weekly/monthly magazine
definition_zh: 一种纸质封面、薄而大开本的刊物，每周或每月发行一次，内容包括文章、照片等，通常围绕特定主题；网上定期发布的、类似的文章集等内容
example_zh: 周刊/月刊

definition: having or using special powers to make impossible things happen or seem to happen
example: a magic spell/charm/potion
definition_zh: 拥有或运用特殊能力，使不可能的事情发生或看似发生
example_zh: 一个魔法咒语/护身符/魔药

definition: the secret power of appearing to make impossible things happen by saying special words or doing special things
example: Do you believe in magic?
definition_zh: 通过说出特殊的话语或做些特殊的事情，看似能让不可能的事情发生，这种神秘的力量
example_zh: 你相信魔法吗？

definition: containing magic; used in magic
example: magical powers
definition_zh: 具有魔力；用于魔法
example_zh: 魔法力量

definition: an official who acts as a judge in the lowest courts of law
example: to come up before the magistrates
definition_zh: 在基层法院担任法官的官员
example_zh: 出庭接受治安法官审讯

definition: behaving like a magnet; that can be attracted by a magnet
example: magnetic materials
definition_zh: 像磁铁一样；能被磁铁吸引
example_zh: 磁性材料

definition: extremely attractive and impressive; deserving praise
example: The Taj Mahal is a magnificent building.
definition_zh: 极具吸引力且令人印象深刻；值得称赞
example_zh: 泰姬陵是一座宏伟的建筑。

definition: the great size or importance of something; the degree to which something is large or important
example: We did not realize the magnitude of the problem.
definition_zh: 某事物的巨大规模或重要性；某事物规模之大或重要性之高的程度
example_zh: 我们当时并没有意识到问题的严重性。

definition: the official system used for sending and delivering letters, packages, etc.
example: a mail service/train/van
definition_zh: 用于寄送和投递信件、包裹等的官方系统。
example_zh: 邮政服务/火车/厢式货车

definition: to send something to somebody using the postal system
example: mail something (to somebody/something), Don't forget to mail that letter to your mother.
definition_zh: 通过邮政系统将某物寄给某人
example_zh: 给（某人/某物）寄点东西，别忘了把那封信寄给你妈妈。

definition: being the largest or most important of its kind
example: Be careful crossing the main road.
definition_zh: 指同类中规模最大或地位最重要的
example_zh: 过主干道时请小心。

definition: the main area of land of a country or region, not including any islands near to it
example: to/from the mainland, a boat to/from the mainland
definition_zh: 一个国家或地区的主要陆地部分，不包括其附近的任何岛屿
example_zh: 往返大陆，一艘往返大陆的船

definition: more than anything else; also used to talk about the most important reason for something
example: They eat mainly fruit and nuts.
definition_zh: 比其他任何事情都重要；也用于指某事最重要的原因
example_zh: 它们主要吃水果和坚果。

definition: considered normal because it reflects what is done or accepted by most people
example: mainstream culture/politics
definition_zh: 被视为正常，因为它反映了大多数人的做法或普遍接受的情况
example_zh: 主流文化/政治

definition: the ideas and opinions that are thought to be normal because they are shared by most people; the people whose ideas and opinions are most accepted
example: His radical views place him outside the mainstream of American politics.
definition_zh: 那些因被大多数人认同而被视为正常的思想和观点；那些思想和观点最受认可的人
example_zh: 他的激进观点使他游离于美国政治的主流之外。

definition: to make something continue at the same level, standard, etc.
example: to maintain law and order/standards/a balance/control
definition_zh: 使某事保持在同一水平、标准等。
example_zh: 以维护法律和秩序/标准/平衡/控制

definition: the act of keeping something in good condition by checking or repairing it regularly
example: The school pays for heating and the maintenance of the buildings.
definition_zh: 通过定期检查或维修，使某物保持良好状态的行为
example_zh: 学校承担取暖费和校舍的维护费用。

definition: very large or important
example: a major road
definition_zh: 非常大或非常重要
example_zh: 一条主要道路

definition: the largest part of a group of people or things
example: majority (of somebody/something), The majority of people interviewed prefer TV to radio.
definition_zh: 一群人或事物中占最大比例的部分
example_zh: （某人/某事）的大多数，接受采访的大多数人更喜欢看电视而不是听广播。

definition: the name or type of a machine, piece of equipment, etc. that is made by a particular company
example: make of something, What make of car does he drive?
definition_zh: 由某家公司制造的机器、设备等的名称或类型
example_zh: 某款车，他开的是什么牌子的车？

definition: to create or prepare something by combining materials or putting parts together
example: make something, to make a table/dress/cake
definition_zh: 通过组合材料或将部件拼装在一起来制作或准备某物
example_zh: 制作某物，例如制作桌子、连衣裙或蛋糕

definition: coloured substances used on the skin to make yourself look more attractive or to change your appearance
example: eye make-up
definition_zh: 涂抹在皮肤上的有色物质，用于让自己看起来更吸引人或改变外貌
example_zh: 眼妆

definition: the act or process of making or producing something
example: strategic decision-making
definition_zh: 制造或生产某物的行为或过程
example_zh: 战略决策

definition: being a man or boy
example: a male friend/colleague/partner
definition_zh: 作为男人或男孩
example_zh: 一位男性朋友/同事/伴侣

definition: a male person, animal or plant
example: The male of the species has a white tail.
definition_zh: 雄性的人、动物或植物
example_zh: 该物种的雄性尾巴是白色的。

definition: a large building or covered area that has many shops, restaurants, etc. inside it
example: Let's go to the mall.
definition_zh: 一座大型建筑或带顶棚的区域，内部设有许多商店、餐馆等
example_zh: 咱们去商场吧。

definition: an adult male human
example: a good-looking young man
definition_zh: 一名成年男性
example_zh: 一位英俊的小伙子

definition: to control or be in charge of a business, a team, an organization, land, etc.
example: to manage a business/factory/bank/hotel/soccer team
definition_zh: 管理或负责一家企业、一个团队、一个组织、一块土地等。
example_zh: 管理一家企业/工厂/银行/酒店/足球队

definition: the activity of running and controlling a business or similar organization
example: a career in management
definition_zh: 经营和管理企业或类似组织的活动
example_zh: 管理职业

definition: a person who is in charge of running a business, a shop or a similar organization or part of one
example: a bank/hotel manager
definition_zh: 负责经营企业、商店或类似组织（或其部分）的人
example_zh: 银行/酒店经理

definition: the authority to do something, given to a government or other organization by the people who vote for it in an election
example: It is undemocratic to govern an area without an electoral mandate.
definition_zh: 由选民在选举中投票选出，从而赋予政府或其他组织采取某种行动的权力
example_zh: 在没有选举授权的情况下治理一个地区，这是不民主的。

definition: required by law
example: The offence carries a mandatory life sentence.
definition_zh: 法律规定
example_zh: 该罪行将被判处强制性无期徒刑。

definition: to show something clearly, especially a feeling, an attitude or a quality
example: Social tensions were manifested in the recent political crisis.
definition_zh: 清楚地表现出来，尤其是某种情感、态度或品质
example_zh: 社会紧张局势在最近的政治危机中显现出来。

definition: to control or influence somebody/something, often in a dishonest way so that they do not realize it
example: manipulate somebody/something, She uses her charm to manipulate people.
definition_zh: 控制或影响某人/某事，通常是以不诚实的方式进行，使其浑然不觉
example_zh: 操纵某人/某事，她利用自己的魅力来操纵别人。

definition: behaviour that controls or influences somebody/something, often in a dishonest way so that they do not realize it
example: Advertising like this is a cynical manipulation of the elderly.
definition_zh: 一种控制或影响某人/某事的行为，通常以不诚实的方式进行，使其无法察觉
example_zh: 这样的广告是对老年人的冷酷操纵。

definition: behaviour that is considered to be polite in a particular society or culture
example: to have good/bad manners
definition_zh: 在特定社会或文化中被视为礼貌的行为
example_zh: 举止得体/粗鲁

definition: to make goods in large quantities, using machines
example: manufactured goods
definition_zh: 利用机器大量生产商品
example_zh: 制成品

definition: the business or industry of producing goods in large quantities in factories, etc.
example: Many jobs in manufacturing were lost during the recession.
definition_zh: 在工厂等场所大量生产商品的商业或行业。
example_zh: 经济衰退期间，制造业失去了许多工作岗位。

definition: a copy of a book, piece of music, etc. before it has been printed
example: an unpublished/original manuscript
definition_zh: 书籍、乐谱等在印刷前的副本
example_zh: 一篇未发表的原创手稿

definition: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: We don't have very many copies left.
definition_zh: 用于复数名词和动词，尤其在否定句或较为正式的英语中，意为“大量”。也可用于疑问句中询问数量大小，并常与“as”、“so”和“too”搭配使用。
example_zh: 我们剩下的库存已经不多了。

definition: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: We don't have very many copies left.
definition_zh: 用于复数名词和动词，尤其在否定句或较为正式的英语中，意为“大量”。也可用于疑问句中询问数量大小，并常与“as”、“so”和“too”搭配使用。
example_zh: 我们剩下的存货已经不多了。

definition: a drawing or plan of the earth’s surface or part of it, showing countries, towns, rivers, etc.
example: a map of France
definition_zh: 地球表面或其部分的图画或图示，上面标有国家、城镇、河流等。
example_zh: 法国地图

definition: to make a map of an area
example: an unexplored region that has not yet been mapped
definition_zh: 绘制某地区的地图
example_zh: 一片尚未被勘探且尚未绘制地图的地区

definition: a long running race of about 42 kilometres or 26 miles
example: the London marathon
definition_zh: 一项长跑比赛，赛程约为42公里或26英里
example_zh: 伦敦马拉松

definition: the 3rd month of the year, between February and April
example: She was born in March.
definition_zh: 这一年的第三个月，介于2月和4月之间
example_zh: 她出生于三月。

definition: an organized walk by many people from one place to another, in order to protest about something, or to express their opinions
example: protest marches
definition_zh: 由许多人有组织地从一地步行至另一地，以抗议某事或表达意见
example_zh: 抗议游行

definition: to walk with stiff regular steps like a soldier
example: Quick march! (= the order to start marching)
definition_zh: 像士兵一样迈着僵硬而整齐的步伐行走
example_zh: 快步走！（= 开始行进的命令）

definition: the empty space at the side of a written or printed page
example: the left-hand/right-hand margin
definition_zh: 书写或印刷页面侧边的空白处
example_zh: 左边距/右边距

definition: small and not important
example: a marginal improvement in weather conditions
definition_zh: 微不足道
example_zh: 天气状况略有好转

definition: connected with the sea and the creatures and plants that live there
example: marine life
definition_zh: 与大海以及栖息其中的生物和植物息息相关
example_zh: 海洋生物

definition: a written or printed symbol that is used as a sign of something, for example the quality of something or who made or owns it
example: punctuation marks
definition_zh: 一种书面或印刷的符号，用作某事物的标志，例如某事物的质量，或是其制造者或所有者
example_zh: 标点符号

definition: to write or draw a symbol, line, etc. on something in order to give information about it
example: mark something, The flood level is marked by a white line on the wall.
definition_zh: 在某物上书写或绘制符号、线条等，以提供有关该物体的信息
example_zh: 标记某物，墙上的白线标出了洪水水位。

definition: an object or a sign that shows the position of something
example: a boundary marker
definition_zh: 一个物体或符号，用于指示某物的位置
example_zh: 界标

definition: an occasion when people buy and sell goods; the open area or building where they meet to do this
example: a fruit/flower/fish market
definition_zh: 人们买卖商品的场合；人们为此聚集的露天场所或建筑物
example_zh: 水果/鲜花/鱼市

definition: to advertise a product in a particular way in order to make people want it
example: market something, The company utilizes every media tool available to market its products.
definition_zh: 以某种特定方式宣传产品，以激发人们的购买欲望
example_zh: 推广某产品，该公司利用一切可用的媒体工具来推广其产品。

definition: the activity of presenting, advertising and selling a company’s products or services in the best possible way
example: a marketing campaign/strategy
definition_zh: 以最佳方式展示、宣传和销售公司产品或服务的活动
example_zh: 一项营销活动/策略

definition: the activity of competing with other companies to buy and sell goods, services, etc.
example: Companies must be able to survive in the marketplace.
definition_zh: 与其他公司竞争以买卖商品、服务等的行为。
example_zh: 企业必须能够在市场上生存下去。

definition: the legal relationship between two people who are married to each other
example: a happy/an unhappy marriage
definition_zh: 已婚夫妇之间的法律关系
example_zh: 一段幸福的/一段不幸的婚姻

definition: having a husband or wife
example: a married man/woman
definition_zh: 有丈夫或妻子
example_zh: 已婚男子/女子

definition: to become the husband or wife of somebody; to get married to somebody
example: marry (somebody), She married a German.
definition_zh: 成为某人的丈夫或妻子；与某人结婚
example_zh: 嫁给（某人），她嫁给了一个德国人。

definition: connected with fighting or war
example: She has practised martial arts for several years.
definition_zh: 与战斗或战争有关的
example_zh: 她练武已有几年了。

definition: something that you wear over your face to hide it, or to frighten or entertain other people
example: The robbers wore stocking masks.
definition_zh: 一种戴在脸上用来遮住脸，或者用来吓唬或取悦他人的东西
example_zh: 劫匪戴着连裤袜做的面罩。

definition: affecting or involving a large number of people or things
example: The world faces the tremendous problem of mass unemployment.
definition_zh: 影响或涉及大量人员或事物
example_zh: 世界正面临着大规模失业这一严峻问题。

definition: a large amount of a substance that does not have a definite shape or form
example: She saw a large dark mass in the water.
definition_zh: 大量没有固定形状或形态的物质
example_zh: 她看到水里有一个巨大的黑色物体。

definition: the killing of a large number of people especially in a cruel way
example: the bloody massacre of innocent civilians
definition_zh: 大量杀害人员，尤其是以残忍的方式杀害
example_zh: 对无辜平民的血腥屠杀

definition: very large, heavy and solid
example: a massive rock
definition_zh: 非常大、重且结实
example_zh: 一块巨大的岩石

definition: a man who has people working for him, often as servants in his home
example: They lived in fear of their master.
definition_zh: 指手下有仆人的人，这些仆人通常在他家中服侍他
example_zh: 他们一直活在对主人的恐惧之中。

definition: to learn or understand something completely
example: She never completely mastered the art of lip-reading.
definition_zh: 彻底掌握或理解某事
example_zh: 她从未完全掌握读唇术。

definition: a sports event where people or teams compete against each other
example: (British English), a football match
definition_zh: 一项人们或队伍之间相互竞技的体育赛事
example_zh: （英国英语），一场足球比赛

definition: to find somebody/something that goes together with or is connected with another person or thing
example: match A and B, Match the words and pictures.
definition_zh: 找到与另一个人或事物相配或相关的人或事物
example_zh: 将A和B配对，将单词和图片配对。

definition: having the same colour, pattern, style, etc. and therefore looking attractive together
example: The two sisters wore matching outfits.
definition_zh: 颜色、图案、款式等相同，因此搭配起来很赏心悦目
example_zh: 这两姐妹穿了同款衣服。

definition: a friend
example: They've been best mates since school.
definition_zh: 一位朋友
example_zh: 他们从上学起就是最好的朋友。

definition: to have sex in order to produce young
example: Do foxes ever mate with dogs?
definition_zh: 为了繁衍后代而发生性行为
example_zh: 狐狸会和狗交配吗？

definition: connected with money, possessions, etc. rather than with the needs of the mind or spirit
example: material possessions/wealth
definition_zh: 与金钱、财产等有关，而非与思想或精神上的需求有关
example_zh: 物质财富

definition: a substance that things can be made from
example: building materials (= bricks, sand, glass, etc.)
definition_zh: 一种可以用来制造物品的物质
example_zh: 建筑材料（即砖、沙、玻璃等）

definition: connected with or involving mathematics
example: mathematical calculations/problems/models
definition_zh: 与数学有关或涉及数学的
example_zh: 数学计算/问题/模型

definition: the science of numbers and shapes. Branches of mathematics include arithmetic, algebra, geometry and trigonometry.
example: the school mathematics curriculum
definition_zh: 关于数字和形状的科学。数学的分支包括算术、代数、几何和三角学。
example_zh: 学校数学课程

definition: mathematics, especially as a subject in school
example: The core subjects are English, maths and science.
definition_zh: 数学，尤其是作为学校的一门学科
example_zh: 核心科目是英语、数学和科学。

definition: used (to ask) if somebody is upset, unhappy, etc. or if there is a problem
example: What's the matter? Is there something wrong?
definition_zh: 用于（询问）某人是否心情不好、不开心等，或者是否出了什么问题
example_zh: 怎么了？有什么问题吗？

definition: to be important or have an important effect on somebody/something
example: ‘I'm afraid I forgot that book again.’ ‘It doesn't matter (= it is not important enough to worry about).’
definition_zh: 对某人/某事很重要，或对某人/某事产生重要影响
example_zh: “恐怕我又把那本书忘在家里了。”“没关系（=这事没那么重要，不必担心）。”

definition: behaving in a sensible way, like an adult
example: Jane is very mature for her age.
definition_zh: 表现得合情合理，像个大人一样
example_zh: 简的成熟程度远超同龄人。

definition: to become fully grown or developed
example: This particular breed of cattle matures early.
definition_zh: 长大成人或发育成熟
