example: She plays the flute in the school orchestra.
definition_zh: 由一名指挥家带领、共同演奏各种乐器的庞大乐团
example_zh: 她在学校管弦乐团里吹长笛。

definition: the way in which people or things are placed or arranged in relation to each other
example: in… order, The names are listed in alphabetical order.
definition_zh: 人或物之间相互位置或排列的方式
example_zh: 按……顺序，这些名字按字母顺序排列。

definition: to ask for something to eat or drink in a restaurant, bar, etc.
example: order (something), I ordered a coffee and a sandwich.
definition_zh: 在餐厅、酒吧等场所点餐或点饮料。
example_zh: 点（某物），我点了一杯咖啡和一个三明治。

definition: not unusual or different in any way
example: an ordinary sort of day
definition_zh: 并不罕见，也没有任何不同之处
example_zh: 一个寻常的日子

definition: a part of the body that has a particular purpose, such as the heart or the brain; part of a plant with a particular purpose
example: the internal organs
definition_zh: 身体中具有特定功能的部位，例如心脏或大脑；植物中具有特定功能的部位
example_zh: 内脏

definition: produced or practised without using artificial chemicals
example: organic cheese/vegetables/wine, etc.
definition_zh: 在不使用人工化学物质的情况下生产或进行
example_zh: 有机奶酪/蔬菜/葡萄酒等。

definition: a group of people who form a business, club, etc. together in order to achieve a particular aim
example: He's the president of a large international organization.
definition_zh: 一群人为了实现特定目标而共同组建的企业、俱乐部等组织
example_zh: 他是某大型国际组织的主席。

definition: connected with the way in which the different parts of something are arranged; connected with an organization
example: organizational changes within the party
definition_zh: 与某事物各部分的排列方式有关；与组织结构有关
example_zh: 党内的组织变动

definition: to make all the arrangements for something to happen or be provided
example: He helped to organize various events.
definition_zh: 为某事发生或某物得到提供做好一切安排
example_zh: 他协助组织了各种活动。

definition: involving large numbers of people who work together to do something in a way that has been carefully planned
example: an organized body of workers
definition_zh: 涉及大量人员，他们通力合作，按照精心策划的方式完成某项任务
example_zh: 一个有组织的工人团体

definition: a person who makes the arrangements for something
example: the organizers of the festival
definition_zh: 负责安排某事的人
example_zh: 该节日的组织者

definition: a person’s basic beliefs or feelings about a particular subject
example: religious/political orientation
definition_zh: 一个人对某个特定主题的基本信念或感受
example_zh: 宗教/政治倾向

definition: the point from which something starts; the cause of something
example: origin of something, the origins of life on earth
definition_zh: 某事开始的起点；某事的原因
example_zh: 某事物的起源，地球上生命的起源

definition: existing at the beginning of a particular period, process or activity
example: The room still has many of its original features.
definition_zh: 在某个时期、过程或活动的开始时就已存在
example_zh: 这间房间至今仍保留着许多原有的特色。

definition: a document, work of art, etc. produced for the first time, from which copies are later made
example: This painting is a copy; the original is in Madrid.
definition_zh: 首次创作的文件、艺术作品等，其后据此制作副本
example_zh: 这幅画是复制品；原作收藏于马德里。

definition: used to describe the situation that existed at the beginning of a particular period or activity, especially before something was changed
example: The school was originally very small.
definition_zh: 用于描述某个特定时期或活动开始时的状况，尤其是某项改变发生之前的状况
example_zh: 这所学校起初规模很小。

definition: to happen or appear for the first time in a particular place or situation
example: The disease is thought to have originated in the tropics.
definition_zh: 在某个特定地点或情况下首次发生或出现
example_zh: 据推测，该疾病起源于热带地区。

definition: used to refer to people or things that are additional or different to people or things that have been mentioned or are known about
example: Mr Harris and Mrs Bate and three other teachers were there.
definition_zh: 用于指代那些与已提及或已知的人或事物相比，属于额外或不同的其他人和事物
example_zh: 哈里斯先生、贝特夫人和另外三位老师都在场。

definition: used to refer to people or things that are additional or different to people or things that have been mentioned or are known about
example: Mr Harris and Mrs Bate and three other teachers were there.
definition_zh: 用于指代那些与已提及或已知的人或事物相比，属于额外或不同的其他人和事物
example_zh: 哈里斯先生、贝特夫人和另外三位老师都在场。

definition: used to state what the result would be if something did not happen or if the situation were different
example: My parents lent me the money. Otherwise, I couldn't have afforded the trip.
definition_zh: 用于说明如果某事没有发生或情况不同，结果会如何
example_zh: 这笔钱是我父母借给我的。要不然，我根本负担不起这次旅行。

definition: used to say what is the right thing to do
example: They ought to apologize.
definition_zh: 常用来表示“该怎么做才对”
example_zh: 他们应该道歉。

definition: belonging to us; connected with us
example: our daughter/dog/house
definition_zh: 属于我们的；与我们有关的
example_zh: 我们的女儿/狗/房子

definition: the one or ones that belong to us
example: Their house is very similar to ours, but ours is bigger.
definition_zh: 属于我们的那个或那些
example_zh: 他们家和我们家很像，不过我们家更大。

definition: the reflexive form of we; used when you and another person or other people together cause and are affected by an action
example: We shouldn't blame ourselves for what happened.
definition_zh: “我们”的反身形式；用于指你与另一个人或其他人共同引发某项行动，并共同受到该行动影响的情况
example_zh: 对于发生的事情，我们不应该自责。

definition: away from the inside of a place or thing
example: She ran out into the corridor.
definition_zh: 远离某处或某物的内部
example_zh: 她冲到了走廊里。

definition: away from the inside of a place or thing
example: She ran out into the corridor.
definition_zh: 远离某处或某物的内部
example_zh: 她冲到了走廊里。

definition: the sudden start of something unpleasant, especially violence or a disease
example: the outbreak of war
definition_zh: 某件令人不快的事情的突然发生，尤其是暴力或疾病
example_zh: 战争的爆发

definition: the result or effect of an action or event
example: The likely outcome is a compromise.
definition_zh: 某项行动或事件的结果或影响
example_zh: 最可能的结果是达成妥协。

definition: used, happening or located outside rather than in a building
example: outdoor pursuits/recreation/activities
definition_zh: 指在建筑物外而非建筑物内使用、发生或位于的情况
example_zh: 户外运动/休闲/活动

definition: outside, rather than in a building
example: The rain prevented them from eating outdoors.
definition_zh: 在室外，而不是在建筑物内
example_zh: 下雨使他们无法在户外用餐。

definition: on the outside of something
example: the outer layers of the skin
definition_zh: 在某物的外面
example_zh: 皮肤的外层

definition: a set of clothes that you wear together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose
example: She was wearing an expensive new outfit.
definition_zh: 一套搭配穿着的衣服，尤其是为特定场合或目的而穿的
example_zh: 她身上穿了一套昂贵的新衣服。

definition: a trip that you go on for pleasure or education, usually with a group of people and lasting no more than one day
example: a family outing
definition_zh: 为了娱乐或学习而进行的旅行，通常与一群人同行，且持续时间不超过一天
example_zh: 一次家庭出游

definition: a shop or an organization that sells goods made by a particular company or of a particular type
example: The business has 34 retail outlets in this state alone.
definition_zh: 一家销售某家公司生产或某类商品的商店或组织
example_zh: 仅在这个州，该公司就拥有34家零售店。

definition: a description of the main facts or points involved in something
example: outline of something, This is a brief outline of the events.
definition_zh: 对某事所涉及的主要事实或要点的描述
example_zh: 某事的概要，这是对这些事件的简要概述。

definition: to give a description of the main facts or points involved in something
example: outline something, He outlined his plan to leave St. Petersburg.
definition_zh: 对某事涉及的主要事实或要点进行描述
example_zh: 概述某事，他概述了自己离开圣彼得堡的计划。

definition: the attitude to life and the world of a particular person, group or culture
example: Travel broadens your outlook.
definition_zh: 某个人、某个群体或某种文化对生活和世界的态度
example_zh: 旅行能开阔眼界。

definition: the amount of something that a person, a machine or an organization produces
example: Manufacturing output has increased by 8 per cent.
definition_zh: 一个人、一台机器或一个组织所生产的某物的数量
example_zh: 制造业产出增长了8%。

definition: a strong feeling of shock and anger
example: The judge's remarks caused public outrage.
definition_zh: 强烈的震惊和愤怒之情
example_zh: 法官的言论引发了公众的愤怒。

definition: to make somebody very shocked and angry
example: He was outraged at the way he had been treated.
definition_zh: 使某人感到非常震惊和愤怒
example_zh: 他对自己受到的待遇感到非常愤怒。

definition: of, on or facing the outer side
example: The outside walls are damp.
definition_zh: 位于、在……上或朝向外侧的
example_zh: 外墙受潮了。

definition: not in a room, building or container but on or to the outside of it
example: I'm seeing a patient—please wait outside.
definition_zh: 不在房间、建筑物或容器内，而是在其上或外部
example_zh: 我正在接诊一位患者——请在外面等一下。

definition: the outer side or surface of something
example: The outside of the house needs painting.
definition_zh: 某物的外侧或表面
example_zh: 房子外墙需要粉刷。

definition: on or to a place on the outside of something
example: You can park your car outside our house.
definition_zh: 在某物外部的某个位置上，或通向该位置
example_zh: 你可以把车停在我们家外面。

definition: a person who is not accepted as a member of a society, group, etc.
example: Here she felt she would always be an outsider.
definition_zh: 指未被社会、群体等接纳为成员的人。
example_zh: 在这里，她觉得自己永远是个局外人。

definition: extremely good; excellent
example: an outstanding player/achievement/success
definition_zh: 非常好；极好
example_zh: 一位杰出的球员/一项杰出的成就/一次杰出的成功

definition: the part of a cooker that is like a box with a door on the front, in which food is cooked or heated
example: Take the cake out of the oven.
definition_zh: 炊具中类似于带前门箱体的部分，用于烹饪或加热食物
example_zh: 把蛋糕从烤箱里拿出来。

definition: across a street, an open space, etc.
example: I stopped and crossed over.
definition_zh: 穿过一条街道、一片空地等。
example_zh: 我停下脚步，穿过马路。

definition: resting on the surface of somebody/something and partly or completely covering them/it
example: She put a blanket over the sleeping child.
definition_zh: 停留在某人/某物表面，并部分或完全覆盖住他们/它
example_zh: 她给熟睡的孩子盖上了一条毯子。

definition: including all the things or people that are involved in a particular situation; general
example: There will be winners in each of three age groups, and one overall winner.
definition_zh: 包括与特定情况有关的所有事物或人员；总体而言
example_zh: 三个年龄组中每个组别都将产生一名获奖者，并设一名总冠军。

definition: including everything or everyone; in total
example: The company will invest $1.6m overall in new equipment.
definition_zh: 包括所有事物或所有人；总计
example_zh: 该公司将总计投资160万美元用于购置新设备。

definition: to succeed in dealing with or controlling a problem that has been preventing you from achieving something
example: She overcame injury to win the Olympic gold medal.
definition_zh: 成功应对或控制一个一直阻碍你实现某件事的问题
example_zh: 她克服了伤病，赢得了奥运会金牌。

definition: to fail to see or notice something
example: He seems to have overlooked one important fact.
definition_zh: 没有看到或注意到某事
example_zh: 他似乎忽略了一个重要事实。

definition: too; very
example: I'm not overly fond of pasta.
definition_zh: 也是；非常
example_zh: 我并不是特别喜欢意大利面。

definition: during or for the night
example: We stayed overnight in London after the theatre.
definition_zh: 当晚或整晚
example_zh: 看完戏后，我们在伦敦住了一晚。

definition: connected with foreign countries, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean
example: The firm is expanding into overseas markets.
definition_zh: 与外国有联系，尤其是那些与贵国隔海相望的国家
example_zh: 该公司正在向海外市场拓展业务。

definition: to or in a foreign country, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean
example: to live/work/go overseas
definition_zh: 指前往或位于外国，尤其是那些与本国隔海相望的国家
example_zh: 去国外生活/工作/旅行

definition: to watch somebody/something and make sure that a job or an activity is done correctly
example: United Nations observers oversaw the elections.
definition_zh: 监督某人或某事，以确保某项工作或活动得到正确完成
example_zh: 联合国观察员监督了此次选举。

definition: if something overturns, or if somebody overturns it, it turns into a position in which the top of it is where the bottom of it normally is or on its side
example: The car skidded and overturned.
definition_zh: 如果某物翻倒了，或者有人把它翻倒了，它就会变成一种状态：原本的底部变成了顶部，或者侧倒在地
example_zh: 汽车打滑后翻车了。

definition: to have such a strong emotional effect on somebody that it is difficult for them to resist or know how to react
example: She was overwhelmed by feelings of guilt.
definition_zh: 对某人产生如此强烈的情感冲击，以至于他们难以抗拒或不知如何应对
example_zh: 她被内疚感淹没了。

definition: very great or very strong; so powerful that you cannot resist it or decide how to react
example: The evidence against him was overwhelming.
definition_zh: 极其巨大或极其强大；强大到让人无法抗拒，也无法决定该如何应对
example_zh: 针对他的证据确凿。

definition: to have to pay somebody for something that you have already received or return money that you have borrowed
example: owe somebody something, She still owes her father £3 000.
definition_zh: 不得不为已经收到过的东西付钱，或者归还借来的钱
example_zh: 欠某人钱，她至今还欠她父亲3 000英镑。

definition: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with somebody
example: It was her own idea.
definition_zh: 用于强调某物属于某人或与某人有关
example_zh: 这是她自己的主意。

definition: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with somebody
example: It was her own idea.
definition_zh: 用于强调某物属于某人或与某人有关
example_zh: 这是她自己的主意。

definition: to have something that belongs to you, especially because you have bought it
example: Do you own your house or do you rent it?
definition_zh: 拥有属于自己的东西，尤其是因为自己买下的
example_zh: 你是房主还是租客？

definition: a person who owns something
example: a dog/pet/gun owner
definition_zh: 某物所有者
example_zh: 养狗/养宠物/持枪的人

definition: the fact of owning something
example: a growth in home ownership
definition_zh: 拥有某物的这一事实
example_zh: 住房拥有率的增长

definition: a chemical element. Oxygen is a gas that is present in air and water and is necessary for people, animals and plants to live.
example: The patient didn't seem to be getting enough oxygen.
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。氧气是一种气体，存在于空气和水中，是人类、动物和植物生存所必需的。
example_zh: 患者似乎缺氧了。

definition: the speed at which somebody/something walks, runs or moves
example: at a… pace, to set off at a steady/gentle/leisurely pace
definition_zh: 某人或某物行走、奔跑或移动的速度
example_zh: 以……的速度，以平稳/缓慢/悠闲的速度出发

definition: to walk up and down in a small area many times, especially because you are feeling nervous or angry
example: + adv./prep., She paced up and down outside the room.
definition_zh: 在狭小范围内来回踱步多次，尤其是因为感到紧张或生气
example_zh: + 副词/介词，她在那间房外面来回踱步。

definition: a container, usually made of paper, that holds a number of the same thing or an amount of something, ready to be sold
example: pack of something, a pack of cigarettes/gum
definition_zh: 一种通常由纸制成的容器，用于盛放若干件相同物品或一定数量的某物，以便出售
example_zh: 一包什么东西，一包香烟/口香糖

definition: to put clothes, etc. into a bag in preparation for a trip away from home
example: I haven't packed yet.
definition_zh: 将衣物等物品装入行李袋，为出远门做准备
example_zh: 我还没收拾行李。

definition: something that is wrapped in paper or put into a thick envelope so that it can be sent by mail, carried easily, or given as a present
example: A large package has arrived for you.
definition_zh: 用纸包裹或装入厚信封中的物品，以便通过邮寄寄送、便于携带或作为礼物赠送
example_zh: 有一大包裹寄到了，是给您的。

definition: to put something into a box, bag, etc. to be sold or transported
example: package something, packaged food/goods
definition_zh: 将某物装入盒子、袋子等容器中，以便出售或运输
example_zh: 某物的包装，包装食品/商品

definition: a small container made of paper or card in which goods are packed for selling
example: a packet of biscuits/cigarettes/crisps
definition_zh: 一种由纸或纸板制成的小型容器，用于包装待售商品
example_zh: 一包饼干/香烟/薯片

definition: a thick piece of soft material that is used, for example, for cleaning or protecting something or for holding liquid
example: medicated cleansing pads for sensitive skin
definition_zh: 一块厚实的柔软材料，例如用于清洁或保护某物，或用于盛装液体
example_zh: 适用于敏感肌肤的药用洁面湿巾

definition: one side or both sides of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, etc.
example: Turn to page 64.
definition_zh: 书籍、杂志等中的一张纸的一面或两面。
example_zh: 请翻到第64页。

definition: the feelings that you have in your body when you have been hurt or when you are ill
example: a cry of pain
definition_zh: 当你受伤或生病时，身体产生的感受
example_zh: 一声痛呼

definition: causing you pain
example: Is your back still painful?
definition_zh: 让你感到痛苦
example_zh: 你的背还疼吗？

definition: a liquid that is put on surfaces to give them a particular colour; a layer of this liquid when it has dried on a surface
example: white paint
definition_zh: 一种涂在物体表面以使其呈现特定颜色的液体；这种液体在物体表面干燥后形成的薄层
example_zh: 白色油漆

definition: to cover a surface or object with paint
example: paint something with something, Paint the shed with weather-resistant paint.
definition_zh: 用油漆覆盖表面或物体
example_zh: 用某种东西给某物涂漆，用耐候漆给棚屋涂漆。

definition: a person whose job is painting buildings, walls, etc.
example: He works as a painter and decorator.
definition_zh: 以粉刷建筑物、墙壁等为职业的人。
example_zh: 他是一名油漆工和装修工。

definition: a picture that has been painted
example: a watercolour/crylic painting
definition_zh: 一幅已经画好的画
example_zh: 一幅水彩/丙烯画

definition: two things of the same type, especially when they are used or worn together
example: a pair of shoes/boots
definition_zh: 两件同类物品，尤其是当它们被一起使用或穿着时
example_zh: 一双鞋/靴子

definition: the official home of a king, queen, president, etc.
example: Buckingham Palace
definition_zh: 国王、女王、总统等人的官方居所。
example_zh: 白金汉宫

definition: having skin that is very light in colour; having skin that has less colour than usual because of illness, a strong emotion, etc.
example: a pale complexion
definition_zh: 皮肤颜色非常浅；因疾病、强烈情绪等原因，皮肤颜色比平时更浅。
example_zh: 脸色苍白

definition: a straight tree with a mass of long leaves at the top, growing in tropical countries. There are several types of palm tree, some of which produce fruit.
example: a date palm
definition_zh: 一种树干笔直、顶端簇生长叶的树，生长在热带国家。棕榈树有几种类型，其中有些会结果。
example_zh: 一棵椰枣树

definition: a metal container used for cooking food in
example: Heat some oil in a pan.
definition_zh: 一种用于烹饪食物的金属容器
example_zh: 在平底锅里热一点油。

definition: a square or rectangular piece of wood, glass or metal that forms part of a larger surface such as a door or wall
example: One of the glass panels in the front door was cracked.
definition_zh: 一块方形或矩形的木头、玻璃或金属片，构成门或墙等较大表面的一部分
example_zh: 前门的一块玻璃板裂了。

definition: a sudden feeling of great fear that cannot be controlled and prevents you from thinking clearly
example: a moment of panic
definition_zh: 一种无法控制的、突然袭来的强烈恐惧感，使你无法清晰思考
example_zh: 一瞬间的惊慌

definition: underpants or knickers
example: a pair of pants
definition_zh: 内裤或小内裤
example_zh: 一条裤子

definition: the thin material that you write and draw on and that is also used for wrapping and packing things
example: a piece/sheet of paper
definition_zh: 一种薄薄的材料，既可以用来书写和绘画，也可以用来包裹和包装物品
example_zh: 一张纸

definition: a public celebration of a special day or event, usually with bands in the streets and decorated vehicles
example: the Lord Mayor’s parade
definition_zh: 为庆祝某个特殊的日子或活动而举行的公众庆祝活动，通常包括街头乐队表演和装饰一新的车辆
example_zh: 市长游行

definition: a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph starts on a new line.
example: an opening/introductory paragraph
definition_zh: 文章中的一段，通常由几句围绕同一主题展开的句子组成。段落的第一句应换行开始。
example_zh: 开篇段落/引言段落

definition: two or more lines that are parallel to each other are the same distance apart at every point
example: parallel lines
definition_zh: 两条或多条彼此平行的直线，在每个点处的距离都相等
example_zh: 平行线

definition: a person, a situation, an event, etc. that is very similar to another, especially one in a different place or time
example: These ideas have parallels in Freud's thought too.
definition_zh: 与另一个（尤其是发生在不同地点或不同时间）非常相似的人、情况、事件等
example_zh: 这些观点在弗洛伊德的思想中也有相似之处。

definition: something that decides or limits the way in which something can be done
example: to set/define the parameters
definition_zh: 决定或限制某事实现方式的因素
example_zh: 设置/定义参数

definition: a person’s father or mother
example: He's still living with his parents.
definition_zh: 某人的父亲或母亲
example_zh: 他现在还和父母住在一起。

definition: connected with a parent or parents
example: parental responsibility/rights
definition_zh: 与父母中的一方或双方有亲属关系
example_zh: 父母的责任/权利

definition: an area that has its own church and that a priest is responsible for
example: a parish church/priest
definition_zh: 一个拥有自己教堂且由一名神父负责的地区
example_zh: 一所堂区教堂/一位神父

definition: an area of public land in a town or a city where people go to walk, play and relax
example: Hyde Park
definition_zh: 城镇中的一片公共用地，人们常去那里散步、玩耍和放松
example_zh: 海德公园

definition: to leave a vehicle that you are driving in a particular place for a period of time
example: He parked and went inside.
definition_zh: 将自己驾驶的车辆停放在某处一段时间
example_zh: 他把车停好，走进了里面。

definition: the act of stopping a vehicle at a place and leaving it there for a period of time
example: There is no parking here between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m.
definition_zh: 将车辆停放在某处并让其停放一段时间的行为
example_zh: 上午9点至下午6点期间，此处禁止停车。

definition: the group of people who are elected to make and change the laws of a country
example: The German parliament is called the ‘Bundestag’.
definition_zh: 经选举产生、负责制定和修改国家法律的一群人
example_zh: 德国议会被称为“联邦议院”（Bundestag）。

definition: connected with a parliament; having a parliament
example: parliamentary elections
definition_zh: 与议会有关的；设有议会的
example_zh: 议会选举

definition: some but not all of a thing
example: We spent part of the time in the museum.
definition_zh: 某事的一部分，但并非全部
example_zh: 我们花了一部分时间在博物馆里。

definition: for part of the day or week in which people work
example: She's looking for a part-time job.
definition_zh: 人们工作的一天或一周中的部分时间
example_zh: 她在找一份兼职工作。

definition: not complete or whole
example: It was only a partial solution to the problem.
definition_zh: 不完整或不全面
example_zh: 这只是对该问题的一种部分解决办法。

definition: partly; not completely
example: The road was partially blocked by a fallen tree.
definition_zh: 部分地；并非完全地
example_zh: 道路被一棵倒下的树部分阻塞了。

definition: a person who is taking part in an activity or event
example: The average age of study participants was 48 years.
definition_zh: 参加某项活动或事件的人
example_zh: 研究参与者的平均年龄为48岁。

definition: to take part in or become involved in an activity
example: Anyone who wishes to participate is welcome.
definition_zh: 参加或参与某项活动
example_zh: 欢迎任何有兴趣参与的人士加入。

definition: the act of taking part in an activity or event
example: a show with lots of audience participation
definition_zh: 参与某项活动或事件的行为
example_zh: 一场观众互动性很强的演出

definition: used to emphasize that you are referring to one individual person, thing or type of thing and not others
example: There is one particular patient I'd like you to see.
definition_zh: 用于强调你所指的是某一个特定的人、事物或某类事物，而非其他
example_zh: 有位特定的患者，我想请你看看。

definition: especially; more than usual or more than others
example: particularly useful/important/interesting
definition_zh: 尤其是；比平时更多，或比别人更多
example_zh: 特别有用/重要/有趣

definition: to some extent; not completely
example: Some people are unwilling to attend the classes partly because of the cost involved.
definition_zh: 在某种程度上；并非完全
example_zh: 有些人不愿意参加这些课程，部分原因在于所需的费用。

definition: a person that you are doing an activity with, such as dancing or playing a game
example: a dance/tennis partner
definition_zh: 与你一起进行某项活动的人，例如跳舞或玩游戏
example_zh: 舞伴/网球搭档

definition: the state of being a partner in business
example: to be in/to go into partnership
definition_zh: 作为商业合伙人的身份
example_zh: 建立/进入合伙关系

definition: a social occasion, often in a person’s home, at which people eat, drink, talk, dance and enjoy themselves
example: a dinner/tea/cocktail party
definition_zh: 一种社交聚会，通常在某人家中举行，人们在聚会上吃喝、交谈、跳舞并尽情享受
example_zh: 晚宴/茶会/鸡尾酒会

definition: an official document or ticket that shows that you have the right to enter or leave a place, to travel on a bus or train, etc.
example: a boarding pass (= for a plane)
definition_zh: 一种官方文件或票证，用于证明你有权进入或离开某地、乘坐公交车或火车等。
example_zh: 登机牌（= 飞机）

definition: to achieve the required standard in an exam, a test, etc.
example: I'm not really expecting to pass first time.
definition_zh: 在考试、测验等中达到要求的标准。
example_zh: 我其实并不指望第一次就能通过。

definition: a long narrow area with walls on either side that connects one room or place with another
example: A dark narrow passage led to the main hall.
definition_zh: 一条长而窄的通道，两侧有墙壁，将一个房间或场所与另一个连接起来
example_zh: 一条昏暗狭窄的通道通向主厅。

definition: a person who is travelling in a car, bus, train, plane or ship and who is not driving it or working on it
example: airline/cruise/rail/bus passengers
definition_zh: 乘坐汽车、公交车、火车、飞机或轮船出行，但并非驾驶或操作该交通工具的人
example_zh: 航空/邮轮/铁路/长途汽车乘客

definition: the process of time going by
example: The colour of the wood darkens with the passing of time.
definition_zh: 时间流逝的过程
example_zh: 随着时间的流逝，木材的颜色会逐渐变深。

definition: a very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.
example: I admire the passion and commitment shown by the players.
definition_zh: 一种极其强烈的情感，如爱、恨、愤怒、热情等。
example_zh: 我钦佩球员们所展现出的热情和奉献精神。

definition: having or showing strong feelings of sexual love or of anger, etc.
example: to have a passionate nature
definition_zh: 怀有或表现出强烈的性爱或愤怒等情感。
example_zh: 天性热情

definition: accepting what happens or what people do without trying to change anything or oppose them
example: He played a passive role in the relationship.
definition_zh: 接受发生的事情或他人的行为，而不试图改变或反对它们
example_zh: 在这段感情中，他扮演了一个被动的角色。

definition: an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country, and that you may have to show when you enter or leave a country
example: a valid passport
definition_zh: 一份官方文件，用于证明您是某国公民，您在出入境时可能需要出示该文件
example_zh: 一本有效的护照

definition: a series of letters, numbers, etc. that you must type into a computer or computer system in order to be able to use it
example: Enter a username and password to get into the system.
definition_zh: 一系列字母、数字等，您必须将其输入计算机或计算机系统中，才能使用该系统
example_zh: 请输入用户名和密码以登录系统。

definition: gone by in time
example: in past years/centuries
definition_zh: 随时间流逝
example_zh: 在过去的几年/几个世纪里

definition: from one side of something to the other
example: She smiled at me as she walked past.
definition_zh: 从某物的一侧到另一侧
example_zh: 她走过我身边时冲我笑了笑。

definition: the time that has gone by; things that happened in an earlier time
example: in the past, I used to go there often in the past.
definition_zh: 已经流逝的时光；过去发生的事情
example_zh: 过去，我经常去那里。

definition: later than something
example: half past two
definition_zh: 比……晚
example_zh: 两点半

definition: a minister in charge of a Christian church or group, especially in some Nonconformist churches
example: He was ordained a pastor in the Lutheran Church.
definition_zh: 基督教教会或团体的负责人，特别是在某些非国教派教会中
example_zh: 他在路德教会被按立为牧师。

definition: a small area of something, especially one which is different from the area around it
example: a black dog with a white patch on its back
definition_zh: 某事物的某个小区域，尤其是与周围区域不同的那个区域
example_zh: 一只背上有块白斑的黑狗

definition: an official right to be the only person to make, use or sell a product or an invention; a document that proves this
example: patent on something, to apply for/obtain/take out a patent on an invention
definition_zh: 一项官方授予的权利，即作为唯一有权制造、使用或销售某产品或发明的个人；证明此权利的文件
example_zh: 某项专利，即为一项发明申请/获得/取得专利

definition: a way or track that is built or is made by the action of people walking
example: a dirt/gravel/concrete path
definition_zh: 一条由人们行走而形成或修筑的小路或路径
example_zh: 一条土路/碎石路/混凝土路

definition: a track that serves as a path
example: They came out of the woods and onto a pathway.
definition_zh: 一条作为小径的轨道
example_zh: 他们走出树林，来到一条小路上。

definition: the ability to stay calm and accept a delay or something annoying without complaining
example: She has little patience with (= will not accept or consider) such views.
definition_zh: 能够保持冷静，在遇到延误或令人不快的事情时不抱怨地接受
example_zh: 她对这种观点几乎毫无耐心（= 不会接受或考虑）。

definition: able to wait for a long time or accept annoying behaviour or difficulties without becoming angry
example: You'll just have to be patient and wait till I'm finished.
definition_zh: 能够长时间等待，或在不发怒的情况下容忍令人讨厌的行为或困难
example_zh: 你只能耐心点，等我做完再说。

definition: a person who is receiving medical treatment, especially in a hospital
example: cancer/AIDS/heart patients
definition_zh: 正在接受治疗的人，尤其是在医院接受治疗的人
example_zh: 癌症/艾滋病/心脏病患者

definition: the act of going to different parts of a building, an area, etc. to make sure that there is no trouble or crime
example: Security guards make regular patrols at night.
definition_zh: 前往建筑物、区域等不同地点，以确保没有问题或犯罪行为的行为
example_zh: 保安人员会在夜间定期巡逻。

definition: to go around an area or a building at regular times to check that it is safe and that there is no trouble
example: Troops patrolled the border day and night.
definition_zh: 定期在某个区域或建筑物周围巡查，以确保安全且没有问题
example_zh: 部队日夜在边境巡逻。

definition: a person who gives money and support to artists and writers
example: Frederick the Great was the patron of many artists.
definition_zh: 向艺术家和作家提供资金和支持的人
example_zh: 腓特烈大帝是许多艺术家的赞助人。

definition: the regular way in which something happens or is done
example: changing patterns of urban life
definition_zh: 某事发生或被处理的常规方式
example_zh: 城市生活方式的变迁

definition: a period of time during which somebody stops talking or stops what they are doing
example: There was a long pause before she answered.
definition_zh: 某人停止说话或停止正在做的事情的一段时间
example_zh: 她沉默了许久才回答。

definition: to stop talking or doing something for a short time before continuing
example: Anita paused for a moment, then said: ‘All right’.
definition_zh: 暂时停止说话或做某事，然后继续
example_zh: 安妮塔停顿了一会儿，然后说：“好吧。”

definition: the money that somebody gets for doing regular work
example: Her job is hard work, but the pay is good.
definition_zh: 某人因从事常规工作而获得的报酬
example_zh: 她的工作虽然辛苦，但薪水很高。

definition: to give somebody money for work, goods, services, etc.
example: Who's paying?
definition_zh: 因工作、商品、服务等向某人支付金钱。
example_zh: 谁来付钱？

definition: the act of paying somebody/something or of being paid
example: What method of payment do you prefer?
definition_zh: 向某人/某物付款或收到付款的行为
example_zh: 您更倾向于哪种支付方式？

definition: a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area
example: world peace
definition_zh: 一个国家或地区没有战争或暴力的状况或时期
example_zh: 世界和平

definition: not involving a war, violence or argument
example: a peaceful protest/demonstration
definition_zh: 不涉及战争、暴力或争吵
example_zh: 一场和平抗议/示威活动

definition: the point when somebody/something is best, most successful, strongest, etc.
example: Traffic reaches its peak between 8 and 9 in the morning.
definition_zh: 指某人或某物处于最佳状态、最成功、最强大等时的时刻。
example_zh: 早上的交通高峰期在8点到9点之间。

definition: (especially in the past, or in poorer countries) a farmer who owns or rents a small piece of land
example: peasant farmers
definition_zh: （特别是在过去，或在较贫穷的国家）拥有或租用一小块土地的农民
example_zh: 小农

definition: strange or unusual, especially in a way that is unpleasant or makes you worried
example: a peculiar smell/taste
definition_zh: 奇怪或不同寻常，尤其是那种令人不快或让人感到担忧的情况
example_zh: 一种奇怪的气味/味道

definition: a person who is the same age or who has the same social status as you
example: She enjoys the respect of her peers.
definition_zh: 与你同龄或社会地位相同的人
example_zh: 她在同行中备受尊敬。

definition: an instrument made of plastic or metal used for writing with ink (= coloured liquid for writing, etc.)
example: an ink pen
definition_zh: 一种由塑料或金属制成的、用于蘸墨水（即用于书写等的有色液体）书写的工具
example_zh: 一支钢笔

definition: a punishment for breaking a law, rule or contract
example: to impose a penalty
definition_zh: 因违反法律、规则或合同而受到的处罚
example_zh: 处以罚款

definition: a narrow piece of wood, or a metal or plastic case, containing a black or coloured substance, used for drawing or writing
example: I'll get a pencil and paper.
definition_zh: 一块细长的木条，或一个金属或塑料笔管，内装黑色或彩色物质，用于绘画或书写
example_zh: 我去拿支铅笔和一张纸。

definition: a small British coin and unit of money. There are 100 pence in one pound (£1).
example: He had a few pennies in his pocket.
definition_zh: 一种英国的小面额硬币和货币单位。1英镑（£1）等于100便士。
example_zh: 他口袋里有几枚便士。

definition: an amount of money paid regularly to somebody when they retire from work
example: She receives a monthly pension.
definition_zh: 某人退休后定期领取的一笔款项
example_zh: 她每月领取一笔养老金。

definition: human beings; men, women and children
example: At least ten people were killed in the crash.
definition_zh: 人类；男人、女人和孩子
example_zh: 这起事故造成至少十人死亡。

definition: a powder made from dried berries (called peppercorns), used to give a hot, spicy taste to food
example: Season with salt and pepper
definition_zh: 一种由干燥的浆果（称为胡椒粒）制成的粉末，用于给食物增添辛辣的味道
example_zh: 撒上盐和胡椒调味

definition: used to express the cost or amount of something for each person, number used, distance travelled, etc.
example: Rooms cost £50 per person, per night.
definition_zh: 用于表示某物的人均成本或数量、使用人数、行驶距离等。
example_zh: 客房价格为每人每晚50英镑。

definition: by, in or for every hundred
example: a 15 per cent rise in price
definition_zh: 每百个……、每百个……或每百个……
example_zh: 价格上涨15%

definition: by, in or for every hundred
example: a 15 per cent rise in price
definition_zh: 每百个……、每百个……或每百个……
example_zh: 价格上涨15%

definition: one part in every hundred
example: per cent of something/somebody, Poor families spend about 80 to 90 per cent of their income on food.
definition_zh: 百分之一
example_zh: 某事/某人的百分比，贫困家庭约有80%至90%的收入用于购买食品。

definition: to understand or think of somebody/something in a particular way
example: perceive somebody/something/yourself (as something), This discovery was perceived as a major breakthrough.
definition_zh: 以某种特定方式理解或看待某人/某事
example_zh: 将某人/某物/自己视为（某物），这一发现被视为一项重大突破。

definition: the number, amount or rate of something, expressed as if it is part of a total that is 100; a part or share of a whole
example: percentage of something/somebody, What percentage of the population is/are overweight?
definition_zh: 某事物的数量、金额或比率，以占100的百分比形式表示；整体中的一部分或份额
example_zh: 某事/某人的百分比，超重人口占总人口的百分比是多少？

definition: an idea, a belief or an image you have as a result of how you see or understand something
example: a campaign to change public perception of the police
definition_zh: 你对某事物的看法或理解所形成的想法、信念或印象
example_zh: 一项旨在改变公众对警察看法的宣传活动

definition: having everything that is necessary; complete and without faults or weaknesses
example: in perfect condition
definition_zh: 具备一切必要条件；完整且无缺陷或弱点
example_zh: 状况极佳

definition: completely
example: It's perfectly normal to feel like this.
definition_zh: 完全地
example_zh: 有这种感觉是很正常的。

definition: to entertain an audience by playing a piece of music, acting in a play, etc.
example: to perform a song/dance/play
definition_zh: 通过演奏一首乐曲、出演一出戏剧等方式来娱乐观众。
example_zh: 表演一首歌曲/一支舞蹈/一出戏

definition: the act of performing a play, concert or some other form of entertainment
example: The performance starts at seven.
definition_zh: 演出戏剧、音乐会或其他形式的娱乐活动的行为
example_zh: 演出七点开始。

definition: possibly
example: ‘Are you going to come?’ ‘Perhaps. I'll see how I feel.’
definition_zh: 可能
example_zh: “你要来吗？”“也许吧。看我当时的心情。”

definition: a particular length of time
example: a long/an extended period
definition_zh: 一段特定的时间
example_zh: 一段很长的时间/较长的一段时间

definition: lasting for a long time or for all time in the future; existing all the time
example: She was unable to find a permanent job.
definition_zh: 在未来持续很长时间或永远；始终存在
example_zh: 她没能找到一份长期工作。

definition: in a way that lasts for a long time or for all time in the future; in a way that exists all the time
example: The stroke left his right side permanently damaged.
definition_zh: 以一种能够长期持续或在未来永远持续的方式；以一种始终存在的方式
example_zh: 中风导致他的右侧身体永久性受损。

definition: the act of allowing somebody to do something, especially when this is done by somebody in a position of authority
example: permission for something, You must ask permission for all major expenditure.
definition_zh: 允许某人做某事的行为，尤其是当此举由处于权威地位的人做出时
example_zh: 某事的许可，所有重大开支都必须事先征得许可。

definition: an official document that gives somebody the right to do something, especially for a limited period of time
example: a parking/building permit
definition_zh: 一份赋予某人某项权利的官方文件，尤其是指在限定时间内有效的文件
example_zh: 停车/建筑许可证

definition: to allow somebody to do something or to allow something to happen
example: be permitted, Mobile phones are not permitted in the examination room.
definition_zh: 允许某人做某事，或允许某事发生
example_zh: 允许，考场内不允许携带手机。

definition: to continue to do something despite difficulties or opposition, in a way that can seem unreasonable
example: persist in doing something, Why do you persist in blaming yourself for what happened?
definition_zh: 尽管面临困难或阻力，仍以一种看似不合理的方式坚持做某事
example_zh: 坚持做某事，你为什么坚持为发生的事自责呢？

definition: determined to do something despite difficulties, especially when other people are against you and think that you are being annoying or unreasonable
example: How do you deal with persistent salesmen who won't take no for an answer?
definition_zh: 尽管面临困难，仍决心去做某事，尤其是当别人反对你，认为你很烦人或不讲理的时候
example_zh: 面对那些不肯接受“不”作为答案的死缠烂打的推销员，你该如何应对？

definition: a human as an individual
example: What sort of person would do a thing like that?
definition_zh: 作为个体的一个人
example_zh: 什么样的人会干出这种事？

definition: your own; not belonging to or connected with anyone else
example: The novel is written from personal experience.
definition_zh: 属于你自己的；不属于或与任何其他人无关的
example_zh: 这部小说是根据亲身经历写成的。

definition: the various aspects of a person’s character that combine to make them different from other people
example: His wife has a strong personality.
definition_zh: 一个人性格的各个方面，这些方面综合起来使他与他人不同
example_zh: 他妻子性格很强。

definition: used to show that you are giving your own opinion about something
example: Personally, I prefer the second option.
definition_zh: 用于表明你对某事发表的是自己的看法
example_zh: 就我个人而言，我更倾向于第二种选择。

definition: the people who work for an organization or one of the armed forces
example: There is a severe shortage of skilled personnel.
definition_zh: 在某个组织或某支武装部队中工作的人员
example_zh: 技术人才严重短缺。

definition: a particular attitude towards something; a way of thinking about something
example: a global perspective
definition_zh: 对某事的一种特定态度；思考某事的一种方式
example_zh: 全球视角

definition: to make somebody do something by giving them good reasons for doing it
example: persuade somebody to do something, Try to persuade him to come.
definition_zh: 通过向某人提供充分的理由，促使他/她去做某事
example_zh: 说服某人做某事，试着说服他来吧。

definition: an animal, a bird, etc. that you have at home for pleasure, rather than one that is kept for work or food
example: Do you have any pets?
definition_zh: 指在家中为娱乐而饲养的动物、鸟类等，而非为劳动或食用而饲养的动物
example_zh: 你有宠物吗？

definition: a written document signed by a large number of people that asks somebody in a position of authority to do or change something
example: petition against something, Would you like to sign our petition against experiments on animals?
definition_zh: 一份由大量人士签署的书面文件，要求某位有权势的人采取行动或做出改变
example_zh: 反对某事的请愿书，您愿意签署我们反对动物实验的请愿书吗？

definition: a liquid obtained from petroleum, used as fuel in car engines, etc.
example: to fill a car up with petrol
definition_zh: 一种从石油中提炼出的液体，用作汽车发动机等的燃料。
example_zh: 给车加满油

definition: a stage in a process of change or development
example: during the initial/final phase
definition_zh: 变革或发展过程中的一个阶段
example_zh: 在初期/末期

definition: a fact or an event in nature or society, especially one that is not fully understood
example: cultural/natural phenomena
definition_zh: 自然界或社会中的一种现象或事件，尤其是尚未被完全理解的
example_zh: 文化/自然现象

definition: a person who studies or writes about philosophy
example: We studied the writings of the Greek philosopher Aristotle.
definition_zh: 研究或撰写哲学的人
example_zh: 我们研读了古希腊哲学家亚里士多德的著作。

definition: connected with philosophy
example: the philosophical writings of Kant
definition_zh: 与哲学有关
example_zh: 康德的哲学著作

definition: the study of the nature and meaning of the universe and of human life
example: philosophy of something, the philosophy of science
definition_zh: 对宇宙及人类生命的本质与意义的研究
example_zh: 某事的哲学，科学哲学

definition: a piece of equipment for talking to people who are not in the same place as you
example: I have to make a phone call.
definition_zh: 一种用于与不在同一地点的人通话的设备
example_zh: 我得打个电话。

definition: to make a phone call to somebody
example: I was just phoning up for a chat.
definition_zh: 给某人打个电话
example_zh: 我只是打个电话聊聊天。

definition: a picture that is made by using a camera that stores images in digital form or that has a film sensitive to light inside it
example: a colour/black-and-white photo
definition_zh: 使用相机拍摄的照片，该相机将图像以数字形式存储，或者内部装有感光胶片
example_zh: 彩色/黑白照片

definition: a picture that is made by using a camera that stores images in digital form or that has a film sensitive to light inside it
example: aerial photographs of the crash site
definition_zh: 使用相机拍摄的照片，该相机将图像以数字形式存储，或者内部装有感光胶片
example_zh: 事故现场的航拍照片

definition: to take a photograph of somebody/something
example: photograph somebody/something, a workshop on photographing wildlife
definition_zh: 给某人/某物拍照
example_zh: 拍摄某人/某物，野生动物摄影工作坊

definition: a person who takes photographs, especially as a job
example: a wedding/wildlife/fashion photographer
definition_zh: 拍摄照片的人，尤其是以此为职业的人
example_zh: 一位婚礼/野生动物/时尚摄影师

definition: the art, process or job of taking photographs or filming something
example: Her hobbies include hiking and photography.
definition_zh: 拍摄照片或录像的艺术、过程或工作
example_zh: 她的爱好包括徒步旅行和摄影。

definition: a group of words that have a particular meaning when used together
example: a memorable/catchy phrase
definition_zh: 一组词语，当它们组合在一起时具有特定含义
example_zh: 一句令人难忘/朗朗上口的短语

definition: connected with a person’s body rather than their mind
example: physical activity/fitness
definition_zh: 与一个人的身体有关，而非其思想
example_zh: 体育活动/健身

definition: a doctor, especially one who is a specialist in general medicine and not surgery
example: Dr Dennett is a practicing family physician in Atlanta.
definition_zh: 医生，尤其是专攻全科医学而非外科的医生
example_zh: 丹尼特医生是亚特兰大的一名执业全科医生。

definition: the scientific study of matter and energy and the relationships between them, including the study of forces, heat, light, sound, electricity and the structure of atoms
example: a degree in physics
definition_zh: 对物质和能量及其之间关系的科学研究，包括对力、热、光、声、电以及原子结构的研究
example_zh: 物理学学位

definition: a large musical instrument played by pressing the black and white keys on the keyboard. The sound is produced by small hammers hitting the metal strings inside the piano.
example: to play the piano
definition_zh: 一种大型乐器，演奏时需按下键盘上的黑键和白键。声音是由小锤敲击钢琴内部的金属琴弦产生的。
example_zh: 弹钢琴

definition: an act of choosing something
example: Take your pick (= choose).
definition_zh: 一种选择某物的行为
example_zh: 任选其一（= 选择）。

definition: to choose somebody/something from a group of people or things
example: pick somebody/something, Pick a number from one to twenty.
definition_zh: 从一群人或事物中挑选某人或某物
example_zh: 选一个人/一样东西，从1到20中选一个数字。

definition: a painting or drawing, etc. that shows a scene, a person or thing
example: He likes books with lots of pictures in them.
definition_zh: 一幅描绘场景、人物或事物的绘画或素描等
example_zh: 他喜欢里面有很多图片的书。

definition: to imagine somebody/something; to create an image of somebody/something in your mind
example: picture somebody/something, I could picture the scene clearly.
definition_zh: 想象某人/某物；在脑海中构想出某人/某物的形象
example_zh: 想象某人/某物，我能清晰地想象出那个场景。

definition: an amount of something that has been cut or separated from the rest of it; a standard amount of something
example: piece of something, She wrote something on a small piece of paper.
definition_zh: 从整体中切下或分离出来的一定数量；某物的标准份量
example_zh: 某物的碎片，她在一小张纸上写了点什么。

definition: an animal with pink, black or brown skin, short legs, a broad nose and a short curly tail. Pigs are kept on farms for their meat (called pork) or live in the wild.
example: a pig farmer
definition_zh: 一种皮肤呈粉色、黑色或棕色，四肢短小，鼻部宽大，尾巴短而卷曲的动物。猪有的被饲养在农场以获取肉类（称为猪肉），有的则生活在野外。
example_zh: 一位养猪户

definition: a number of things that have been placed on top of each other
example: pile of something, a pile of clothes/paper
definition_zh: 一些堆叠在一起的东西
example_zh: 一堆什么东西，一堆衣服/纸张

definition: to put things one on top of another; to form a pile
example: pile something, She piled the boxes one on top of the other.
definition_zh: 将东西一层层堆叠起来；堆成一堆
example_zh: 堆放某物，她把箱子一个接一个地堆叠起来。

definition: a small flat round piece of medicine that you swallow whole, without biting it
example: a vitamin pill
definition_zh: 一种小而扁平的圆形药片，需整片吞服，不要咀嚼
example_zh: 一粒维生素片

definition: a person who operates the controls of an aircraft, especially as a job
example: an airline pilot
definition_zh: 操作飞机操纵装置的人，尤其是以此为职业的人
example_zh: 一名航空公司飞行员

definition: a short thin piece of stiff wire with a sharp point at one end and a round head at the other, used especially for fastening together pieces of cloth when sewing
example: Use pins to keep the patch in place while you sew it on.
definition_zh: 一段短而细的硬质金属丝，一端呈尖头，另一端呈圆头，主要用于缝纫时将布片固定在一起
example_zh: 缝补时，请用大头针将补丁固定好。

definition: to attach something onto another thing or fasten things together with a pin, etc.
example: She pinned the badge onto her jacket.
definition_zh: 将某物固定在另一物体上，或用别针等将物体固定在一起。
example_zh: 她把徽章别在了夹克上。

definition: pale red in colour
example: pale pink roses
definition_zh: 呈淡红色
example_zh: 淡粉色的玫瑰

definition: the colour that is produced when you mix red and white together
example: She was dressed in pink.
definition_zh: 将红色和白色混合后产生的颜色
example_zh: 她穿了一身粉色的衣服。

definition: a person who is the first to study and develop a particular area of knowledge, culture, etc. that other people then continue to develop
example: a pioneer in the field of microsurgery
definition_zh: 指率先研究和开拓某一特定知识、文化等领域的人，此后其他人则在此基础上继续发展该领域。
example_zh: 显微外科领域的先驱

definition: when somebody pioneers something, they are one of the first people to do, discover or use something new
example: a new technique pioneered by surgeons in a London hospital
definition_zh: 当某人开创某项事业时，他就是最早从事、发现或使用某项新事物的人之一。
example_zh: 伦敦一家医院的外科医生首创的一种新技术

definition: a tube through which liquids and gases can flow
example: Both hot and cold water pipes should be properly insulated.
definition_zh: 一种可供液体和气体流经的管子
example_zh: 冷热水管都应进行适当的保温处理。

definition: a series of pipes that are usually underground and are used for carrying oil, gas, etc. over long distances
example: There are plans to lay a gas pipeline through the region.
definition_zh: 通常埋设于地下的管道系统，用于长距离输送石油、天然气等。
example_zh: 目前计划在该地区铺设一条天然气管道。

definition: (especially in the past) a person on a ship who attacks other ships at sea in order to steal from them
example: There were reports that a pirate ship had come looking for treasure in the cove.
definition_zh: （尤指过去）指船上为抢劫而袭击其他船只的人
example_zh: 有报道称，一艘海盗船曾来到这个海湾寻找宝藏。

definition: a large deep hole in the ground
example: We dug a deep pit in the yard.
definition_zh: 地面上一个又大又深的洞
example_zh: 我们在院子里挖了一个深坑。

definition: an area of ground specially prepared and marked for playing a sports game
example: a football pitch
definition_zh: 为进行体育比赛而专门准备并划定的一块场地
example_zh: 一个足球场

definition: used to show that you are disappointed about something
example: a pity (that…), It's a pity that you can't stay longer.
definition_zh: 用于表达对某事感到失望
example_zh: 真可惜（……），真可惜你不能多待一会儿。

definition: a particular position, point or area
example: in a place, Keep your purse in a safe place.
definition_zh: 某个位置、点或区域
example_zh: 在某处，请将钱包放在安全的地方。

definition: to put something in a particular place, especially when you do it carefully or deliberately
example: He placed his hand on her shoulder.
definition_zh: 将某物放在特定位置，尤其是小心或有意识地这样做时
example_zh: 他把手搭在她的肩膀上。

definition: the act of finding somebody a suitable job or place to live
example: a job placement service
definition_zh: 为某人寻找合适的工作或住所的行为
example_zh: 一项就业安置服务

definition: not decorated or complicated; simple
example: a plain but elegant dress
definition_zh: 不花哨，也不复杂；简单
example_zh: 一条简约而优雅的连衣裙

definition: something that you intend to do or achieve
example: plan for something, Do you have any plans for the summer?
definition_zh: 你打算做或实现的事情
example_zh: 计划做点什么，你对这个夏天有什么计划吗？

definition: to make detailed arrangements for something you want to do in the future
example: plan something, to plan a trip
definition_zh: 为将来想做的事情制定详细计划
example_zh: 计划某事，计划一次旅行

definition: a flying vehicle with wings and one or more engines
example: a passenger/fighter/military/private plane
definition_zh: 一种带有机翼和一个或多个发动机的飞行器
example_zh: 客机/战斗机/军用飞机/私人飞机

definition: a large round object in space that moves around a star (such as the sun) and receives light from it
example: the planets of our solar system
definition_zh: 太空中一个围绕恒星（如太阳）运转并从其接收光线的大型圆形天体
example_zh: 我们太阳系的行星

definition: the act or process of making plans for something
example: The department is responsible for all financial planning.
definition_zh: 为某事制定计划的行为或过程
example_zh: 该部门负责所有的财务规划。

definition: a living thing that grows in the earth and usually has a stem, leaves and roots, especially one that is smaller than a tree or bush
example: All plants need light and water.
definition_zh: 生长在土壤中的生物，通常具有茎、叶和根，尤其是比树或灌木更小的那种
example_zh: 所有植物都需要光和水。

definition: to put plants, seeds, etc. in the ground to grow
example: to plant a tree/seed/crop
definition_zh: 将植物、种子等种入土中以供生长
example_zh: 种植一棵树/一粒种子/一种作物

definition: made of plastic
example: a plastic bag/bottle/cup
definition_zh: 由塑料制成
example_zh: 一个塑料袋/瓶/杯

definition: a light strong material that is produced by chemical processes and can be formed into shapes when heated. There are many different types of plastic, used to make different objects and fabrics.
example: The pipes should be made of plastic.
definition_zh: 一种轻质且坚韧的材料，通过化学工艺制成，加热后可塑造成各种形状。塑料种类繁多，可用于制造各种物品和织物。
example_zh: 管道应采用塑料制成。

definition: a flat, usually round, dish that you put food on
example: sandwiches on a plate
definition_zh: 一种平底的、通常是圆形的盘子，用来盛放食物
example_zh: 盘子里的三明治

definition: the raised flat area next to the track at a train station where you get on or off the train
example: (British English), What platform does it go from?
definition_zh: 火车站站台上紧邻轨道、供乘客上下车的隆起平坦区域
example_zh: （英国英语），这是从哪个平台发出的？

definition: a piece of writing performed by actors in a theatre or on television or radio
example: a stage/radio play
definition_zh: 由演员在剧院、电视或广播中演绎的一部作品
example_zh: 一部舞台剧/广播剧

definition: to do things for pleasure, as children do; to enjoy yourself, rather than work
example: You'll have to play inside today.
definition_zh: 像孩子一样，为了乐趣而做事；享受生活，而不是工作
example_zh: 今天你们得在室内玩了。

definition: a person who takes part in a game or sport
example: a football/tennis/chess player
definition_zh: 参加比赛或体育运动的人
example_zh: 一名足球/网球/国际象棋运动员

definition: a serious emotional request, especially for something needing action now
example: plea for something, She made an impassioned plea for help.
definition_zh: 一项严肃而真挚的请求，尤其是针对需要立即采取行动的事情
example_zh: 恳求某事，她恳切地请求帮助。

definition: to ask somebody for something in a very strong and serious way
example: plead (with somebody) (to do something), She pleaded with him not to go.
definition_zh: 以非常强烈且严肃的方式向某人提出请求
example_zh: 恳求（某人）（做某事），她恳求他不要走。

definition: fun, attractive, or giving pleasure
example: a pleasant evening/atmosphere/walk
definition_zh: 有趣的、有吸引力的或令人愉悦的
example_zh: 一个愉快的夜晚/氛围/散步

definition: used as a polite way of asking for something or telling somebody to do something
example: Please sit down.
definition_zh: 用作礼貌地提出请求或请人做某事的表达方式
example_zh: 请坐。

definition: to make somebody happy
example: please somebody, You can't please everybody.
definition_zh: 让某人开心
example_zh: 拜托了，总不能让所有人满意。

definition: feeling happy about something
example: You're coming? I'm so pleased.
definition_zh: 对某事感到高兴
example_zh: 你要来吗？我太高兴了。

definition: a state of feeling or being happy or satisfied
example: His eyes lit up with pleasure.
definition_zh: 一种感到快乐或满足的状态
example_zh: 他的眼睛因喜悦而亮了起来。

definition: a serious promise
example: pledge (of something), a pledge of support
definition_zh: 一项郑重的承诺
example_zh: 承诺（某事），支持的承诺

definition: to formally promise to give or do something
example: pledge something, Japan has pledged $100 million in humanitarian aid.
definition_zh: 正式承诺给予或做某事
example_zh: 承诺提供援助，日本已承诺提供1亿美元的人道主义援助。

definition: a large amount; as much or as many as you need
example: plenty of eggs/money/time
definition_zh: 大量；随你需要的多少
example_zh: 大量的鸡蛋/钱/时间

definition: the series of events that form the story of a novel, play, film, etc.
example: It's hard to follow the plot of the film.
definition_zh: 构成小说、戏剧、电影等故事的一系列事件。
example_zh: 这部电影的剧情很难跟上。

definition: to make a secret plan to harm somebody, especially a government or its leader
example: plot with somebody, It is claimed he plotted with the country's enemies.
definition_zh: 密谋加害某人，尤其是政府或其领导人
example_zh: 与某人密谋，据称他与该国的敌人密谋。

definition: a small plastic object with two or three metal pins that connects a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity
example: The iron is fitted with a three-pin plug.
definition_zh: 一个带有两三根金属插脚的小型塑料部件，用于将某台电气设备连接到主电源
example_zh: 熨斗配有一个三脚插头。

definition: to fill a hole with a substance or piece of material that fits tightly into it
example: He plugged the hole in the pipe with an old rag.
definition_zh: 用某种物质或材料填补一个孔洞，使其与孔洞紧密贴合
example_zh: 他用一块旧抹布堵住了管道上的洞。

definition: to move or make somebody/something move suddenly forwards and/or downwards
example: + adv./prep., She lost her balance and plunged 100 feet to her death.
definition_zh: 使某人或某物突然向前和/或向下移动
example_zh: + 副词/介词，她失去平衡，从100英尺高处坠落身亡。

definition: used after a number to show that the real number or amount is more than the one mentioned
example: The work will cost £10 000 plus.
definition_zh: 用于数字之后，表示该实际数值或数量大于所提到的那个数值
example_zh: 这项工程的费用将超过10 000英镑。

definition: used to add more information
example: I've got too much on at work. Plus my father is not well.
definition_zh: 用于添加更多信息
example_zh: 我手头的工作太多了。而且我父亲身体不太好。

definition: an advantage; a good thing
example: Knowledge of French is a plus in her job.
definition_zh: 优势；好处
example_zh: 在她的工作中，会说法语是一大优势。

definition: used when the two numbers or amounts mentioned are being added together
example: Two plus five is seven.
definition_zh: 用于将所提到的两个数字或数值相加时
example_zh: 二加五等于七。

definition: a small piece of material like a small bag sewn into or onto a piece of clothing so that you can carry things in it
example: a jacket/coat/shirt/trouser pocket
definition_zh: 像小袋子一样的一小块布料，缝在衣服上或缝进衣服里，以便用来装东西
example_zh: 夹克/大衣/衬衫/裤子的口袋

definition: a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their sound and the images they suggest, not just for their obvious meanings. The words are arranged in separate lines, usually with a repeated rhythm, and often the lines rhyme at the end.
example: His collected poems were published after the war.
definition_zh: 一种文学体裁，其中词语的选择不仅基于其字面含义，还基于其发音及所唤起的意象。词语被安排在各自的诗行中，通常具有重复的韵律，且诗行末尾常押韵。
example_zh: 他的诗集是在战后出版的。

definition: a person who writes poems
example: an internationally renowned poet
definition_zh: 写诗的人
example_zh: 一位享誉国际的诗人

definition: poems in general; poems as a genre of literature
example: lyric/epic poetry
definition_zh: 诗歌的概览；诗歌作为一种文学体裁
example_zh: 抒情诗/史诗

definition: a thing that somebody says or writes giving their opinion or stating a fact
example: She made several interesting points in the article.
definition_zh: 某人说或写下的、表达其观点或陈述事实的内容
example_zh: 她在文章中提出了一些有趣的观点。

definition: to stretch out your finger or something held in your hand towards somebody/something in order to show somebody where a person or thing is
example: point at somebody/something, ‘What's your name?’ he asked, pointing at the child with his pen.
definition_zh: 伸出手指或将手中拿的东西指向某人/某物，以向他人指明该人或该物所在的位置
example_zh: 指着某人/某物，“你叫什么名字？”他一边问，一边用笔指着那个孩子。

definition: having a sharp end
example: a pointed chin
definition_zh: 有一个尖端
example_zh: 尖下巴

definition: a substance that causes death or harm if it gets into the body
example: Some mushrooms contain a deadly poison.
definition_zh: 一种一旦进入人体就会导致死亡或伤害的物质
example_zh: 有些蘑菇含有致命的毒素。

definition: to harm or kill a person or an animal by giving them poison
example: poison somebody/yourself, He was believed to poison his enemies.
definition_zh: 通过给某人或某动物下毒来伤害或杀害他们
example_zh: 毒害某人/自己，据信他曾毒害过自己的敌人。

definition: causing death or illness if swallowed or taken into the body
example: poisonous chemicals/fumes/plants
definition_zh: 若被吞咽或进入体内，会导致死亡或疾病
example_zh: 有毒化学品/烟雾/植物

definition: a long thin straight piece of wood or metal, especially one with the end placed in the ground, used as a support
example: a tent pole
definition_zh: 一根细长笔直的木棍或金属棒，尤其是其一端插入地中作为支撑的
example_zh: 一根帐篷杆

definition: an official organization whose job is to make people obey the law and to prevent and solve crime; the people who work for this organization
example: Get out of the house or I'll call the police.
definition_zh: 一个官方机构，其职责是确保人们遵守法律，并预防和解决犯罪；该机构的工作人员
example_zh: 赶紧离开这房子，否则我就报警。

definition: a male police officer
example: a plain-clothes/uniformed policeman
definition_zh: 一名男警官
example_zh: 一名便衣/制服警察

definition: a plan of action agreed or chosen by a political party, a business, etc.
example: policy on something, the present government’s policy on education
definition_zh: 由政党、企业等商定或选定的行动计划。
example_zh: 关于某事的政策，现政府的教育政策

definition: having or showing good manners and respect for the feelings of others
example: polite to somebody, Please be polite to our guests.
definition_zh: 具有或表现出良好的礼仪，并尊重他人的感受
example_zh: 对某人礼貌一点，请对我们的客人礼貌一点。

definition: connected with the state, government or public affairs
example: a monarch without political power
definition_zh: 与国家、政府或公共事务有关
example_zh: 一位没有政治权力的君主

definition: a person whose job involves politics, especially as an elected member of parliament, etc.
example: democratically elected politicians
definition_zh: 从事政治工作的人，尤其是作为民选议员等。
example_zh: 经民主选举产生的政治家

definition: the activities involved in getting and using power in public life, and being able to influence decisions that affect a country or a society
example: world/international politics
definition_zh: 在公共生活中获取和行使权力所涉及的活动，以及能够对影响一个国家或社会的决策施加影响
example_zh: 世界/国际政治

definition: the process of questioning people who are representative of a larger group in order to get information about the general opinion
example: to carry out/conduct a poll
definition_zh: 通过询问能够代表某个较大群体的个人，以了解该群体普遍意见的过程
example_zh: 进行/开展一项民意调查

definition: the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty; the state of being dirty
example: air/water pollution
definition_zh: 使空气、水、土壤等受到污染的过程；处于污染的状态
example_zh: 空气/水污染

definition: a small area of still water, especially one that is artificial
example: a fish pond
definition_zh: 一小片静水区域，尤其是人工形成的静水区域
example_zh: 一个鱼塘

definition: an area of water that has been created for people to swim in
example: an indoor/outdoor pool
definition_zh: 为供人们游泳而开辟的水域
example_zh: 室内/室外游泳池

definition: having very little money; not having enough money for basic needs
example: They were too poor to buy shoes for the kids.
definition_zh: 手头非常拮据；连基本生活所需都难以维持
example_zh: 他们太穷了，买不起孩子的鞋子。

definition: connected with modern popular music
example: a pop song
definition_zh: 与现代流行音乐有关
example_zh: 一首流行歌曲

definition: popular music of the sort that has been popular since the 1950s, usually with a strong rhythm and simple tunes, often contrasted with rock, soul and other forms of popular music
example: rock, pop and soul
definition_zh: 一种自20世纪50年代以来一直广受欢迎的流行音乐，通常节奏鲜明、旋律简单，常与摇滚、灵魂乐及其他形式的流行音乐相对比
example_zh: 摇滚、流行和灵魂乐

definition: to make a short explosive sound; to cause something to make this sound
example: the sound of corks popping
definition_zh: 发出短促的爆裂声；使某物发出这种声音
example_zh: 开瓶声

definition: liked or enjoyed by a large number of people
example: Andalucia is a popular tourist destination.
definition_zh: 受到大量人群的喜爱或欣赏
example_zh: 安达卢西亚是一个备受游客青睐的旅游胜地。

definition: the state of being liked, enjoyed or supported by a large number of people
example: the increasing popularity of cycling
definition_zh: 受到大量人群喜爱、欣赏或支持的状态
example_zh: 骑行日益流行

definition: all the people who live in a particular area, city or country; the total number of people who live there
example: One third of the world’s population consumes/consume two thirds of the world’s resources.
definition_zh: 居住在某个特定地区、城市或国家的所有人；居住在那里的人的总数
example_zh: 全球三分之一的人口消耗了全球三分之二的资源。

definition: a town or city with a harbour, especially one where ships load and unload goods
example: a container/fishing ports
definition_zh: 拥有港口的小镇或城市，尤其是那些船舶在此装卸货物的城镇
example_zh: 集装箱/渔港

definition: a thin flat case used for carrying documents, drawings, etc.
example: I left my portfolio on the train.
definition_zh: 一种用于装载文件、图纸等的薄而扁平的盒子。
example_zh: 我把我的作品集忘在火车上了。

definition: one part of something larger
example: a substantial/significant portion of the population
definition_zh: 更大整体中的一部分
example_zh: 相当大一部分人口

definition: a painting, drawing or photograph of a person, especially of the head and shoulders
example: portrait of somebody, a portrait of his wife
definition_zh: 一幅以人物为题材的油画、素描或照片，尤其是以人物的头部和肩部为主体的作品
example_zh: 某人的肖像，他妻子的肖像

definition: to show somebody/something in a picture; to describe somebody/something in a piece of writing
example: The painting portrays the duke’s third wife.
definition_zh: 在图片中展示某人/某物；在文章中描述某人/某物
example_zh: 这幅画描绘的是公爵的第三任妻子。

definition: to create a threat, problem, etc. that has to be dealt with
example: to pose a threat/risk/challenge/danger
definition_zh: 制造一种必须加以应对的威胁、问题等
example_zh: 构成威胁/风险/挑战/危险

definition: the place where somebody/something is located
example: Where would be the best position for the lights?
definition_zh: 某人或某物所在的位置
example_zh: 灯安装在什么位置最好？

definition: to put somebody/something in a particular position
example: position somebody/something/yourself + adv./prep., She quickly positioned herself behind the desk.
definition_zh: 使某人/某物处于某种特定境地
example_zh: 将某人/某物/自己置于……位置 + 副词/介词，她迅速将自己置于办公桌后面。

definition: good or useful
example: The tests have so far yielded positive results.
definition_zh: 好或有用
example_zh: 到目前为止，这些测试已取得积极成果。

definition: a good or useful quality or aspect
example: What are the positives and negatives of going this route?
definition_zh: 一种良好的或有用的品质或方面
example_zh: 走这条路有哪些利弊？

definition: to have or own something
example: He was charged with possessing a shotgun without a licence.
definition_zh: 拥有某物
example_zh: 他被指控在未取得许可证的情况下持有霰弹枪。

definition: something that you own or have with you at a particular time
example: Prisoners were allowed no personal possessions.
definition_zh: 你在特定时刻所拥有或随身携带的某样东西
example_zh: 囚犯不允许拥有任何个人物品。

definition: a thing that may happen or be true; the fact that something might happen or be true, but is not certain
example: Bankruptcy is a real possibility if sales don't improve.
definition_zh: 可能发生或属实的事情；某事可能发生或属实，但尚未确定
example_zh: 如果销售额没有起色，破产的可能性确实存在。

definition: that can be done or achieved
example: possible to do something, New technology has made it possible to communicate more easily.
definition_zh: 可以做到或实现的
example_zh: 做某件事是可能的，新技术使得沟通变得更加容易。

definition: used to say that something might exist, happen or be true, but you are not certain
example: It was possibly their worst performance ever.
definition_zh: 用于表示某事可能存在、发生或属实，但你并不确定
example_zh: 这可能是他们有史以来最差的表现。

definition: the official system used for sending and delivering letters, packages, etc.
example: by post, I'll send the original to you by post.
definition_zh: 用于寄送和投递信件、包裹等的官方系统。
example_zh: 通过邮寄，我会把原件寄给您。

definition: to send a letter, etc. to somebody by post
example: post something, The cost of posting a letter has gone up again.
definition_zh: 通过邮寄方式给某人寄一封信等
example_zh: 寄点东西，寄信的费用又涨了。

definition: existing, happening or made in the period after a war, especially the Second World War
example: the post-war years
definition_zh: 指在战争（尤其是第二次世界大战）结束后这一时期内存在的、发生的或制作的
example_zh: 战后时期

definition: a large notice, often with a picture on it, that is put in a public place to advertise something
example: campaign/election posters
definition_zh: 一张通常印有图片的大型告示，张贴在公共场所用于宣传某事
example_zh: 竞选/选举海报

definition: to arrange for an event, etc. to take place at a later time or date than originally planned
example: postpone something, The game has already been postponed three times.
definition_zh: 将某项活动等安排在比原计划更晚的时间或日期举行
example_zh: 推迟某事，这场比赛已经被推迟了三次。

definition: a deep round container used for cooking things in
example: pots and pans
definition_zh: 一种用于烹饪食物的深而圆的容器
example_zh: 锅碗瓢盆

definition: a round white vegetable with a brown or red skin that grows underground as part of a plant also called a potato
example: Will you peel the potatoes for me?
definition_zh: 一种圆形的白色蔬菜，表皮呈棕色或红色，生长在地下，是某种植物的一部分，也被称为土豆
example_zh: 你能帮我把土豆削皮吗？

definition: that can develop into something or be developed in the future
example: potential customers/buyers/investors/clients
definition_zh: 未来可能发展成某种东西，或者在未来被开发出来
example_zh: 潜在客户/买家/投资者/客户

definition: the possibility of something happening or being developed or used
example: potential for something, the potential for change
definition_zh: 某事发生、被开发或被使用的可能性
example_zh: 某事的潜力，变革的潜力

definition: used to say that something may develop into something
example: a potentially dangerous situation
definition_zh: 常说某事可能会发展成另一件事
example_zh: 一种可能危及安全的状况

definition: the unit of money in the UK, worth 100 pence
example: a ten-pound note
definition_zh: 英国的货币单位，相当于100便士
example_zh: 一张十英镑钞票

definition: to make a liquid or other substance flow from a container in a continuous stream, especially by holding the container at an angle
example: pour something + adv./prep., Pour the sauce over the pasta.
definition_zh: 使液体或其他物质从容器中以连续的流状流出，尤其是通过将容器倾斜来实现
example_zh: 将……倒在……上 + 副词/介词，将酱汁浇在意大利面上。

definition: the state of being poor
example: conditions of extreme/abject poverty
definition_zh: 贫困的状态
example_zh: 极端/赤贫状况

definition: a dry mass of very small fine pieces or grains
example: milk/chilli/cocoa powder
definition_zh: 由极细小的碎屑或颗粒组成的干燥物质
example_zh: 奶粉/辣椒粉/可可粉

definition: the ability to control people or things
example: power to do something, He has the power to make things very unpleasant for us.
definition_zh: 控制他人或事物的能力
example_zh: 有能力做某事，祂也有能力让我们过得很难受。

definition: to supply a machine or vehicle with the energy that makes it work
example: be powered (by something), The aircraft is powered by a jet engine.
definition_zh: 为机器或车辆提供使其运转所需的能量
example_zh: 由……提供动力，该飞机由喷气发动机提供动力。

definition: being able to control and influence people and events
example: an incredibly powerful organization
definition_zh: 能够控制和影响人和事件
example_zh: 一个极其强大的组织

definition: connected with real situations rather than with ideas or theories
example: to have gained practical experience of the work
definition_zh: 与实际情况相关，而非与观念或理论相关
example_zh: 在该工作中积累了实践经验

definition: doing an activity or training regularly so that you can improve your skill; the time you spend doing this
example: conversation practice
definition_zh: 定期进行某项活动或训练，以提高自己的技能；用于此活动的时间
example_zh: 会话练习

definition: to do an activity or train regularly so that you can improve your skill
example: You need to practise every day.
definition_zh: 定期参加某项活动或进行训练，以便提高自己的技能
example_zh: 你需要每天练习。

definition: a person who works in a profession, especially medicine or law
example: dental practitioners
definition_zh: 从事某项专业工作的人，尤其是医学或法律领域的人
example_zh: 牙科从业人员

definition: words that show that you approve of and admire somebody/something
example: The team coach singled out two players for special praise.
definition_zh: 表示你赞同并钦佩某人或某事的词语
example_zh: 球队教练特别表扬了两名球员。

definition: to say that you approve of and admire somebody/something
example: praise somebody/something, She praised his cooking.
definition_zh: 表示你赞同并钦佩某人或某事
example_zh: 称赞某人/某事，她称赞他的厨艺。

definition: to speak to God, especially to give thanks or ask for help
example: They knelt down and prayed.
definition_zh: 向上帝祈祷，尤其是为了表达感谢或寻求帮助
example_zh: 他们跪下来祈祷。

definition: words that you say to God giving thanks or asking for help
example: to say your prayers
definition_zh: 你对上帝说的话，无论是表达感谢还是寻求帮助
example_zh: 做祷告

definition: to give a religious talk in a public place, especially in a church during a service
example: She preached to the congregation about forgiveness.
definition_zh: 在公共场所，尤其是教堂的礼拜仪式期间，进行宗教讲道
example_zh: 她向会众讲道，主题是宽恕。

definition: to happen before something or come before something/somebody in order
example: the years preceding the war
definition_zh: 在某事之前发生，或在顺序上排在某事或某人之前
example_zh: 战前几年

definition: an official action or decision that has happened in the past and that is seen as an example or a rule to be followed in a similar situation later
example: The ruling set a precedent for future libel cases.
definition_zh: 过去发生过的一项官方行动或决定，被视为日后在类似情况下应遵循的范例或规则
example_zh: 该判决为今后的诽谤案件树立了先例。

definition: rare and worth a lot of money
example: a precious vase
definition_zh: 稀有且价值不菲
example_zh: 一只珍贵的花瓶

definition: clear and accurate
example: precise details/instructions/measurements
definition_zh: 清晰准确
example_zh: 具体细节/说明/尺寸

definition: exactly
example: They look precisely the same to me.
definition_zh: 正是如此
example_zh: 在我看来，它们看起来完全一样。

definition: the quality of being exact, accurate and careful
example: Her writing is imaginative but lacks precision.
definition_zh: 精确、准确和细致的特质
example_zh: 她的写作富有想象力，但不够精准。

definition: an animal that kills and eats other animals
example: Some animals have no natural predators.
definition_zh: 一种捕杀并吞食其他动物的动物
example_zh: 有些动物没有天敌。

definition: a person who did a job before somebody else
example: The new president reversed many of the policies of his predecessor.
definition_zh: 比某人更早完成某项工作的人
example_zh: 新总统推翻了前任的许多政策。

definition: to say that something will happen in the future
example: predict something, a reliable method of predicting earthquakes
definition_zh: 表示某事将来会发生
example_zh: 预测某事，一种可靠的地震预测方法

definition: if something is predictable, you know in advance that it will happen or what it will be like
example: a predictable result
definition_zh: 如果某件事是可预见的，你就事先知道它会发生，或者会是什么样子
example_zh: 意料之中的结果

definition: a statement that says what you think will happen; the act of making such a statement
example: The results of the experiment confirmed our predictions.
definition_zh: 一种表达你认为将会发生什么的陈述；做出此类陈述的行为
example_zh: 实验结果证实了我们的预测。

definition: mostly; mainly
example: She works in a predominantly male environment.
definition_zh: 大多；主要
example_zh: 她在以男性为主的工作环境中工作。

definition: to like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than something else because you like it better
example: prefer something, ‘Coffee or tea?’ ‘I'd prefer tea, thanks.’
definition_zh: 比另一件事或另一个人更喜欢某件事或某个人；因为更喜欢某件事，所以选择它而不是其他事情
example_zh: 更喜欢某样东西，“咖啡还是茶？”“我更喜欢茶，谢谢。”

definition: a greater interest in or desire for somebody/something than somebody/something else
example: It's a matter of personal preference.
definition_zh: 对某人/某事比对另一个人/另一件事更感兴趣或更渴望
example_zh: 这纯属个人喜好问题。

definition: the state of being pregnant
example: a pregnancy test
definition_zh: 怀孕的状态
example_zh: 妊娠测试

definition: having a baby or young animal developing inside her/its body
example: My wife is pregnant.
definition_zh: 体内正孕育着一个婴儿或幼崽
example_zh: 我妻子怀孕了。

definition: an unreasonable dislike of or preference for a person, group, custom, etc., especially when it is based on their race, religion, sex, etc.
example: a victim of racial prejudice
definition_zh: 对某人、某群体、某种习俗等怀有不合理的厌恶或偏爱，尤其是当这种态度基于其种族、宗教、性别等因素时。
example_zh: 种族偏见的受害者

definition: happening before a more important action or event
example: After a few preliminary remarks he announced the winners.
definition_zh: 发生在更重要的行动或事件之前
example_zh: 在发表了几句开场白后，他宣布了获奖者名单。

definition: most important, famous or successful
example: one of the country’s premier chefs
definition_zh: 最重要的、最著名的或最成功的
example_zh: 该国顶尖主厨之一

definition: a statement or an idea that forms the basis for a reasonable line of argument
example: the basic premise of her argument
definition_zh: 构成合理论证基础的论点或观点
example_zh: 她论点的基本前提

definition: an amount of money that you pay once or regularly for an insurance policy
example: a monthly premium of £6.25
definition_zh: 您为一份保险单一次性或定期支付的一笔款项
example_zh: 每月保费为6.25英镑

definition: the act or process of getting ready for something or making something ready
example: food preparation
definition_zh: 为某事做准备或使某物做好准备的行为或过程
example_zh: 食物准备

definition: to make something or somebody ready to be used or to do something
example: prepare something/somebody, to prepare a report
definition_zh: 使某物或某人做好准备，以便使用或做某事
example_zh: 准备某事/某人，准备一份报告

definition: ready and able to deal with something
example: We'll be better prepared next time.
definition_zh: 已做好准备并有能力应对某事
example_zh: 下次我们会准备得更充分。

definition: to tell somebody to take a particular medicine or have a particular treatment; to write a prescription for a particular medicine, etc.
example: prescribe something, Valium is usually prescribed to treat anxiety.
definition_zh: 指示某人服用某种药物或接受某种治疗；为某种药物等开具处方。
example_zh: 开处方，安定通常用于治疗焦虑。

definition: an official piece of paper on which a doctor writes the type of medicine you should have, and which enables you to get it from a chemist's
example: prescription for something, The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics.
definition_zh: 一张由医生开具的正式单据，上面写明了你应服用的药物种类，凭此单据你可以去药房领取药物
example_zh: 某物的处方，医生给我开了一张抗生素的处方。

definition: the fact of being in a particular place
example: He hardly seemed to notice my presence.
definition_zh: 身处某地的这一事实
example_zh: 他似乎几乎没注意到我的存在。

definition: existing or happening now
example: I am not satisfied with the present situation.
definition_zh: 现有的或正在发生的
example_zh: 我对目前的状况并不满意。

definition: a thing that you give to somebody as a gift
example: What can I get him for a birthday present?
definition_zh: 送给某人的礼物
example_zh: 我该给他买什么生日礼物呢？

definition: to show or offer something for other people to look at or consider
example: present something, Are you presenting a paper at the conference?
definition_zh: 向他人展示或提供某物，供其观看或考虑
example_zh: 做报告，你要在会议上做报告吗？

definition: a meeting at which something, especially a new product or idea, or piece of work, is shown to a group of people
example: presentation on/about somebody/something, The sales manager will give a presentation on the new products.
definition_zh: 一种会议，旨在向一群人展示某样东西，尤其是新产品、新创意或某项作品
example_zh: 关于某人/某事的演讲，销售经理将就新产品做一场演讲。

definition: at the time you are speaking or writing; now
example: The crime is presently being investigated by the police.
definition_zh: 你说话或写作的当下；现在
example_zh: 警方目前正在对这起案件进行调查。

definition: the act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition
example: building/environmental/food preservation
definition_zh: 将某物保持在原状或良好状态的行为
example_zh: 建筑/环境/食品保鲜

definition: to keep a particular quality, feature, etc.; to make sure that something is kept
example: He was anxious to preserve his reputation.
definition_zh: 保持某种特定的品质、特征等；确保某物得以保持
example_zh: 他急于维护自己的声誉。

definition: to lead or be in charge of a meeting, ceremony, etc.
example: the presiding judge
definition_zh: 主持或负责会议、仪式等。
example_zh: 主审法官

definition: the job of being president of a country or an organization; the period of time somebody holds this job
example: the current holder of the EU presidency
definition_zh: 担任一个国家或组织总统的职务；某人担任该职务的任期
example_zh: 现任欧盟轮值主席国

definition: the leader of a republic, for example the US
example: Several presidents attended the funeral.
definition_zh: 一个共和国的领导人，例如美国的领导人
example_zh: 几位总统出席了葬礼。

definition: connected with the position or activities of a president
example: a presidential campaign/candidate/election
definition_zh: 与总统的职位或活动有关
example_zh: 总统竞选活动/候选人/选举

definition: newspapers and magazines
example: the local/national/foreign press
definition_zh: 报纸和杂志
example_zh: 当地/国内/国外媒体

definition: to push part of a device, etc. in order to make it work
example: press something, to press a button/key
definition_zh: 按压设备的一部分等，使其正常工作
example_zh: 按下某物，按下按钮/按键

definition: the act of trying to persuade or to force somebody to do something
example: pressure for something, The pressure for change continued to mount.
definition_zh: 试图说服或强迫某人做某事的行为
example_zh: 某事的压力，要求变革的压力持续加剧。

definition: respected and admired as very important or of very high quality
example: a prestigious award
definition_zh: 因极其重要或品质极高而备受尊敬和钦佩
example_zh: 一项享有盛誉的奖项

definition: used to say that you think that something is probably true
example: Presumably this is where the accident happened.
definition_zh: 用于表示你认为某事“大概是”真的
example_zh: 想必事故就是发生在这里。

definition: to suppose that something is true, although you do not have actual proof
example: They are very expensive, I presume?
definition_zh: 尽管没有确凿的证据，但推测某事为真
example_zh: 我想它们应该很贵吧？

definition: to behave in a particular way, in order to make other people believe something that is not true
example: I'm tired of having to pretend all the time.
definition_zh: 以某种特定方式行事，目的是让别人相信某种不真实的事情
example_zh: 我厌倦了总得装模作样。

definition: attractive without being very beautiful
example: a pretty face
definition_zh: 虽不算特别漂亮，但很有魅力
example_zh: 一张漂亮的脸蛋

definition: to some extent; fairly
example: The game was pretty good.
definition_zh: 在某种程度上；相当
example_zh: 这场比赛挺不错的。

definition: to exist or be very common at a particular time or in a particular place
example: prevail in something, We were horrified at the conditions prevailing in local prisons.
definition_zh: 在特定时间或特定地点存在或非常普遍
example_zh: 在某事上盛行，当地监狱中普遍存在的状况让我们感到震惊。

definition: the fact of existing or being very common at a particular time or in a particular place
example: an increase in the prevalence of smoking among young people
definition_zh: 在特定时间或特定地点确实存在或非常普遍这一事实
example_zh: 青少年吸烟率的上升

definition: to stop somebody from doing something; to stop something from happening
example: prevent something/somebody, The accident could have been prevented.
definition_zh: 阻止某人做某事；阻止某事发生
example_zh: 阻止某事/某人，这起事故本可以避免。

definition: the act of stopping something bad from happening
example: accident/crime prevention
definition_zh: 阻止某件坏事发生的行为
example_zh: 事故/犯罪预防

definition: happening or existing before the event or object that you are talking about
example: No previous experience is necessary for this job.
definition_zh: 发生或存在于你所谈论的事件或事物之前
example_zh: 该职位无需相关工作经验。

definition: at a time before the time that you are talking about
example: The building had previously been used as a hotel.
definition_zh: 在你所说的那个时间之前的一段时间里
example_zh: 该建筑此前曾作为酒店使用。

definition: an animal, a bird, etc. that is hunted, killed and eaten by another
example: The lion will often stalk its prey for hours.
definition_zh: 被另一种动物、鸟类等捕猎、杀死并食用的动物、鸟类等
example_zh: 狮子常常会潜行数小时来追踪猎物。

definition: the amount of money that you have to pay for something
example: Boat for sale, price £8 000
definition_zh: 为某件事需要支付的金额
example_zh: 船只出售，售价 8 000 英镑

definition: to fix the price of something at a particular level
example: be priced + adv./prep., The main courses are all reasonably priced.
definition_zh: 将某物的价格定在特定水平
example_zh: 价格为 + 副词/介词，主菜的价格都很合理。

definition: a feeling of being pleased or satisfied that you get when you or people who are connected with you have done something well or own something that other people admire
example: The sight of her son graduating filled her with pride.
definition_zh: 当你或与你有关的人做得很好，或者拥有了别人羡慕的东西时，所产生的一种高兴或满足的感觉
example_zh: 看到儿子毕业，她感到无比自豪。

definition: a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in the Roman Catholic, Anglican and Orthodox Churches
example: a parish priest
definition_zh: 在罗马天主教会、圣公会和东正教会中，有资格履行宗教职责并主持宗教仪式的神职人员
example_zh: 一位堂区神父

definition: mainly
example: a course designed primarily for specialists
definition_zh: 主要是
example_zh: 一门主要面向专业人士开设的课程

definition: connected with the education of children between the ages of about five and eleven
example: primary teachers
definition_zh: 与大约五岁至十一岁儿童的教育有关
example_zh: 小学教师

definition: main; most important; basic
example: My prime concern is to protect my property.
definition_zh: 主要；最重要的；基本的
example_zh: 我最关心的就是保护我的财产。

definition: a male member of a royal family who is not king, especially the son or grandson of the king or queen
example: the royal princes
definition_zh: 王室中非国王的男性成员，尤其是国王或王后的儿子或孙子
example_zh: 王室王子们

definition: a female member of a royal family who is not a queen, especially the daughter or granddaughter of the king or queen
example: the royal princesses
definition_zh: 王室中非王后的女性成员，尤其是国王或王后的女儿或孙女
example_zh: 王室公主们

definition: most important; main
example: The principal reason for this omission is lack of time.
definition_zh: 最重要的；主要的
example_zh: 造成这一遗漏的主要原因是时间不够。

definition: the person who is in charge of a college or (in Scotland and Canada) a university
example: Peter Brown, principal of St John’s College
definition_zh: 负责管理学院或（在苏格兰和加拿大）大学的负责人
example_zh: 彼得·布朗，圣约翰学院院长

definition: a moral rule or a strong belief that influences your actions
example: He has high moral principles.
definition_zh: 一种道德准则或一种坚定的信念，它会影响你的行为
example_zh: 他有着崇高的道德准则。

definition: letters, words, numbers, etc. that have been printed onto paper
example: The tiny print was hard to read without my glasses.
definition_zh: 印在纸上的字母、单词、数字等
example_zh: 不戴眼镜的话，那些小字很难看清。

definition: to produce letters, pictures, etc. on paper using a machine that puts ink (= coloured liquid) on the surface
example: print (something), I'm printing a copy of the document for you.
definition_zh: 利用一种将墨水（=有色液体）涂在纸张表面的机器，在纸上印出文字、图片等
example_zh: 打印（某物），我正在为你打印一份该文档的副本。

definition: a machine for printing text on paper, especially one connected to a computer
